en.name: 100G QSFP28 Direct Attach module, range up to 1 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech 100G QSFP28 Direct Attach DAC cable up to 1 m: direct 100 Gbps copper connection for servers in a rack. Buy in Tashkent with delivery.
en.description:
The Pixietech PXT-QSFP28+DA-1 module is a 100-gigabit direct-attach copper DAC cable in the QSFP28 form factor with a reach of up to 1 meter. It is designed for ultra-high-speed connection of switches, servers, and routers with 100G QSFP28 ports inside a single mounting cabinet. The absence of optical components makes the cable more reliable and cheaper than optical transceivers for connections over minimal distances in data centers.

## Advantages
- 100 Gbit/s speed: provides maximum throughput for demanding applications and uplinks
- Passive design: no active components, significantly reducing heat dissipation in the rack
- Savings compared to 100G optical transceivers: a copper DAC cable is noticeably cheaper
- Zero conversion latency: a direct copper connection minimizes latency
- Plug-and-play: requires no configuration and is compatible with standard QSFP28 ports
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Data centers: high-speed inter-rack and intra-rack server connections
- Corporate network cores: 100G uplinks between aggregation and core switches
- Cloud and virtualized environments: connecting servers and storage with minimal latency
- Telecommunications platforms: high-speed junctions between equipment nodes

## FAQ
Q: What is the maximum distance the PXT-QSFP28+DA-1 works over?
A: The cable is designed for distances up to 1 meter and is optimal for connections within a single mounting cabinet.
Q: Is the cable compatible with equipment from different manufacturers?
A: The cable uses a standard QSFP28 connector and is compatible with most switches and servers with 100G ports that support this form factor.
Q: How is a DAC cable better than a 100G optical transceiver?
A: Over distances of up to a few meters, a DAC cable is cheaper, more reliable (no laser and photodetector), and dissipates less heat than active optical solutions.

- Pasif tasarım: aktif bileşen yok, rafta ısı yayılımı önemli ölçüde azalır
- 100G optik alıcı-vericilere kıyasla tasarruf: bakır DAC kablosu belirgin şekilde daha ucuzdur
- Sıfır dönüştürme gecikmesi: doğrudan bakır bağlantı gecikmeyi en aza indirir

- Telekomünikasyon platformaları: ekipman düğümleri arasında yüksek hızlı bağlantılar

## FAQ
Q: PXT-QSFP28+DA-1 maksimum hangi mesafede çalışır?
A: Kablo 1 metreye kadar mesafeler için tasarlanmıştır ve tek bir montaj kabini içindeki bağlantılar için idealdir.

A: Kablo standart bir QSFP28 konnektörü kullanır ve bu form faktörünü destekleyen 100G portlu çoğu anahtar ve sunucuyla uyumludur.
Q: DAC kablosu 100G optik alıcı-vericiden neden daha iyi?

zh.name: 100G QSFP28 Direct Attach 模块，距离达 1 m

- 100 Gbit/s 速率：为高要求应用和上行链路提供最大吞吐量
- 无源设计：无有源组件，机柜中散热量显著降低
- 相比 100G 光模块更省钱：铜缆 DAC 明显更便宜
- 零转换延迟：直连铜缆将时延降至最低

- 云和虚拟化环境：以最低延迟连接服务器和存储
- 电信平台：设备节点之间的高速对接

## FAQ
Q: PXT-QSFP28+DA-1 的最大工作距离是多少？
A: 该线缆专为最长 1 米的距离设计，最适合单个安装机柜内的连接。
Q: 该线缆兼容不同厂商的设备吗？
A: 该线缆使用标准 QSFP28 连接器，兼容大多数支持此外形的 100G 端口交换机和服务器。
Q: DAC 线缆相比 100G 光模块好在哪里？
A: 在最长几米的距离上，DAC 线缆更便宜、更可靠（无激光器和光电探测器），且比有源光缆方案散热更少。

- 100 Gbit/s o‘tkazuvchanlik zamonaviy ma'lumot markazlari va yuqori yuklamali tarmoqlar talablariga mos keladi

en.name: 100G QSFP28 Direct Attach module, range up to 2 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech 100G QSFP28 Direct Attach passive DAC cable, 2 m: connecting devices at 100 Gbps in adjacent racks. In stock, delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
The Pixietech PXT-QSFP28+DA-2 module is a passive 100-gigabit direct-attach DAC cable in the QSFP28 form factor with a length of 2 meters. It provides a high-speed 100G connection of two devices within one or adjacent racks without using optical transceivers. The solution is suitable for data centers where an economical and reliable way to implement 100-gigabit links is required.

## Advantages
- 100 Gbit/s of throughput meets the requirements of modern data centers and high-load networks
- A length of 2 meters provides flexibility when connecting devices in different rack positions or in adjacent cabinets
- The passive design reduces heat dissipation and increases reliability compared to active cables
- The cost is lower than a pair of 100G optical transceivers at the same performance
- Plug-and-play without additional configuration
- 1-year warranty from the manufacturer

## Applications
- Data centers: connecting servers, switches, and storage in adjacent rack positions
- Corporate networks: high-speed uplinks between core network equipment
- Virtualization and clusters: minimal latency between compute cluster nodes
- Telecommunications companies: 100G junctions between platforms in a single technical room

## FAQ
Q: How does the PXT-QSFP28+DA-2 differ from the DA-1 version?
A: The only difference is the cable length: the DA-2 has a length of 2 meters versus 1 meter for the DA-1, which provides more flexibility in equipment placement.
Q: Does the cable work with equipment that supports only 40G on a QSFP+ port?
A: QSFP28 and QSFP+ are different standards; QSFP+ DAC cables are used for 40G, while the PXT-QSFP28+DA-2 is intended specifically for 100G QSFP28 ports.
Q: Is splitting 100G into 4x25G supported with this cable?
A: This cable is a standard QSFP28 DAC, not a breakout cable; specialized breakout variants are used to split 100G into 4x25G.

Q: PXT-QSFP28+DA-2, DA-1 sürümünden nasıl farklıdır?

en.name: 100G QSFP28 Direct Attach module, range up to 3 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech 100G QSFP28 Direct Attach DAC cable, 3 m: direct 100 Gbps copper connection of equipment in different racks. Buy in Tashkent.
en.description:
The Pixietech PXT-QSFP28+DA-3 is a passive 100 Gbit/s DAC cable in the QSFP28 form factor with a length of 3 meters for direct copper connection of network equipment. The maximum length in the DA series allows connecting devices located in different racks or remote positions of a single mounting row. The cable is suitable for high-load data center networks where an economical alternative to expensive 100G optical transceivers is needed.

## Advantages
- 100 Gbit/s data transfer speed for the most demanding applications and workloads
- A length of 3 meters provides the greatest coverage in the series, allowing connection of devices in different racks
- Passive copper design: high reliability and minimal heat dissipation
- Significant savings compared to 100G optical transceivers and patch cords
- Easy connection to standard QSFP28 ports without additional configuration
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Data centers: connecting equipment in adjacent racks without using optics
- High-performance computing: inter-node connections with minimal latency in HPC clusters
- Corporate network cores: 100G uplinks between aggregation and core switches
- Cloud platforms: connecting servers and storage in hyperconverged infrastructures

## FAQ
Q: Why is a passive DAC, rather than an active one, used for a length of 3 meters?
A: Passive DAC cables operate reliably over distances of up to 3-5 meters without additional amplifiers, providing low heat dissipation and high reliability at a lower cost.
Q: Is the cable compatible with switches from Cisco, Juniper, Arista, and other manufacturers?

Q: 3 metre uzunluk için neden aktif değil de pasif DAC kullanılır?

en.name: 25G SFP28 Direct Attach module, 1 meter

en.description:

The solution is in demand in modern data centers and high-load corporate networks transitioning to 25-gigabit uplinks.

## Advantages
- 25 Gbit/s speed per port: doubles the capabilities of a 10G infrastructure with minimal upgrade costs
- A passive design without active components reduces cost and increases reliability
- An economical alternative to optical SFP28 transceivers: a DAC cable is noticeably cheaper
- Minimal latency thanks to a direct copper connection without signal conversion
- Plug-and-play: requires no configuration, compatible with standard SFP28 ports
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Data centers: connecting servers to ToR (Top-of-Rack) switches at 25G speed
- Corporate networks: next-generation high-speed uplinks within the server room
- Virtualization and container platforms: low-latency connection of cluster hosts
- Technology companies and cloud providers: scaling the network without switching to expensive 100G optics

Q: Is the PXT-SFP28-DA-1 compatible with equipment that supports only SFP+ 10G?

Q: For what distances is this cable intended?

A: Over short distances of up to a few meters, a passive copper cable has virtually no moving parts and active components, which makes it no less reliable and significantly more cost-effective.
Q: Is hot-swapping of the module supported without powering off the equipment?
A: The SFP28 form factor supports hot-swapping on most compatible switches and server cards.
Q: How should the cable be stored to avoid damaging the connectors?
A: Store the module in its original packaging with protective caps on the connectors, avoiding kinks and mechanical loads on the cable braid.

Q: 应如何存放线缆以免损坏连接器？
A: 将模块存放在带有连接器保护帽的原包装中，避免线缆外被层折弯和受到机械负荷。

en.name: 40G QSFP+ Direct Attach module, range up to 1 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech 40G QSFP+ Direct Attach cable up to 1 m: passive 40 Gbps copper connection for servers in the same rack. In stock in Tashkent, with warranty.
en.description:
The 40G QSFP+ Direct Attach module from Pixietech with a length of up to 1 meter is an ultra-short high-speed connection for switches and servers installed in a single rack. The passive copper DAC cable provides data transmission at 40 Gbit/s and is ideally suited for connecting ToR switches to server nodes with minimal latency. The solution is in demand in data centers where transmission speed is critically important while minimizing costs for inter-component connections.

## Advantages
- 40 Gbit/s speed: high aggregated throughput for server and network loads
- Up to 1 meter length: the ideal size for connections within a single rack without excess cable length
- Passive copper interface: no active components, low power consumption and heat dissipation
- Standard QSFP+: wide compatibility with server and network equipment from leading manufacturers
- Minimal latency: a direct copper connection without optical signal conversion
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Data centers: connecting access-layer switches to server chassis within a rack
- High-performance computing: building low-latency clusters
- Cloud platforms: a transport layer between compute nodes
- Storage systems: connecting storage to servers over a high-speed interface

## FAQ
Q: How does a QSFP+ DAC differ from a standard QSFP+ optical transceiver?
A: A DAC cable uses a copper wire and does not require a laser transmitter and a photoreceiver, which makes it cheaper and more reliable over distances of up to a few meters.
Q: Will the module work with switches from other brands?
A: Most modern switches with QSFP+ connectors support DAC cables from third-party manufacturers; it is better to check compatibility with the specific model with the supplier.
Q: Is there a risk of signal loss at a length of 1 meter?
A: At a distance of 1 meter, the passive copper cable provides an absolutely stable signal without any losses.

Q: QSFP+ DAC, standart bir QSFP+ optik alıcı-vericiden nasıl farklıdır?

en.name: 40G QSFP+ Direct Attach module, range up to 2 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech 40G QSFP+ Direct Attach DAC cable up to 2 m for connecting switches and servers in a rack. Speed 40 Gbps, delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
The 40G QSFP+ Direct Attach module from Pixietech with a reach of up to 2 meters is designed for high-speed connection of switches and servers within a server rack or between side-by-side racks. The speed of 40 Gbit/s combined with the simplicity of a passive copper cable makes it an optimal choice for the economical construction of a high-performance network infrastructure. The device is suitable for use in data centers, corporate server rooms, and operator nodes of any scale.

## Advantages
- 40 Gbit/s: provides high aggregated bandwidth for modern server loads
- Up to 2 meters length: connection flexibility within a rack and between adjacent racks
- Passive copper design: reliable and requires no additional power
- QSFP+ form factor: supported by a wide range of switches and server adapters
- Cost-effectiveness: a lower cost than a pair of optical transceivers with the corresponding speed
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Data centers: inter-rack and intra-rack connections of switches and servers
- Corporate networks: the high-speed core of the server infrastructure
- Virtualized environments: a transport layer between hypervisor hosts
- Storage networks: connecting high-performance storage

## FAQ
Q: What is the advantage of a DAC cable over an optical transceiver at a distance of 2 meters?
A: A passive copper cable is cheaper, easier to connect, and requires no maintenance of optical connectors, while providing the same data transfer speed.
Q: Does the module support speed auto-negotiation?
A: Passive DAC cables operate at a fixed speed of 40 Gbit/s and do not perform auto-negotiation; the equipment on both ends must support this standard.
Q: Can the cable be used in an environment with elevated temperature?
A: Copper passive cables are quite resistant to heating, but the temperature norms specified by the equipment manufacturer for server rooms should be observed.

## 应用领域

Q: 在 2 米距离上，DAC 线缆相比光模块有何优势？

Q: 该模块支持速率自动协商吗？

Q: 该线缆能在高温环境中使用吗？
A: 铜质无源线缆对受热具有相当的耐受性，但应遵守设备厂商为服务器机房规定的温度标准。

en.name: 40G QSFP+ Direct Attach module, range up to 3 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech 40G QSFP+ Direct Attach passive DAC cable up to 3 m: connecting equipment across multiple racks at 40 Gbps. Buy in Tashkent.
en.description:
The 40G QSFP+ Direct Attach module from Pixietech with a reach of up to 3 meters is a reliable and economical solution for high-speed connection of network equipment within several racks. The passive copper DAC cable operates at 40 Gbit/s and is suitable for server environments that require more cable-routing flexibility than shorter models can provide. The solution is relevant for data centers, operator nodes, and corporate computing centers in Uzbekistan.

## Advantages
- 40 Gbit/s speed: meets the requirements of modern server platforms and storage systems
- 3-meter length: optimal for connecting equipment between adjacent racks in a data center
- Passive type: no active components, minimal heat dissipation and high reliability
- Standard QSFP+: compatible with a wide range of switches and server cards
- Low latency: a direct copper connection without optical conversion
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Data centers: inter-rack connections of aggregation switches and server units
- High-performance computing: building low-latency HPC clusters
- Corporate server rooms: high-speed linking of network and server equipment
- Operator communication nodes: organizing fast internal connections in equipment rooms

## FAQ
Q: Can the cable be bent and laid in cable channels?
A: The cable allows moderate bending within the norm specified by the manufacturer; avoid sharp kinks at an acute angle so as not to damage the conductors.
Q: Are special tools needed to install the module?
A: No, the module is inserted into the QSFP+ connector without tools and is secured with a standard latching mechanism.
Q: Is operation guaranteed with switches from manufacturers not mentioned in the documentation?
A: The QSFP+ form factor is standardized, and most manufacturers support compatible DAC cables; check compatibility with the specific model with a SAT Solutions manager.

Q: Kablo bükülüp kablo kanallarına döşenebilir mi?

Q: Belgelerde belirtilmeyen üreticilerin anahtarlarıyla çalışma garanti edilir mi?

- Bitta QSFP+ portdan har biri 10 Gbit/s bo‘lgan 4 kanal: kommutatorning yuqori tezlikdagi portlaridan samarali foydalanish
- Portlar va uskunada tejamkorlik: bitta QSFP+ port to‘rtta alohida SFP+ ulanishni almashtiradi

en.name: 40G QSFP-40G->4xSFP+ DAC module, 3 meters
en.shortDescription: Pixietech 40G QSFP+ to 4xSFP+ DAC breakout cable, 3 m: splits a 40 Gbps port into four 10G channels for data centers. Buy in Tashkent with delivery.
en.description:
The Pixietech 40G QSFP+ — 4xSFP+ DAC module with a length of 3 meters allows splitting one 40 Gbit/s QSFP+ port into four independent SFP+ channels of 10 Gbit/s each. This breakout-type solution is widely used in data centers for efficient utilization of high-speed switch ports: instead of one 40G connection, you get four 10G connections without additional equipment. The 3-meter length provides convenient routing within several racks.

## Advantages
- 4 channels of 10 Gbit/s from a single QSFP+ port: efficient utilization of high-speed switch ports
- Savings on ports and equipment: one QSFP+ port replaces four separate SFP+ connections
- 3-meter length: comfortable routing between racks of a single row
- Passive design: no active components, high reliability and low power consumption
- Standard form factors: compatible with switches and servers that support QSFP+ breakout
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Data centers: connecting several servers to a single QSFP+ port of an aggregation switch
- Corporate networks: flexible speed distribution among several nodes
- Cloud and hyperconverged environments: optimizing the number of ports used
- Storage networks: simultaneously connecting several storage nodes

## FAQ
Q: How does the switch "understand" that a breakout cable is connected?
A: The switch must support QSFP+ breakout mode and be configured to split the port into four 10G channels; check support for this mode in your equipment's documentation.
Q: Do all four channels work simultaneously and independently?
A: Yes, each of the four SFP+ connectors functions as a full-fledged independent 10 Gbit/s port.
Q: Can only some of the four SFP+ connectors be used, leaving the rest free?
A: Technically, unused connectors can be left unengaged, but you should make sure that such a configuration is supported by your switch's firmware.

tr.name: 40G QSFP-40G->4xSFP+ DAC modülü, 3 metre

tr.description:
Pixietech 40G QSFP+ — 4xSFP+ DAC modülü, 3 metre uzunluğunda, bir 40 Gbit/s QSFP+ portunu her biri 10 Gbit/s olan dört bağımsız SFP+ kanalına bölmeye olanak tanır. Bu "breakout" türü çözüm, anahtarın yüksek hızlı portlarının verimli kullanımı için veri merkezlerinde yaygın olarak kullanılır: bir 40G bağlantı yerine, ek ekipman olmadan dört 10G bağlantı elde edersiniz. 3 metre uzunluk, birkaç raf içinde rahat döşeme sağlar.

## Avantajları
- Tek bir QSFP+ porttan her biri 10 Gbit/s olan 4 kanal: anahtarın yüksek hızlı portlarının verimli kullanımı
- Portlardan ve ekipmandan tasarruf: bir QSFP+ port, dört ayrı SFP+ bağlantısının yerini alır
- 3 metre uzunluk: tek bir sıradaki raflar arasında rahat döşeme
- Pasif tasarım: aktif bileşen yok, yüksek güvenilirlik ve düşük güç tüketimi
- Standart form faktörleri: QSFP+ breakout destekleyen anahtarlar ve sunucularla uyumlu
- Pixietech'ten 1 yıl garanti

## Uygulama Alanları
- Veri merkezleri: birkaç sunucunun bir toplama anahtarının tek bir QSFP+ portuna bağlanması
- Kurumsal ağlar: birkaç düğüm arasında esnek hız dağıtımı
- Bulut ve hiperbirleşik ortamlar: kullanılan port sayısının optimize edilmesi
- Depolama ağları: birkaç depolama düğümünün aynı anda bağlanması

## FAQ
Q: Anahtar, bir breakout kablosunun bağlı olduğunu nasıl "anlar"?
A: Anahtar QSFP+ breakout modunu desteklemeli ve portu dört 10G kanalına bölecek şekilde yapılandırılmalıdır; bu modun desteğini ekipmanınızın belgelerinde kontrol edin.
Q: Dört kanalın hepsi aynı anda ve bağımsız olarak çalışır mı?
A: Evet, dört SFP+ konnektörünün her biri tam teşekküllü bağımsız bir 10 Gbit/s portu olarak işlev görür.
Q: Dört SFP+ konnektörünün yalnızca bir kısmı kullanılıp geri kalanı boş bırakılabilir mi?
A: Teknik olarak kullanılmayan konnektörler bağlanmadan bırakılabilir, ancak böyle bir yapılandırmanın anahtarınızın bellenimi tarafından desteklendiğinden emin olmalısınız.

Pixietech 40G QSFP+ — 4xSFP+ DAC 模块长度为 3 米，可将一个 40 Gbit/s QSFP+ 端口拆分为四个各 10 Gbit/s 的独立 SFP+ 通道。这种 breakout 型方案在数据中心广泛用于高效利用交换机高速端口：您无需额外设备即可用四个 10G 连接替代一个 40G 连接。3 米长度可在数个机柜范围内方便布线。

## 优势
- 从单个 QSFP+ 端口获得 4 个各 10 Gbit/s 的通道：高效利用交换机的高速端口
- 节省端口和设备：一个 QSFP+ 端口替代四个独立的 SFP+ 连接
- 3 米长度：在单排机柜之间舒适布线
- 无源设计：无有源组件，高可靠性和低功耗
- 标准外形：兼容支持 QSFP+ breakout 的交换机和服务器
- Pixietech 提供 1 年保修

## 应用领域
- 数据中心：将多台服务器连接到汇聚交换机的单个 QSFP+ 端口
- 企业网络：在多个节点之间灵活分配速率
- 云和超融合环境：优化所用端口数量
- 存储网络：同时连接多个存储节点

## FAQ
Q: 交换机如何"识别"已连接 breakout 线缆？
A: 交换机必须支持 QSFP+ breakout 模式并配置为将该端口拆分为四个 10G 通道；请在您设备的文档中确认对此模式的支持。
Q: 四个通道是否同时独立工作？
A: 是的，四个 SFP+ 连接器中的每一个都作为完整的独立 10 Gbit/s 端口运行。
Q: 能否只使用四个 SFP+ 连接器中的一部分，其余保持空闲？
A: 技术上可以让未使用的连接器保持闲置，但应确保您交换机的固件支持这种配置。

en.shortDescription: Pixietech QSFP+ 40GBASE-LR4 transceiver, LC Duplex, up to 10 km over single-mode: WDM technology, 40 Gbps speed. Buy in Tashkent with delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
The Pixietech QSFP+ 40GBASE-LR4 optical transceiver with an LC Duplex connector provides data transmission at 40 Gbit/s over single-mode optical fiber for distances up to 10 kilometers. It uses four-wavelength WDM technology and transmits the entire stream over a pair of single-mode fibers with an LC connector, making it optimal for building high-speed inter-site connections and backbone channels. The solution is in demand in telecommunications, large corporate networks, and operator networks of Uzbekistan.

## Advantages
- 40 Gbit/s speed: high-performance backbone data transmission
- Range up to 10 km: allows connecting sites located in different districts of the city
- Single-mode fiber: minimal signal attenuation over long distances
- LC Duplex connector: a standard and widely available connection type
- LR4 technology (4 wavelengths): high spectral efficiency of a single fiber path
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Backbone corporate networks: connecting offices and production sites
- Telecommunications operators: transport channels between communication nodes
- Data centers: high-speed uplinks over long distances
- Universities and government institutions: combining geographically distributed buildings

## FAQ
Q: What type of fiber is required for this transceiver?
A: The transceiver works with single-mode optical fiber (SMF); multi-mode fiber is incompatible with the LR4 standard.
Q: Is a media converter needed to connect to equipment without a QSFP+ port?
A: If the switch or router does not have a QSFP+ port, a media converter or a modular switch supporting this form factor will be required.
Q: Does the transceiver guarantee a distance of exactly 10 km?
A: The 10 km distance is the maximum per the standard; the actual distance depends on fiber quality, the number of fusion splices, and connectors in the path.

Dört dalga boyu WDM teknolojisini kullanır ve tüm akışı LC konnektörlü bir çift tek modlu fiber üzerinden iletir, bu da onu yüksek hızlı tesisler arası bağlantılar ve omurga kanalları oluşturmak için optimal kılar. Çözüm, Özbekistan'ın telekomünikasyon, büyük kurumsal ağlar ve operatör ağlarında talep görmektedir.

## Avantajları
- 40 Gbit/s hız: yüksek performanslı omurga veri iletimi
- 10 km'ye kadar mesafe: şehrin farklı bölgelerinde bulunan tesisleri bağlamaya olanak tanır
- Tek modlu fiber: uzun mesafelerde minimum sinyal zayıflaması
- LC Duplex konnektör: standart ve yaygın olarak bulunabilen bir bağlantı türü
- LR4 teknolojisi (4 dalga boyu): tek bir fiber yolunun yüksek spektral verimliliği
- Pixietech'ten 1 yıl garanti

## Uygulama Alanları
- Omurga kurumsal ağlar: ofislerin ve üretim sahalarının bağlanması
- Telekomünikasyon operatörleri: iletişim düğümleri arasında taşıma kanalları
- Veri merkezleri: uzun mesafelerde yüksek hızlı uplink'ler
- Üniversiteler ve devlet kurumları: coğrafi olarak dağıtılmış binaların birleştirilmesi

## FAQ
Q: Bu alıcı-verici için hangi tür fiber gereklidir?
A: Alıcı-verici tek modlu optik fiber (SMF) ile çalışır; çok modlu fiber LR4 standardıyla uyumsuzdur.
Q: QSFP+ portu olmayan ekipmana bağlanmak için bir medya dönüştürücü gerekli mi?
A: Anahtarın veya yönlendiricinin QSFP+ portu yoksa, bu form faktörünü destekleyen bir medya dönüştürücü veya modüler anahtar gerekecektir.
Q: Alıcı-verici tam olarak 10 km mesafeyi garanti eder mi?
A: 10 km mesafe standarda göre maksimumdur; gerçek mesafe fiber kalitesine, yoldaki kaynak ek sayısına ve konnektörlere bağlıdır.

zh.name: QSFP+ 40GBASE-LR4 模块，LC Duplex，距离达 10 km
zh.shortDescription: Pixietech QSFP+ 40GBASE-LR4 光模块，LC Duplex，单模光纤上达 10 km：采用 WDM 技术，速率 40 Gbps。塔什干购买，乌兹别克斯坦全境配送。
zh.description:
带 LC Duplex 连接器的 Pixietech QSFP+ 40GBASE-LR4 光模块，可在单模光纤上以 40 Gbit/s 速率传输数据，距离最长 10 公里。它采用四波长 WDM 技术，通过一对带 LC 连接器的单模光纤传输整个数据流，使其成为构建高速跨站点连接和主干通道的最佳选择。该方案在乌兹别克斯坦的电信、大型企业网络和运营商网络中备受需求。

## 优势
- 40 Gbit/s 速率：高性能主干数据传输
- 最长 10 km 距离：可连接位于城市不同区域的站点
- 单模光纤：长距离上信号衰减最小
- LC Duplex 连接器：标准且广泛可得的连接类型
- LR4 技术（4 个波长）：单光纤路径的高频谱效率
- Pixietech 提供 1 年保修

## 应用领域
- 主干企业网络：连接办公室和生产场所
- 电信运营商：通信节点之间的传输通道
- 数据中心：长距离的高速上行链路
- 大学和政府机构：连接地理上分散的建筑

## FAQ
Q: 该光模块需要哪种类型的光纤？
A: 该光模块使用单模光纤（SMF）；多模光纤与 LR4 标准不兼容。
Q: 连接到没有 QSFP+ 端口的设备需要媒体转换器吗？
A: 如果交换机或路由器没有 QSFP+ 端口，则需要支持此外形的媒体转换器或模块化交换机。
Q: 该光模块能保证恰好 10 km 的距离吗？
A: 10 km 距离是标准规定的最大值；实际距离取决于光纤质量、路径中的熔接接头数量和连接器。

Bu yechim katta masofalarda ishonchli yuqori unumdorlikdagi optik aloqaga muhtoj bo‘lgan aloqa operatorlari, yirik korporatsiyalar va davlat tuzilmalari uchun mo‘ljallangan.

## Afzalliklari
- 40 Gbit/s tezlik: ma'lumotlar, video va ovoz uchun kuchli transport kanali
- 20 km gacha masofa: butun shahar yoki aglomeratsiya miqyosini qamrab oladi
- Bir modali tola: oraliq kuchaytirgichlarsiz barqaror signal sifati
- LC Duplex: patch-kordlar va kross-panellarning keng tanloviga ega standart razyom

Q: 20 km lik transiver 10 km lik versiyadan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?

Q: G.652 bir modali tolasidan foydalanish majburiymi?
A: 40GBASE-LR4 standarti G.652D toifasidagi bir modali tolani nazarda tutadi, boshqa turdagi tolalardan foydalanish masofani yomonlashtirishi yoki uzatishdagi xatolarga olib kelishi mumkin.

Q: LC optik razyomlarining tozaligi qanchalik muhim?
A: Razyom uchlarining tozaligi signal sifatiga bevosita ta'sir qiladi; maxsus tozalagichlardan foydalanish va ulashdan oldin razyomlarni tekshirish tavsiya etiladi.

en.name: QSFP+ 40GBASE-LR4 module, LC Duplex, range up to 20 km
en.shortDescription: Pixietech QSFP+ 40GBASE-LR4 module, LC Duplex, up to 20 km: backbone 40 Gbps links over single-mode with WDM. In stock, delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
The Pixietech QSFP+ 40GBASE-LR4 optical transceiver with an LC Duplex connector and a reach of up to 20 kilometers is designed for building high-speed backbone links between geographically dispersed sites. Operating at 40 Gbit/s over single-mode fiber using four-wavelength technology, it confidently covers the distances typical of metropolitan areas and suburban zones. This is a solution for telecom operators, large corporations, and government agencies that require reliable, high-performance optical communication over long distances.

## Advantages
- 40 Gbit/s speed: a powerful transport channel for data, video, and voice
- Reach up to 20 km: covers the scale of an entire city or metropolitan area
- Single-mode fiber: stable signal quality without intermediate amplifiers
- LC Duplex: a standard connector with a wide choice of patch cords and cross-connects
- LR4 technology: four wavelengths in a single fiber — high throughput
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Telecom operators: inter-node backbone links in metropolitan networks
- Large corporate networks: connecting branches and industrial sites
- Government and municipal networks: high-speed communication between departmental facilities
- Internet service providers: high-capacity uplinks in regional networks of Uzbekistan

## FAQ
Q: How does the 20 km transceiver differ from the 10 km version?
A: The 20 km version is designed for a higher optical budget, which allows it to compensate for the greater signal attenuation over the doubled distance.

Q: Is it mandatory to use G.652 single-mode fiber?
A: The 40GBASE-LR4 standard assumes G.652D category single-mode fiber; using other types may degrade the reach or lead to transmission errors.

Q: How critical is the cleanliness of the LC optical connectors?
A: The cleanliness of the connector end faces directly affects signal quality; it is recommended to use special cleaners and inspect connectors before connecting.

## Avantajlar
- 40 Gbit/s hız: veri, video ve ses için güçlü bir taşıma kanalı
- 20 km'ye kadar menzil: bütün bir şehrin veya metropol alanın ölçeğini kapsar
- Tek modlu fiber: ara yükselticiler olmadan kararlı sinyal kalitesi
- LC Duplex: geniş patch kordon ve kros seçeneğine sahip standart konnektör
- LR4 teknolojisi: tek bir fiberde dört dalga boyu — yüksek aktarım kapasitesi

## Uygulama Alanları
- Telekom operatörleri: metropol ağlarda düğümler arası omurga bağlantıları
- Büyük kurumsal ağlar: şubelerin ve endüstriyel sahaların bağlanması

## FAQ
Q: 20 km'lik alıcı-verici 10 km'lik versiyondan nasıl farklıdır?
A: 20 km'lik versiyon daha yüksek bir optik bütçe için tasarlanmıştır; bu, iki katına çıkan mesafede daha büyük sinyal zayıflamasını telafi etmeyi sağlar.

Q: G.652 tek modlu fiber kullanmak zorunlu mu?
A: 40GBASE-LR4 standardı G.652D kategorisi tek modlu fiber öngörür; diğer türlerin kullanılması menzili kötüleştirebilir veya iletim hatalarına yol açabilir.

Q: LC optik konnektörlerinin temizliği ne kadar kritik?
A: Konnektör uçlarının temizliği sinyal kalitesini doğrudan etkiler; özel temizleyiciler kullanılması ve bağlantıdan önce konnektörlerin kontrol edilmesi önerilir.

- 40 Gbit/s 速率：用于数据、视频和语音的强大传输通道
- 传输距离达 20 公里：覆盖整座城市或城市群的范围
- 单模光纤：无需中间放大器即可保持稳定的信号质量

## FAQ
Q: 20 公里的光模块与 10 公里的版本有何区别？

Q: 必须使用 G.652 单模光纤吗？
A: 40GBASE-LR4 标准要求使用 G.652D 类单模光纤，使用其他类型可能会降低传输距离或导致传输错误。

Q: LC 光接口的清洁度有多关键？

- 100 Gbit/s tezlik: yuqori yuklamali tarmoqlar uchun o‘tkazuvchanlikning keyingi darajasi

en.name: QSFP28 100GBASE-LR4-20 module, LC connector, range up to 10 km
en.shortDescription: Pixietech QSFP28 100GBASE-LR4 transceiver, LC, up to 10 km: 100 Gbps over existing single-mode, four channels in the module. In stock in Tashkent, with delivery.
en.description:
The Pixietech QSFP28 100GBASE-LR4 optical transceiver with an LC connector and a reach of up to 10 kilometers opens up the possibilities of 100-gigabit data transmission over existing single-mode optical infrastructure. LR4 technology combines four optical channels in a single transceiver, providing a total speed of 100 Gbit/s using a pair of fibers with LC connectors. This is a solution for backbone nodes, large data centers, and telecom operators where traditional 40G links can no longer handle the load.

## Advantages
- 100 Gbit/s speed: the next level of throughput for high-load networks
- Reach up to 10 km: sufficient for inter-node connections in metropolitan networks
- QSFP28 form factor: a compact and energy-efficient standard for 100G equipment
- LC Duplex connector: a standard interface compatible with existing patch-panel infrastructure
- LR4 technology: four wavelengths deliver maximum spectral efficiency
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Data centers: 100G uplinks and inter-switch backbones
- Telecom operators: inter-node 100G transport links in metropolitan networks
- Large corporate networks: a high-speed core for video surveillance, cloud, and ERP
- Internet service providers: high-capacity uplinks at regional traffic exchange points

## FAQ
Q: Is the transceiver compatible with switches from other manufacturers?
A: The 100GBASE-LR4 standard is supported by most leading network equipment manufacturers; compatibility with a specific model is recommended to be verified before ordering.

Q: Can already-installed single-mode fiber be used?
A: Yes, the transceiver works with standard G.652 single-mode fiber, which is widely used in existing optical infrastructure.

Q: How does the number of splices affect the actual reach?
A: Each splice and connector introduces attenuation; with a large number of connection points, the actual reach may be less than the maximum — an optical budget calculation is required.

- 100 Gbit/s hız: yüksek yüklü ağlar için bir sonraki aktarım kapasitesi seviyesi
- 10 km'ye kadar menzil: metropol ağlarda düğümler arası bağlantılar için yeterli
- QSFP28 form faktörü: 100G ekipmanları için kompakt ve enerji verimli bir standart
- LC Duplex konnektörü: mevcut patch panel altyapısıyla uyumlu standart arayüz
- LR4 teknolojisi: dört dalga boyu maksimum spektral verimlilik sağlar
- Pixietech'ten 1 yıl garanti

- Veri merkezleri: 100G uplinkler ve anahtarlar arası omurgalar

- Büyük kurumsal ağlar: video gözetim, bulut ve ERP için yüksek hızlı çekirdek
- İnternet servis sağlayıcıları: bölgesel trafik değişim noktalarında yüksek kapasiteli uplinkler

## FAQ
Q: Alıcı-verici diğer üreticilerin anahtarlarıyla uyumlu mu?
A: 100GBASE-LR4 standardı önde gelen ağ ekipmanı üreticilerinin çoğu tarafından desteklenir; belirli bir modelle uyumluluğun sipariş öncesi doğrulanması önerilir.

Q: Önceden döşenmiş tek modlu fiber kullanılabilir mi?

Q: Ek kaynak bağlantılarının sayısı gerçek menzili nasıl etkiler?

en.name: QSFP28 100GBASE-LR4-20 module, LC connector, range up to 20 km
en.shortDescription: Pixietech QSFP28 100GBASE-LR4 module, LC, up to 20 km: metro and intercity 100 Gbps links over single-mode. Delivery across Uzbekistan, with warranty.
en.description:
The Pixietech QSFP28 100GBASE-LR4 optical transceiver with an LC connector and a reach of up to 20 kilometers is designed for the longest metropolitan and intercity 100-gigabit links. Operating over standard single-mode fiber with LC Duplex connectors, it provides stable data transmission at 100 Gbit/s over a distance covering most metropolitan areas. The solution is in demand among telecom operators, large data centers, and government networks of Uzbekistan that require maximum backbone link capacity.

## Advantages
- 100 Gbit/s over up to 20 km: maximum throughput for long backbones
- LR4 technology: four wavelengths in a single fiber path — high spectral efficiency
- QSFP28 form factor: a compact standard occupying minimal space in a switch
- LC Duplex connector: compatible with any modern optical patch-panel infrastructure
- Single-mode fiber: minimal attenuation, stable operation without intermediate amplifiers
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Telecom operators: long-distance inter-node links in metropolitan and regional networks
- Large data centers: connecting sites spread tens of kilometers apart for disaster resilience
- Government and municipal networks: high-speed communication between departmental facilities in different districts
- University and research networks: high-capacity links between campuses

## FAQ
Q: Is a signal amplifier needed to operate over 20 km?
A: With quality fiber and a minimal number of connections, the transceiver operates reliably over 20 km without amplifiers; for a specific path, an optical budget calculation is required.

Q: How does the 20 km version differ from the 10 km one in design?
A: The 20 km transceiver has a higher optical transmitter power, which provides the necessary attenuation margin over the increased distance.

Q: Can this transceiver be used in a video surveillance system with a large number of channels?
A: The transceiver is a transport layer and carries any type of traffic; its 100 Gbit/s throughput is sufficient for hundreds of video surveillance streams.

en.name: QSFP28 100GBASE-ZR4 module, LC connector, range up to 80 km
en.shortDescription: Pixietech QSFP28 100GBASE-ZR4 module, LC, up to 80 km: ultra-long-haul 100-gigabit backbones over single-mode in the QSFP28 form factor. Delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
The Pixietech QSFP28 100GBASE-ZR4 optical transceiver with an LC connector and a reach of up to 80 kilometers is a flagship solution for ultra-long-haul 100-gigabit backbones. It operates over single-mode fiber and covers distances typical of inter-regional and intercity links while remaining in the compact QSFP28 form factor. The transceiver is indispensable for telecom operators, providers, and government agencies of Uzbekistan that need high-capacity long-distance transport links without intermediate equipment.

## Advantages
- Reach up to 80 km: covers most intercity and backbone routes without amplifiers
- 100 Gbit/s speed: maximum transport channel capacity in a compact QSFP28
- ZR4 standard: high optical budget designed for long fiber paths
- LC Duplex connector: compatible with standard optical cross-connect infrastructure
- QSFP28 form factor: dense installation in switches supporting 100G
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Telecom operators: intercity 100G transport links
- Internet service providers: high-capacity backbones between traffic exchange points
- Government and departmental networks: secure long-distance communication links
- Large corporations: disaster-resilient connections between geographically dispersed sites

## FAQ
Q: Will additional signal amplification be required on an 80 km route?
A: The transceiver is designed to operate up to 80 km without intermediate amplifiers, provided the fiber is of good quality with rated attenuation; for routes with high attenuation, an optical budget calculation is recommended.

Q: Is the ZR4 transceiver compatible with equipment designed for the LR4 standard?
A: ZR4 and LR4 are different standards with different optical budgets; for operation, both ends of the line must use transceivers of the same standard.

Q: Can the transceiver be operated in outdoor optical cabinets?
A: The transceiver is intended for installation in a switch's QSFP28 port in an enclosed room; for outdoor use, the equipment must be placed in temperature-controlled cabinets with appropriate protection.

The Pixietech ZX SFP module with a reach of up to 80 km is designed for building long-distance fiber-optic backbones without active amplifiers. It operates at a wavelength of 1550 nm with an optical budget of 14 dB and an LC Duplex connector. It is the choice of telecom operators and system integrators who need to link remote sites over a single fiber route with minimal operating costs.

## Advantages
- Reach up to 80 km: enables building intercity links and connecting sites at distances where other modules require amplifiers
- 1550 nm wavelength: the standard for long-distance transmission over low-attenuation single-mode fiber
- 14 dB optical budget: sufficient for real routes accounting for splices, connectors, and cable bends
- SFP form factor: compatibility with a wide range of active equipment without replacing the chassis
- LC Duplex connector: convenient for mounting in densely populated switching cabinets
- 1-year warranty: official Pixietech support

## Applications
- Intercity backbones: connecting communication nodes between settlements
- Operator transport networks: building long-distance P2P links and rings without regenerators
- Energy infrastructure: communication between substations and dispatch centers over significant distances
- Government and departmental networks: providing secure links between sites at distances up to 80 km
- Transport infrastructure: communication along railway corridors and highways

## FAQ
Q: Is an optical amplifier needed to operate over 80 km?
A: With quality laying of single-mode cable and properly executed splices, the module provides communication up to 80 km without additional amplification.

Q: Is the module compatible with Cisco, Huawei, MikroTik equipment?
A: The module conforms to the MSA SFP standard and is compatible with most brands that support this form factor.

Q: Where can I buy SFP ZX-80 in Tashkent?
A: SAT Solutions sells Pixietech SFP modules in Tashkent, advises on selection, and performs installation of optical lines across Uzbekistan.

- Reach up to 60 km: covers inter-district and suburban routes without active amplifiers
- 17 dB optical budget: an increased margin compensating for losses in multiplexers and long cable
- 3-year warranty: an extended support period important for operator and critical sites
- SFP form factor: installation in standard slots of active equipment without replacing the chassis

## Applications
- Operator CWDM networks: multiplexing channels on an existing fiber pair without laying new cable
- Corporate backbones: increasing network capacity between several remote sites
- Data centers: organizing inter-site data replication channels using CWDM architecture
- Government and departmental networks: secure channels with guaranteed throughput
- Video surveillance and telemetry: transmitting data from remote sites within a single CWDM backbone

en.description:
The SFP CWDM module at a wavelength of 1490 nm with a reach of up to 60 km is designed for organizing multi-channel optical systems with wavelength-division separation. An optical budget of 17 dB allows confident operation on long routes with losses in multiplexers. An extended 3-year warranty underscores the reliability of the solution for operator and corporate sites in Uzbekistan.

## Advantages
- CWDM technology: transmitting several independent channels over a single fiber, optimizing cable infrastructure costs
- 1490 nm wavelength: a standard channel of the CWDM grid, compatible with passive multiplexers
- Reach up to 60 km: sufficient for intercity and suburban routes without intermediate amplifiers
- High 17 dB optical budget: compensates for losses in passive multiplexers, splices, and connectors

- SFP form factor: quick installation and replacement without shutting down the chassis

- CWDM backbones of telecom operators: efficiently increasing the capacity of fiber lines
- Corporate WAN: uniting several sites over a single optical pair

- Transport and industrial sites: reliable communication over long distances with a minimal number of active elements
- Security and video surveillance systems: transmitting video streams from remote perimeters

Q: Can CWDM modules of different wavelengths be mixed in one system?
A: Yes, that is the essence of CWDM: each module operates at its own wavelength, and a passive multiplexer combines all channels into one fiber.

en.name: SFP WDM module, range up to 20km (14dB), 1550nm
en.shortDescription: Pixietech 1550 nm SFP WDM module for a single-fiber channel up to 20 km. Backbone connectivity without laying extra cable. Buy in Tashkent with warranty.
en.description:
The Pixietech SFP WDM module for a 1550 nm wavelength provides optical communication over distances up to 20 km on a single fiber. This is a solution for network engineers and system integrators who need to establish a backbone channel without laying additional cable. WDM technology allows two streams to be transmitted simultaneously over a single strand, reducing infrastructure costs.

## Advantages
- Range up to 20 km: covers distances between buildings and sites without intermediate equipment
- WDM technology: two transmission directions over a single optical fiber, savings on cabling infrastructure
- 14 dB power budget: sufficient margin for operation on real routes accounting for connectors and splices
- 1550 nm wavelength: the standard transparency window of single-mode fiber with minimal loss
- Standard SFP form factor: compatibility with most switches and routers, hot-swappable
- 1-year warranty: confirmed quality from Pixietech

## Applications
- Inter-building connections at industrial enterprises and campus networks
- Establishing communication channels between offices or sites within a city
- Backbone lines in video surveillance and access control systems
- Connecting remote points to the central network node without additional fiber

## FAQ
Q: Do I need to buy two identical modules for a pair to work?
A: No. A WDM pair is built from two modules with different wavelengths: 1310 nm at one end and 1550 nm at the other. This module (1550 nm) should be used in a pair with a 1310 nm module.

Q: Is the module suitable for multimode cable?
A: No, the module is designed for single-mode fiber. For multimode cable, you must choose SX modules at 850 nm.

Q: Is the module compatible with third-party equipment, for example MikroTik or Cisco switches?
A: The module is made in the standard SFP form factor and works with most switches that support this standard. If necessary, check compatibility with a specific model with our specialists.

Qurilma allaqachon tortilgan bir modali tolani imkon qadar samarali ishlatish muhim bo‘lgan tarmoq muhandislari uchun mo‘ljallangan. LC Simplex ulagichi yuqori zichlikdagi krosslar va montaj panellarida ishlashni soddalashtiradi.

## Afzalliklari
- 20 km gacha masofa: qo‘shimcha kuchaytirishsiz aksariyat shahar va obyektlararo trassalarni qamrab oladi
- Bitta tola orqali WDM: kabel va kommutatsiya uskunalarining sarfini ikki barobar qisqartiradi
- LC Simplex ulagichi: yuqori zichlikdagi installyatsiyalar uchun standart, krossda minimal joy
- 14 dB liniya byudjeti: bir nechta ulagichli uzun trassalardagi yo‘qotishlarni qoplash imkonini beradi
- 1550 nm to‘lqin uzunligi: to‘liq dupleks kanal hosil qilish uchun 1310 nm WDM-juftligi bilan mos
- Ishlab chiqaruvchining 1 yillik kafolati: uskuna ishonchliligiga ishonch

## Qo‘llanish sohalari
- Tarqoq joylashgan tugunlar o‘rtasidagi korporativ tarmoqlarning magistral liniyalari
- Uzoq videoserverlar yoki NVR ga ega videokuzatuv tizimlari
- Kirishni boshqarish va qo‘riqlash tizimlaridagi ma'lumot uzatish kanallari
- Kabel sig‘imini tejashni talab qiladigan telekommunikatsiya tugunlari

## FAQ
Q: Bu modul LC suffiksiz versiyadan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?
A: Ulanish ulagichi bilan: ushbu modifikatsiya LC Simplex dan foydalanadi, suffiksiz versiya esa boshqa turdagi ulagichga ega bo‘lishi mumkin. Krossingizdagi patch-kord va adapterlar LC standartiga mos kelishiga ishonch hosil qiling.

Q: Modulni mustaqil yechim sifatida ishlatish mumkinmi?
A: Modul faqat liniyaning uzoq uchidagi 1310 nm to‘lqin uzunligidagi boshqa WDM-transiver bilan juftlikda ishlaydi. Mustaqil ravishda (juftliksiz) ma'lumot uzatish mumkin emas.

Q: Modul faqat dual-fiber SFP ni qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi kommutatorlar uchun mos keladimi?
A: Kommutator porti Simplex SFP yoki WDM SFP ni qo‘llab-quvvatlashi kerak. Oddiy Duplex-portlar tegishli adapterlarni talab qiladi. Moslikni texnik bo‘limimizdan aniqlang.

en.name: SFP WDM module, range up to 20km (14dB), LC Simplex, 1550nm
en.shortDescription: Pixietech 1550 nm SFP WDM module with an LC Simplex connector, range up to 20 km over a single fiber. Efficient use of the single-mode line. In stock in Tashkent.
en.description:
The Pixietech SFP WDM module at 1550 nm with an LC Simplex connector is a compact transceiver for building single-fiber optical channels up to 20 km long. The device is intended for network engineers for whom it is important to use already-laid single-mode fiber as efficiently as possible. The LC Simplex connector simplifies work in high-density patch panels and installation panels.

## Advantages
- Range up to 20 km: covers most urban and inter-site routes without additional amplification
- WDM over a single fiber: halves the consumption of cable and switching equipment
- LC Simplex connector: a standard for high-density installations, minimal space in the patch panel
- 14 dB line budget: allows compensation for losses on long routes with several connectors
- 1550 nm wavelength: compatible with a 1310 nm WDM pair to form a full duplex channel
- 1-year manufacturer warranty: confidence in equipment reliability

## Applications
- Backbone lines of corporate networks between distributed nodes
- Video surveillance systems with remote video servers or NVRs
- Data transmission channels in access control and security systems
- Telecommunication nodes requiring savings in cable capacity

## FAQ
Q: How does this module differ from the version without the LC suffix?
A: By the connection connector: this modification uses LC Simplex, whereas the version without the suffix may have a different connector type. Make sure the patch cord and adapters in your patch panel conform to the LC standard.

Q: Can the module be used as a standalone solution?
A: The module works only in a pair with another WDM transceiver at a 1310 nm wavelength at the far end of the line. On its own (without a pair), data transmission is not possible.

Q: Is the module suitable for switches that support only dual-fiber SFP?
A: The switch port must support Simplex SFP or WDM SFP. Ordinary duplex ports require appropriate adapters. Check compatibility with our technical department.

tr.name: SFP WDM modülü, mesafe 20km'ye kadar (14dB), LC Simplex, 1550nm
tr.shortDescription: Pixietech 1550 nm SFP WDM modülü, LC Simplex konektörlü, tek fiber üzerinden 20 km'ye kadar mesafe. Tek mod hattının verimli kullanımı. Taşkent'te stokta.
tr.description:
LC Simplex konektörlü 1550 nm Pixietech SFP WDM modülü, 20 km'ye kadar uzunlukta tek fiberli optik kanallar oluşturmak için kompakt bir alıcı-vericidir. Cihaz, halihazırda döşenmiş tek modlu fiberi mümkün olduğunca verimli kullanmanın önemli olduğu ağ mühendisleri için tasarlanmıştır. LC Simplex konektör, yüksek yoğunluklu kroslarda ve kurulum panellerinde çalışmayı kolaylaştırır.

## Avantajlar
- 20 km'ye kadar menzil: ek yükseltme olmadan çoğu kentsel ve tesisler arası hattı kapsar
- Tek fiber üzerinden WDM: kablo ve anahtarlama ekipmanı tüketimini yarıya indirir
- LC Simplex konektör: yüksek yoğunluklu kurulumlar için standart, kros içinde minimum yer
- 14 dB hat bütçesi: birkaç konektörlü uzun hatlardaki kayıpları telafi etmeyi sağlar
- 1550 nm dalga boyu: tam dupleks kanal oluşturmak için 1310 nm WDM çiftiyle uyumlu
- 1 yıl üretici garantisi: ekipman güvenilirliğine güven

## Uygulama Alanları
- Dağıtık düğümler arasında kurumsal ağların omurga hatları
- Uzak video sunucuları veya NVR'ları olan video gözetim sistemleri
- Erişim kontrol ve güvenlik sistemlerinde veri iletim kanalları
- Kablo kapasitesinde tasarruf gerektiren telekomünikasyon düğümleri

## FAQ
Q: Bu modül LC son eki olmayan sürümden nasıl farklıdır?
A: Bağlantı konektörüyle: bu modifikasyon LC Simplex kullanırken, son eki olmayan sürüm farklı bir konektör tipine sahip olabilir. Krosunuzdaki patch kablonun ve adaptörlerin LC standardına uyduğundan emin olun.

Q: Modül bağımsız bir çözüm olarak kullanılabilir mi?
A: Modül yalnızca hattın uzak ucunda 1310 nm dalga boyundaki başka bir WDM alıcı-vericiyle çift olarak çalışır. Tek başına (çift olmadan) veri iletimi mümkün değildir.

Q: Modül yalnızca dual-fiber SFP'yi destekleyen anahtarlar için uygun mu?
A: Anahtar portu Simplex SFP veya WDM SFP'yi desteklemelidir. Sıradan dupleks portlar uygun adaptörler gerektirir. Uyumluluğu teknik departmanımızla kontrol edin.

zh.name: SFP WDM 模块，距离达 20km (14dB)，LC Simplex，1550nm
zh.shortDescription: Pixietech 1550 nm SFP WDM 模块，LC Simplex 接口，单纤上距离达 20 km。高效利用单模线路。塔什干现货。
zh.description:
带 LC Simplex 接口的 1550 nm Pixietech SFP WDM 模块是一款用于构建长达 20 km 单纤光通道的紧凑型收发器。该设备面向网络工程师，对他们而言尽可能高效地利用已铺设的单模光纤十分重要。LC Simplex 接口简化了在高密度配线架和安装面板中的操作。

## 优势
- 传输距离可达 20 km：无需额外放大即可覆盖大多数城市和站点间线路
- 单纤 WDM：将线缆和交换设备的用量减半
- LC Simplex 接口：高密度安装的标准，在配线架中占用空间最小
- 14 dB 线路预算：可补偿带多个连接器的长线路上的损耗
- 1550 nm 波长：与 1310 nm WDM 配对兼容，构成全双工通道
- 1 年厂商质保：对设备可靠性的信心

## 应用领域
- 分布式节点之间的企业网络骨干线路
- 带远程视频服务器或 NVR 的视频监控系统
- 门禁和安防系统中的数据传输通道
- 需要节省线缆容量的电信节点

## FAQ
Q: 该模块与不带 LC 后缀的版本有何区别？
A: 区别在于连接接口：此型号使用 LC Simplex，而不带后缀的版本可能采用其他类型的接口。请确保配线架中的跳线和适配器符合 LC 标准。

Q: 该模块可以作为独立解决方案使用吗？
A: 该模块仅能与线路远端 1310 nm 波长的另一个 WDM 收发器配对工作。单独使用（无配对）无法传输数据。

Q: 该模块适用于仅支持双纤 SFP 的交换机吗？
A: 交换机端口必须支持 Simplex SFP 或 WDM SFP。普通双工端口需要相应的适配器。请向我们的技术部门确认兼容性。

uz.name: SFP WDM moduli, masofa 3km gacha (6dB), 1310nm
uz.shortDescription: Pixietech 1310 nm SFP WDM moduli, masofa 3 km gacha, 6 dB byudjet, obyekt ichidagi qisqa bir tolali liniyalar uchun. Tejamkor yechim, O‘zbekiston bo‘ylab yetkazib berish.
uz.description:
3 km gacha masofaga ega 1310 nm dagi Pixietech SFP WDM-moduli — bitta obyekt ichida yoki qo‘shni binolar o‘rtasidagi qisqa bir tolali optik liniyalar uchun tejamkor yechim. Qurilma mavjud bir modali tola orqali, qo‘shimcha kabel tortmasdan ma'lumot uzatishni xohlovchi tashkilotlar uchun mos keladi. Ixcham SFP form-faktori barcha zamonaviy aktiv uskunalar bilan moslikni ta'minlaydi.

## Afzalliklari
- 3 km gacha masofa: bitta obyektdagi ichki va binolararo trassalar uchun optimal
- Bitta tola orqali uzatish: WDM texnologiyasi kabel infratuzilmasiga xarajatlarni ikki barobar kamaytiradi
- 6 dB quvvat byudjeti: oz sonli ulagichli trassalar uchun yetarli
- 1310 nm to‘lqin uzunligi: to‘liq dupleks uchun 1550 nm modul bilan juftlikda ishlaydi
- Standart SFP: issiq almashtirish, keng doiradagi kommutatorlarni qo‘llab-quvvatlash
- 1 yil kafolat: Pixietech tomonidan tasdiqlangan sifat

## Qo‘llanish sohalari
- Bitta korxona doirasidagi binolar va qavatlar o‘rtasidagi aloqa
- Savdo markazlari, mehmonxonalar va biznes-markazlar ichidagi optik liniyalar
- IP-videokuzatuv tizimlaridagi uzoq kommutatorlarni ulash
- Kampus doirasidagi serverlar va kommunikatsiya tugunlarini ulash

## FAQ
Q: Nima uchun quvvat byudjeti 20 km lik modullardan kamroq?
A: Qisqa trassalar uchun yuqori byudjet ortiqcha va qimmatlashishiga olib keladi. 6 dB byudjet odatiy ulagichlardagi yo‘qotishlarni hisobga olgan holda 3 km gacha trassalar uchun mutlaqo yetarli.

Q: Bu modulni bitta o‘rniga ikkita tola bilan ishlatishim mumkinmi?
A: Yo‘q, WDM-modul aynan 1550 nm transiver bilan juftlikda bitta tola orqali ishlashga mo‘ljallangan. Ikkita tola bo‘yicha ishlash uchun standart dupleks SFP-modullari mos keladi.

Q: LC ulagichli versiyasi bormi?
A: Ha, LC Simplex ulagichli modifikatsiya PXT-SFP-W35-3-LC artikuli ostida mavjud. Mavjudligini SAT Solutions menejerlaridan aniqlang.

en.name: SFP WDM module, range up to 3km (6dB), 1310nm
en.shortDescription: Pixietech 1310 nm SFP WDM module, range up to 3 km, 6 dB budget for short single-fiber lines within a facility. A cost-effective solution, delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
The Pixietech SFP WDM module at 1310 nm with a range of up to 3 km is an economical solution for short single-fiber optical lines within a single site or between neighboring buildings. The device is suitable for organizations that want to transmit data over existing single-mode fiber without laying additional cable. The compact SFP form factor ensures compatibility with all modern active equipment.

## Advantages
- Range up to 3 km: optimal for internal and inter-building routes at a single site
- Transmission over a single fiber: WDM technology halves cabling infrastructure costs
- 6 dB power budget: sufficient for routes with a small number of connectors
- 1310 nm wavelength: works in a pair with a 1550 nm module for full duplex
- Standard SFP: hot-swappable, support for a wide range of switches
- 1-year warranty: confirmed Pixietech quality

## Applications
- Communication between buildings and floors within a single enterprise
- Optical lines inside shopping malls, hotels, and business centers
- Connecting remote switches in IP video surveillance systems
- Connecting server and communication nodes within a campus

## FAQ
Q: Why is the power budget lower than that of the 20 km modules?
A: For short routes, a high budget is excessive and leads to higher costs. A 6 dB budget is quite sufficient for routes up to 3 km, accounting for losses at typical connectors.

Q: Can I use this module with two fibers instead of one?
A: No, the WDM module is designed specifically to work over a single fiber in a pair with a 1550 nm transceiver. For operation over two fibers, standard duplex SFP modules are suitable.

Q: Is there a version with an LC connector?
A: Yes, a modification with an LC Simplex connector is available under part number PXT-SFP-W35-3-LC. Check availability with SAT Solutions managers.

tr.name: SFP WDM modülü, mesafe 3km'ye kadar (6dB), 1310nm
tr.shortDescription: Pixietech 1310 nm SFP WDM modülü, 3 km'ye kadar mesafe, 6 dB bütçe, tesis içindeki kısa tek fiber hatları için. Ekonomik çözüm, Özbekistan genelinde teslimat.
tr.description:
3 km'ye kadar menzile sahip 1310 nm Pixietech SFP WDM modülü, tek bir tesis içinde veya komşu binalar arasında kısa tek fiberli optik hatlar için ekonomik bir çözümdür. Cihaz, ek kablo döşemeden mevcut tek modlu fiber üzerinden veri iletmek isteyen kuruluşlar için uygundur. Kompakt SFP form faktörü, tüm modern aktif ekipmanlarla uyumluluk sağlar.

## Avantajlar
- 3 km'ye kadar menzil: tek bir tesiste iç ve binalar arası hatlar için optimal
- Tek fiber üzerinden iletim: WDM teknolojisi kablo altyapısı maliyetlerini yarıya indirir
- 6 dB güç bütçesi: az sayıda konektörlü hatlar için yeterli
- 1310 nm dalga boyu: tam dupleks için 1550 nm modülle çift olarak çalışır
- Standart SFP: çalışırken değiştirilebilir, çok çeşitli anahtarlar için destek
- 1 yıl garanti: onaylanmış Pixietech kalitesi

## Uygulama Alanları
- Tek bir işletme içinde binalar ve katlar arası iletişim
- Alışveriş merkezleri, oteller ve iş merkezleri içindeki optik hatlar
- IP video gözetim sistemlerinde uzak anahtarların bağlanması
- Bir kampüs içinde sunucu ve iletişim düğümlerinin bağlanması

## FAQ
Q: Güç bütçesi neden 20 km'lik modüllerden daha düşük?
A: Kısa hatlar için yüksek bir bütçe gereksizdir ve maliyetin artmasına yol açar. 6 dB bütçe, tipik konektörlerdeki kayıplar dikkate alındığında 3 km'ye kadar hatlar için oldukça yeterlidir.

Q: Bu modülü bir yerine iki fiberle kullanabilir miyim?
A: Hayır, WDM modülü özellikle bir 1550 nm alıcı-vericiyle çift halinde tek fiber üzerinden çalışmak için tasarlanmıştır. İki fiber üzerinden çalışma için standart dupleks SFP modülleri uygundur.

Q: LC konektörlü bir sürümü var mı?
A: Evet, LC Simplex konektörlü bir modifikasyon PXT-SFP-W35-3-LC parça numarasıyla mevcuttur. Stok durumunu SAT Solutions yöneticileriyle kontrol edin.

zh.name: SFP WDM 模块，距离达 3km (6dB)，1310nm
zh.shortDescription: Pixietech 1310 nm SFP WDM 模块，距离达 3 km，6 dB 链路预算，用于设施内的短距单纤线路。经济实惠的解决方案，乌兹别克斯坦全境配送。
zh.description:
传输距离可达 3 km 的 1310 nm Pixietech SFP WDM 模块是单个站点内部或相邻楼宇之间短距离单纤光线路的经济型解决方案。该设备适用于希望通过现有单模光纤传输数据而无需铺设额外线缆的机构。紧凑的 SFP 封装确保与所有现代有源设备兼容。

## 优势
- 传输距离可达 3 km：最适合单个站点的内部和楼宇间线路
- 单纤传输：WDM 技术将布线基础设施成本减半
- 6 dB 功率预算：足以应对连接器数量较少的线路
- 1310 nm 波长：与 1550 nm 模块配对工作以实现全双工
- 标准 SFP：支持热插拔，兼容多种交换机
- 1 年质保：Pixietech 确认的品质

## 应用领域
- 单个企业内部楼宇和楼层之间的通信
- 购物中心、酒店和商务中心内部的光线路
- 在 IP 视频监控系统中连接远程交换机
- 在园区内连接服务器和通信节点

## FAQ
Q: 为什么功率预算低于 20 km 模块？
A: 对于短距离线路，高预算是多余的，会导致成本上升。考虑到典型连接器的损耗，6 dB 预算对于 3 km 以内的线路完全足够。

Q: 我可以用两根光纤而不是一根来使用该模块吗？
A: 不可以，WDM 模块专为与 1550 nm 收发器配对、通过单根光纤工作而设计。若要通过两根光纤工作，标准双工 SFP 模块更为适用。

Q: 有带 LC 接口的版本吗？
A: 有，带 LC Simplex 接口的型号以货号 PXT-SFP-W35-3-LC 提供。请向 SAT Solutions 经理确认库存情况。

## Qo‘llanish sohalari

en.name: SFP WDM module, range up to 3km (6dB), 1550nm
en.shortDescription: Pixietech 1550 nm SFP WDM module, range up to 3 km over a single fiber for channels within a facility or between buildings. Delivery across Uzbekistan, warranty from SAT.
en.description:
The Pixietech SFP WDM module at 1550 nm with a range of up to 3 km is designed for establishing short single-fiber optical channels within a single site or neighboring buildings. It forms a working pair together with a 1310 nm module, providing a full duplex channel over a single fiber without additional cable costs. The standard SFP form factor guarantees compatibility with a wide range of network equipment.

## Advantages
- Range up to 3 km: covers on-site and inter-building routes without amplifiers
- WDM over a single fiber: savings on cable capacity and switching equipment
- 6 dB budget: optimal for short routes with minimal losses
- 1550 nm wavelength: compatible with the partner 1310 nm module for duplex
- SFP form factor: support for hot-swapping, compatibility with most switches
- 1-year manufacturer warranty: Pixietech reliability

## Applications
- Local optical networks at industrial sites and enterprises
- Video surveillance systems with IP cameras at distant areas of the site
- Connecting communication cabinets within a single building or complex

## FAQ
Q: Which module should be installed at the opposite end of the line?

Q: Is the module suitable for multimode fiber?

Q: Can the modules be bought in Uzbekistan with fast delivery?
A: Yes, SAT Solutions supplies Pixietech SFP modules across Tashkent and the whole country. Contact our managers to clarify availability and timing.

en.description:
The Pixietech SFP WDM module at 1550 nm with an LC Simplex connector is a compact transceiver for single-fiber optical lines with a range of up to 3 km. The device is aimed at engineers and integrators who need to deploy a high-speed communication channel within a single site or between neighboring buildings without spending resources on additional cable. LC Simplex provides convenient and compact installation in mounting cabinets.

## Advantages
- Range up to 3 km: solves the tasks of on-site and nearby inter-building optical channels
- Operation over a single fiber: WDM allows halving the number of fibers used
- LC Simplex connector: minimal dimensions, simplified connection in a crowded patch panel
- 6 dB line budget: sufficient for short routes with a small number of splices and connectors
- 1550 nm wavelength: paired with the 1310 nm module to establish duplex
- 1-year warranty: Pixietech quality standard

## Applications
- Local optical networks in commercial, administrative, and industrial buildings
- IP video surveillance with optical connection of switches at remote areas
- Data transmission channels in fire safety and security systems
- Redundancy of communication channels between neighboring network nodes

## FAQ
Q: Why does this module have a 1550 nm wavelength and not 1310 nm?
A: The WDM system works on the principle of wavelength separation: one end of the line transmits at 1310 nm and receives at 1550 nm, the other the opposite. This module is installed where transmission at 1550 nm is needed.

Q: Is there a risk of mixing up the pair during installation?
A: If both ends of the line are equipped with modules of the same wavelength, the connection will not be established. Always check that one end has 1310 nm and the other 1550 nm.

Q: Does SAT Solutions supply modules with patch cords included?
A: Patch cords and modules can be ordered as a set. Check availability and configuration with the company's managers.

en.name: SFP WDM module, range up to 40km (21dB), 1310nm
en.shortDescription: Pixietech 1310 nm SFP WDM module, range up to 40 km, 21 dB budget for long single-fiber channels between facilities. For operators, in stock in Tashkent.
en.description:
The Pixietech SFP WDM module at 1310 nm with a range of up to 40 km is designed for building long single-fiber optical channels between remote sites. This solution is in demand among communication operators, large enterprises, and urban infrastructure projects where network nodes need to be connected over significant distances via existing single-mode fiber. The high 21 dB power budget ensures stable operation even on routes with appreciable losses.

## Advantages
- Range up to 40 km: covers distances between city districts or remote production sites
- 21 dB power budget: a large margin to compensate for losses on long routes with numerous connectors
- WDM over a single fiber: efficient use of cable capacity without laying additional cable
- 1310 nm wavelength: paired with a 1550 nm module, forms a full duplex channel
- Standard SFP: hot-swappable, broad compatibility with active equipment
- 1-year warranty: factory Pixietech quality

## Applications
- Backbone communication channels between city districts and remote sites
- Connecting production enterprises to central offices over already-laid cables
- Establishing backup channels in critically important security networks
- Communication operator transport networks with long fiber routes

## FAQ
Q: What determines the range of exactly 40 km?
A: The range is determined by the module's power budget (21 dB) and the typical attenuation of single-mode fiber. On real routes, the final distance depends on cable quality and the number of splices and connectors.

Q: Which module is installed at the other end of a 40 km route?
A: The partner module PXT-SFP-W53-40 with a 1550 nm wavelength. Together with this module, it forms a working WDM pair for duplex transmission.

Q: Is an amplifier needed for a route up to 40 km?
A: When using quality single-mode fiber and observing loss norms, an amplifier is not required. If the 21 dB budget is exceeded, coordination with technical specialists will be required.

- 21 dB güç bütçesi: çok sayıda konektörlü uzun hatlardaki kayıpları telafi etmek için büyük bir marj
- Tek fiber üzerinden WDM: ek kablo döşemeden kablo kapasitesinin verimli kullanımı
- 1310 nm dalga boyu: 1550 nm modülle eşleştirilir, tam dupleks kanal oluşturur
- Standart SFP: çalışırken değiştirilebilir, aktif ekipmanla geniş uyumluluk

## Uygulama Alanları

Q: Menzilin tam olarak 40 km olmasını ne belirler?
A: Menzil, modülün güç bütçesi (21 dB) ve tek modlu fiberin tipik zayıflamasıyla belirlenir. Gerçek hatlarda nihai mesafe, kablo kalitesine ve ek yeri ile konektör sayısına bağlıdır.

A: Kaliteli tek modlu fiber kullanıldığında ve kayıp normlarına uyulduğunda yükseltici gerekmez. 21 dB bütçe aşılırsa teknik uzmanlarla koordinasyon gerekecektir.

en.name: SFP WDM module, range up to 40km (21dB), 1550nm
en.shortDescription: Pixietech 1550 nm SFP WDM module, range up to 40 km and a 21 dB budget for long single-fiber lines between remote network nodes. Delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
The Pixietech SFP WDM module at 1550 nm with a range of up to 40 km is a transceiver for long single-fiber optical lines connecting remote network nodes. The device is aimed at communication operators, system integrators, and large organizations with distributed sites. The high 21 dB power budget guarantees reliable operation on long routes with real infrastructure losses.

## Advantages
- Range up to 40 km: connects sites separated by significant distances without intermediate amplification
- 21 dB budget: compensates for losses on long routes with several splices and patch panels
- WDM over a single fiber: halves the use of cable capacity in backbone networks
- 1550 nm wavelength: paired with a 1310 nm module to build a duplex channel
- SFP form factor: supports hot-swapping, suitable for most switches and routers
- 1-year warranty: Pixietech reliability standard

## Applications
- Inter-district and suburban backbone lines in urban networks
- Channels between production enterprises and administrative centers
- Video surveillance and security systems with long optical lines
- Transport networks connecting remote sites without relaying

## FAQ
Q: Which module does this 1550 nm version work with as a pair?
A: With the PXT-SFP-W35-40 module at a 1310 nm wavelength. Together they form a WDM pair for duplex data transmission over a single fiber up to 40 km.

Q: How can I make sure the route fits within the 21 dB budget?
A: You need to take optical measurements (OTDR reflectometry) or calculate the sum of losses: cable attenuation, splices, and connectors. SAT Solutions specialists can help with the calculation and route verification.

Q: Does the module support operation when using a WDM multiplexer?
A: WDM multiplexers are used for CWDM/DWDM schemes with several wavelengths. This module is intended for a simple WDM pair. Check compatibility with SAT Solutions technical specialists.

en.name: SFP WDM module, range up to 80km (24dB), 1490/1550nm
en.shortDescription: Pixietech 1490/1550 nm SFP WDM module, range up to 80 km over a single fiber for carrier backbone networks. In stock, delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
The Pixietech SFP WDM module at 1490/1550 nm wavelengths with a range of up to 80 km is a solution for establishing ultra-long single-fiber optical channels in backbone and regional networks. The device is intended for communication operators and large infrastructure projects where sites need to be connected over tens of kilometers without intermediate amplifiers. The 24 dB power budget ensures stable operation even on routes with significant losses.

## Advantages
- Range up to 80 km: covers regional distances without amplifiers and intermediate nodes
- 24 dB budget: a high margin to compensate for the total losses of long routes
- WDM over a single fiber: maximally efficient use of limited cable capacity
- Dual wavelength 1490/1550 nm: works in a paired scheme with a 1550/1490 nm module
- Standard SFP form factor: compatibility with a wide range of professional active equipment
- 1-year manufacturer warranty: confirmed Pixietech quality

## Applications
- Intercity and regional optical backbones
- Connecting remote energy, transport infrastructure, and industrial sites
- Transport networks of communication operators with long fiber-optic routes
- Backup and primary channels in critically important security systems

## FAQ
Q: What does the 1490/1550 nm designation mean for this module?
A: These are the transmitting and receiving wavelengths. The module transmits at 1490 nm and receives at 1550 nm; its partner (PXT-SFP-W54-80) works in mirror mode, forming a duplex pair.

Q: Is a signal amplifier needed when used at 80 km?
A: On routes with total losses within 24 dB, an amplifier is not required. If the budget is exceeded or old fiber with high attenuation is used, a preliminary OTDR survey of the route will be required.

Q: Is this module used in CWDM systems?
A: No, this module is intended for a simple WDM pair (BiDi). For CWDM systems with several channels, specialized equipment with other wavelengths per the ITU-T G.694.2 standard is used.

tr.description:
1490/1550 nm dalga boylarında ve 80 km'ye kadar menzile sahip Pixietech SFP WDM modülü, omurga ve bölgesel ağlarda ultra uzun tek fiberli optik kanallar oluşturmak için bir çözümdür. Cihaz, tesislerin ara yükselticiler olmadan onlarca kilometre boyunca bağlanması gereken iletişim operatörleri ve büyük altyapı projeleri için tasarlanmıştır. 24 dB güç bütçesi, önemli kayıplara sahip hatlarda bile kararlı çalışma sağlar.

## Avantajlar
- 80 km'ye kadar menzil: yükselticiler ve ara düğümler olmadan bölgesel mesafeleri kapsar
- 24 dB bütçe: uzun hatların toplam kayıplarını telafi etmek için yüksek bir marj
- Tek fiber üzerinden WDM: sınırlı kablo kapasitesinin maksimum verimli kullanımı
- Çift dalga boyu 1490/1550 nm: 1550/1490 nm modülle eşli bir şemada çalışır
- Standart SFP form faktörü: çok çeşitli profesyonel aktif ekipmanla uyumluluk
- 1 yıl üretici garantisi: onaylanmış Pixietech kalitesi

## Uygulama Alanları
- Şehirlerarası ve bölgesel optik omurgalar
- Uzak enerji, ulaşım altyapısı ve endüstriyel tesislerin bağlanması
- Uzun fiber optik hatlara sahip iletişim operatörlerinin taşıma ağları
- Kritik öneme sahip güvenlik sistemlerinde yedek ve birincil kanallar

## FAQ
Q: Bu modül için 1490/1550 nm gösterimi ne anlama gelir?
A: Bunlar gönderme ve alma dalga boylarıdır. Modül 1490 nm'de gönderir ve 1550 nm'de alır; partneri (PXT-SFP-W54-80) ayna modunda çalışarak bir dupleks çift oluşturur.

Q: 80 km'de kullanıldığında sinyal yükselticisi gerekli mi?
A: Toplam kayıpları 24 dB içinde olan hatlarda yükseltici gerekmez. Bütçe aşılırsa veya yüksek zayıflamalı eski fiber kullanılırsa, hattın önceden OTDR incelemesi gerekecektir.

Q: Bu modül CWDM sistemlerinde kullanılır mı?
A: Hayır, bu modül basit bir WDM çifti (BiDi) için tasarlanmıştır. Birkaç kanallı CWDM sistemleri için ITU-T G.694.2 standardına göre farklı dalga boylarına sahip özel ekipman kullanılır.

zh.name: SFP WDM 模块，距离达 80km (24dB)，1490/1550nm

zh.description:
波长为 1490/1550 nm、传输距离可达 80 km 的 Pixietech SFP WDM 模块是在骨干网和区域网络中构建超长距离单纤光通道的解决方案。该设备适用于需要在数十公里范围内无需中间放大器连接站点的通信运营商和大型基础设施项目。24 dB 功率预算确保即使在损耗较大的线路上也能稳定运行。

## 优势
- 传输距离可达 80 km：无需放大器和中间节点即可覆盖区域距离
- 24 dB 预算：补偿长线路总损耗的高余量
- 单纤 WDM：最大限度高效利用有限的线缆容量
- 双波长 1490/1550 nm：与 1550/1490 nm 模块在配对方案中工作
- 标准 SFP 封装：兼容多种专业有源设备
- 1 年厂商质保：Pixietech 确认的品质

## 应用领域
- 城际和区域光骨干
- 连接远程能源、交通基础设施和工业站点
- 具有长光缆线路的通信运营商传输网络
- 关键安防系统中的备用和主用通道

## FAQ
Q: 该模块的 1490/1550 nm 标识是什么意思？
A: 这是发送和接收波长。该模块在 1490 nm 发送、在 1550 nm 接收；其配对模块（PXT-SFP-W54-80）以镜像模式工作，构成双工配对。

Q: 在 80 km 使用时需要信号放大器吗？
A: 在总损耗不超过 24 dB 的线路上无需放大器。若超出预算或使用衰减较高的旧光纤，则需要事先对线路进行 OTDR 勘测。

Q: 该模块用于 CWDM 系统吗？
A: 不用，该模块用于简单的 WDM 配对（BiDi）。对于多通道的 CWDM 系统，需使用符合 ITU-T G.694.2 标准、采用其他波长的专用设备。

uz.name: SFP WDM moduli, masofa 80km gacha (24dB), 1550/1490nm
uz.shortDescription: Pixietech 1550/1490 nm SFP WDM moduli, bitta tola bo‘ylab 80 km gacha masofa, dupleks BiDi kanal uchun juft transiver. Toshkentda sotib oling, mavjud.
uz.description:
1550/1490 nm to‘lqin uzunliklaridagi va 80 km gacha masofaga ega Pixietech SFP WDM-moduli — o‘ta uzun bir tolali optik kanallarni tashkil etish uchun sherik transiver. 1490/1550 nm modul bilan juftlikda u bitta tola orqali 80 km gacha uzunlikdagi to‘liq dupleks kanalni hosil qiladi. Yechim magistral trassalarda, mintaqaviy telekommunikatsiya tarmoqlarida va yirik infratuzilma obyektlarida talab qilinadi.

## Afzalliklari
- 80 km gacha masofa: oraliq kuchaytirgichlarsiz shaharlararo trassalar uchun mos
- 24 dB byudjet: uzun va murakkab trassalardagi yo‘qotishlarni qoplash uchun katta zaxira
- Bitta tola orqali ishlash: WDM jalb qilingan tolalar sonini ikki barobar qisqartiradi
- 1550/1490 nm to‘lqin uzunligi: dupleks uchun PXT-SFP-W45-80 sherik moduliga ko‘zgu
- Standart SFP: issiq almashtirish, professional tarmoq uskunasini qo‘llab-quvvatlash
- 1 yil kafolat: Pixietech sifati

## Qo‘llanish sohalari
- Shaharlar va tumanlar o‘rtasidagi magistral optik liniyalar
- Energetika, neft-gaz va transport infratuzilmasi obyektlaridagi ma'lumot uzatish tarmoqlari
- Uzun obyektlardagi uzoq videokuzatuv va telemetriya kanallari
- Uzun tolali trassalarga ega aloqa operatorlarining transport tarmoqlari

## FAQ
Q: PXT-SFP-W54-80 ga qaysi modul juft hisoblanadi?
A: Juft modul — 1490/1550 nm to‘lqin uzunliklaridagi PXT-SFP-W45-80. Birgalikda ular bitta tola orqali 80 km gacha masofada dupleks uzatish uchun WDM-juftligini hosil qiladi.

Q: 80 km trassa 24 dB byudjetga sig‘ishini qanday tekshirish mumkin?
A: Yo‘qotish byudjetini hisoblash (tola so‘nishi × uzunlik + payvand va ulagichlardagi yo‘qotishlar) yoki trassani OTDR-o‘lchash kerak. SAT Solutions mutaxassislari buni uskuna xarididan oldin bajarishlari mumkin.

Q: Ikkala juft modulni komplektda sotib olish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, SAT Solutions mijoz so‘roviga ko‘ra WDM-juftliklarni komplektda yetkazib beradi. Bu buyurtmani soddalashtiradi va trassaning ikkala uchidagi uskunalarning mosligini kafolatlaydi.

en.name: SFP WDM module, range up to 80km (24dB), 1550/1490nm
en.shortDescription: Pixietech 1550/1490 nm SFP WDM module, range up to 80 km over a single fiber, a paired transceiver for a duplex BiDi channel. Buy in Tashkent, in stock.
en.description:
The Pixietech SFP WDM module at 1550/1490 nm wavelengths with a range of up to 80 km is a partner transceiver for establishing ultra-long single-fiber optical channels. Paired with a 1490/1550 nm module, it forms a full duplex channel up to 80 km long over a single fiber. The solution is in demand on backbone routes, in regional telecommunication networks, and at large infrastructure sites.

## Advantages
- Range up to 80 km: suitable for intercity routes without intermediate amplifiers
- 24 dB budget: a large margin to compensate for losses on long and complex routes
- Operation over a single fiber: WDM halves the number of fibers used
- 1550/1490 nm wavelength: mirror to the partner module PXT-SFP-W45-80 for duplex
- Standard SFP: hot-swapping, support for professional network equipment
- 1-year warranty: Pixietech quality

## Applications
- Backbone optical lines between cities and districts
- Data transmission networks at energy, oil-and-gas, and transport infrastructure sites
- Long video surveillance and telemetry channels at extended sites
- Transport networks of communication operators with long fiber routes

## FAQ
Q: Which module is the pair for PXT-SFP-W54-80?
A: The pair module is PXT-SFP-W45-80 with wavelengths of 1490/1550 nm. Together they form a WDM pair for duplex transmission over a single fiber up to 80 km.

Q: How can I verify that an 80 km route fits within the 24 dB budget?
A: It is necessary to calculate the loss budget (fiber attenuation × length + losses at splices and connectors) or to take an OTDR measurement of the route. SAT Solutions specialists can do this before purchasing equipment.

Q: Can both pair modules be bought as a set?
A: Yes, SAT Solutions supplies WDM pairs as a set on customer request. This simplifies ordering and guarantees equipment compatibility at both ends of the route.

## Avantajlar
- 80 km'ye kadar menzil: ara yükselticiler olmadan şehirlerarası hatlar için uygun
- 24 dB bütçe: uzun ve karmaşık hatlardaki kayıpları telafi etmek için büyük bir marj
- Tek fiber üzerinden çalışma: WDM kullanılan fiber sayısını yarıya indirir
- 1550/1490 nm dalga boyu: dupleks için partner modül PXT-SFP-W45-80'e ayna
- Standart SFP: çalışırken değiştirme, profesyonel ağ ekipmanı desteği
- 1 yıl garanti: Pixietech kalitesi

## Uygulama Alanları
- Şehirler ve bölgeler arası omurga optik hatlar
- Enerji, petrol-gaz ve ulaşım altyapısı tesislerinde veri iletim ağları
- Uzun tesislerde uzak video gözetim ve telemetri kanalları
- Uzun fiber hatlarına sahip iletişim operatörlerinin taşıma ağları

## FAQ
Q: PXT-SFP-W54-80'in eşi hangi modüldür?
A: Eş modül, 1490/1550 nm dalga boylarına sahip PXT-SFP-W45-80'dir. Birlikte tek fiber üzerinden 80 km'ye kadar dupleks iletim için bir WDM çifti oluştururlar.

Q: 80 km'lik bir hattın 24 dB bütçeye sığdığını nasıl doğrulayabilirim?
A: Kayıp bütçesini hesaplamak (fiber zayıflaması × uzunluk + ek yerleri ve konektörlerdeki kayıplar) veya hattın OTDR ölçümünü yapmak gerekir. SAT Solutions uzmanları bunu ekipman satın almadan önce yapabilir.

Q: Her iki eş modül set olarak satın alınabilir mi?
A: Evet, SAT Solutions müşteri talebi üzerine WDM çiftlerini set olarak tedarik eder. Bu, siparişi basitleştirir ve hattın her iki ucundaki ekipman uyumluluğunu garanti eder.

## 优势
- 传输距离可达 80 km：适用于无需中间放大器的城际线路
- 24 dB 预算：补偿长距离复杂线路损耗的大余量
- 单纤工作：WDM 将所用光纤数量减半

## FAQ
Q: PXT-SFP-W54-80 的配对模块是哪个？

Q: 如何验证 80 km 线路符合 24 dB 预算？

uz.shortDescription: Pixietech SX 850 nm SFP moduli, ko‘p modli tola bo‘ylab 550 m gacha masofa, binolar va ma'lumotlar markazlaridagi qisqa liniyalar uchun. Kommutatorlarni ulash, Toshkentda mavjud.

- 550 m gacha masofa: serverxonalar va qavat shkaflari o‘rtasidagi barcha odatiy obyekt ichidagi trassalarni qamrab oladi
- 850 nm to‘lqin uzunligi: OM2/OM3/OM4 ko‘p modali tola uchun minimal yo‘qotishli optimal
