en.name: Ruijie RG-NBS3200-24GT4XS-P L2+ Switch
en.shortDescription: 24-port managed L2 PoE switch with 10G: 24 Gigabit RJ45 PoE/PoE+ ports, 4 10G SFP+ slots, 370 W PoE budget, metal housing for 19" rack mounting.
en.description:
Ruijie RG-NBS3200-24GT4XS-P is a managed L2+ switch with PoE/PoE+ support on 24 gigabit ports and four 10G SFP+ uplinks. The PoE power budget is 370 W, which allows simultaneously powering a large number of IP cameras, access points or IP phones in a single solution. The 1U form factor housing is designed for mounting in a 19-inch rack and ensures professional integration into server rooms and telecommunication cabinets. The device is ideal for medium and large security facilities and corporate networks.

## Advantages
- PoE/PoE+ on 24 ports — powering a large number of network devices without laying separate power cables
- 370 W PoE budget — high power for simultaneous powering of PTZ cameras, Wi-Fi 6 points and PoE+ devices
- 4 10G SFP+ slots — high-speed uplinks eliminate bottlenecks under high video surveillance traffic
- Centralized L2+ management — VLAN, QoS, IGMP Snooping for a structured security network
- Mounting in a 19" rack — orderly placement in a telecommunication cabinet
- Metal construction — durability and reliability in continuous operation mode

## Applications
- Large IP video surveillance systems: aggregation and powering of cameras per floor or building
- Corporate offices: IP telephony, Wi-Fi and workplaces with a single PoE switch
- Shopping centers and hotels: managed PoE infrastructure for security and guest network
- Educational campuses: powering access points and cameras in classrooms

## FAQ
Q: Is the 370 W PoE budget enough for 24 cameras?
A: For standard IP cameras with consumption of 10–15 W the budget covers most installations; for PTZ cameras with increased consumption it is recommended to calculate the total load in advance.
Q: Does the switch support power redundancy?
A: Check the specific redundancy capabilities with SAT Solutions managers — we will select the optimal solution for your project.
Q: Can the SFP+ ports be used for connecting servers?
A: Yes, the 10G SFP+ slots are universal and suitable both for uplinks to an upstream switch and for direct connection of servers.

- 24 bağlantı noktasında PoE/PoE+ — ayrı güç kabloları döşemeden çok sayıda ağ cihazının beslenmesi
- 370 W PoE bütçesi — PTZ kameralar, Wi-Fi 6 noktaları ve PoE+ cihazların eşzamanlı beslenmesi için yüksek güç
- 4 10G SFP+ yuvası — yüksek hızlı uplinkler, yüksek video gözetim trafiğinde darboğazları önler
- Merkezi L2+ yönetim — yapılandırılmış güvenlik ağı için VLAN, QoS, IGMP Snooping
- 19" rafa montaj — telekomünikasyon dolabında düzenli yerleştirme
- Metal yapı — kesintisiz çalışma modunda dayanıklılık ve güvenilirlik

## Uygulama alanları
- Büyük IP video gözetim sistemleri: kat veya bina başına kameraların toplanması ve beslenmesi

Q: 370 W PoE bütçesi 24 kamera için yeterli mi?
A: 10–15 W tüketimli standart IP kameralar için bütçe çoğu kurulumu karşılar; artan tüketimli PTZ kameralar için toplam yükün önceden hesaplanması önerilir.
Q: Anahtar güç yedeklemesini destekliyor mu?
A: Belirli yedekleme olanaklarını SAT Solutions yöneticilerine danışın — projeniz için en uygun çözümü seçeriz.
Q: SFP+ bağlantı noktaları sunucuları bağlamak için kullanılabilir mi?

zh.name: Ruijie RG-NBS3200-24GT4XS-P L2+ 交换机

en.name: Ruijie RG-NBS3200-24SFP/8GT4XS L2+ Switch
en.shortDescription: 24-port managed L2 SFP switch with 10G: 24 SFP slots, 8 combo Gigabit RJ45 ports, 4 10G SFP+ slots, metal housing for 19" rack mounting.
en.description:
Ruijie RG-NBS3200-24SFP/8GT4XS is a managed L2+ switch based on optical ports: 24 SFP slots for gigabit optical modules, 8 combo Gigabit RJ45 ports and four 10G SFP+ uplinks. This configuration makes the switch an optimal aggregation node for large fiber-optic networks where it is necessary to connect many remote points or buildings. The 1U metal housing is designed for mounting in a standard 19-inch rack. The solution is in demand in security systems, telecommunication networks and at large manufacturing facilities.

## Advantages
- 24 SFP ports — connection of a large number of optical links from remote switches or devices
- 8 combo RJ45 ports — flexibility for local connection of devices over copper without additional equipment
- 4 10G SFP+ uplinks — high-speed transmission of aggregated traffic to the network core
- L2+ management — VLAN, RSTP, monitoring and QoS for complex multi-segment networks
- Mounting in a 19" rack — professional integration into a telecommunication cabinet
- Metal housing — reliability and durability in continuous operation

## Applications
- Aggregation of fiber-optic lines at large facilities and on campuses
- Video surveillance systems: collecting streams from many IP cameras via fiber
- Industrial enterprises: stable communication between workshops and administrative buildings
- Provider points of presence and operator nodes
- Hotels and business centers: optical backbone between floors

## FAQ
Q: Can third-party SFP modules be used?
A: The switch is compatible with SFP modules according to the MSA standard; for guaranteed operation it is recommended to use Ruijie modules or tested analogs.
Q: How to connect devices without an optical port to this switch?
A: For this, 8 combo RJ45 ports are provided, which allow connecting copper devices directly.
Q: Is centralized management of several such switches supported?
A: Yes, NBS3200 series devices are integrated into the Ruijie Cloud platform for management, monitoring and firmware updates from a single interface.

zh.name: Ruijie RG-NBS3200-24SFP/8GT4XS L2+ 交换机
zh.shortDescription: 带 10G 的 24 端口网管型 L2 SFP 交换机：24 个 SFP 插槽，8 个 Combo 千兆 RJ45 端口，4 个 10G SFP+ 插槽，可安装于 19" 机架的金属机箱。
zh.description:
Ruijie RG-NBS3200-24SFP/8GT4XS 是一款以光纤端口为核心的 L2+ 级网管型交换机：24 个用于 Gigabit 光模块的 SFP 插槽、8 个 combo Gigabit RJ45 端口和四个 10G SFP+ 上联。这种配置使该交换机成为大型光纤网络的理想汇聚节点，适用于需要连接众多远程节点或楼宇的场景。1U 金属机壳专为安装于标准 19 英寸机架而设计。该方案广泛应用于安防系统、电信网络和大型生产设施。

## 优势
- 24 个 SFP 端口 — 连接来自远程交换机或设备的大量光纤链路
- 8 个 combo RJ45 端口 — 无需额外设备即可通过铜缆灵活地本地连接设备
- 4 个 10G SFP+ 上联 — 将汇聚流量高速传输至网络核心
- L2+ 管理 — 为复杂的多段网络提供 VLAN、RSTP、监控和 QoS
- 安装于 19" 机架 — 专业集成至电信机柜
- 金属机壳 — 在连续运行中可靠耐用

## 应用领域
- 在大型设施和园区中汇聚光纤线路
- 视频监控系统：通过光纤收集来自众多 IP 摄像头的视频流
- 工业企业：车间与行政楼之间的稳定通信
- 运营商接入点和运营商节点
- 酒店和商务中心：楼层之间的光纤骨干

## FAQ
Q: 可以使用第三方厂商的 SFP 模块吗？
A: 交换机兼容符合 MSA 标准的 SFP 模块；为确保可靠运行，建议使用 Ruijie 模块或经过测试的兼容产品。
Q: 没有光纤端口的设备如何连接到这台交换机？
A: 为此配备了 8 个 combo RJ45 端口，可直接连接铜缆设备。
Q: 是否支持对多台此类交换机进行集中管理？
A: 支持，NBS3200 系列设备可集成至 Ruijie Cloud 平台，从单一界面进行管理、监控和固件更新。

en.name: Ruijie RG-NBS3200-48GT4XS L2+ Switch
en.shortDescription: 48-port managed L2 switch with 10G: 48 Gigabit RJ45 ports, 4 10G SFP+ slots, metal housing for 19" rack mounting.
en.description:
Ruijie RG-NBS3200-48GT4XS is a high-density managed L2+ switch with 48 gigabit RJ45 ports and four 10G SFP+ slots for uplinks. The device is aimed at large offices, floor switching nodes and small-scale data centers where it is necessary to connect a large number of workplaces or IP devices within a single rack unit. The 1U metal housing allows mounting in a 19-inch telecommunication cabinet. A rich set of L2+ features makes it possible to build segmented, managed and fault-tolerant networks.

## Advantages
- 48 Gigabit RJ45 ports — maximum connection density in a single 1U device
- 4 10G SFP+ uplinks — sufficient bandwidth to transmit traffic from all 48 ports without congestion
- L2+ management — VLAN, QoS, RSTP/MSTP, IGMP Snooping for professional network management
- Mounting in a 19" rack — orderly integration into any server or telecommunication room
- Metal housing — strength and efficient cooling under high load density
- Ruijie platform — proven reliability and the possibility of centralized management

## Applications
- Floor switching nodes in office and business centers
- Large IP video surveillance systems: aggregation of streams from dozens of cameras
- Educational institutions: a network for computer classes and lecture halls
- Manufacturing enterprises: connection of terminals, sensors and control systems
- Data centers and server rooms: access to servers and storage systems

## FAQ
Q: Does the switch support link aggregation (LAG/LACP)?
A: Yes, the L2+ level includes support for Link Aggregation (LACP), which allows combining ports to increase bandwidth and provide redundancy.
Q: How to configure VLAN to separate video surveillance and office networks?
A: The configuration is performed via the web interface or CLI; SAT Solutions can take on the initial configuration as part of an installation project.
Q: Is management possible without a dedicated IT specialist on site?
A: Yes, thanks to Ruijie Cloud, the switch can be managed and its state monitored remotely from anywhere.

Zengin L2+ işlev seti, segmentlere ayrılmış, yönetilebilir ve hata toleranslı ağlar kurmayı mümkün kılar.

## Avantajlar
- 48 Gigabit RJ45 bağlantı noktası — tek bir 1U cihazda maksimum bağlantı yoğunluğu
- 4 10G SFP+ uplink — tüm 48 bağlantı noktasının trafiğini tıkanıklık olmadan iletmek için yeterli bant genişliği

- 19" rafa montaj — herhangi bir sunucu veya telekomünikasyon odasına düzenli entegrasyon
- Metal kasa — yüksek yük yoğunluğunda dayanıklılık ve verimli soğutma
- Ruijie platformu — kanıtlanmış güvenilirlik ve merkezi yönetim olanağı

## Uygulama alanları
- Ofis ve iş merkezlerinde kat anahtarlama düğümleri
- Büyük IP video gözetim sistemleri: onlarca kameradan akışların toplanması
- Eğitim kurumları: bilgisayar sınıfları ve derslikler için ağ
- Üretim işletmeleri: terminallerin, sensörlerin ve kontrol sistemlerinin bağlanması
- Veri merkezleri ve sunucu odaları: sunuculara ve depolama sistemlerine erişim

## FAQ
Q: Anahtar bağlantı toplamayı (LAG/LACP) destekliyor mu?
A: Evet, L2+ seviyesi, bant genişliğini artırmak ve yedekleme sağlamak için bağlantı noktalarını birleştirmeye olanak tanıyan Link Aggregation (LACP) desteği içerir.
Q: Video gözetim ve ofis ağlarını ayırmak için VLAN nasıl yapılandırılır?
A: Yapılandırma web arayüzü veya CLI üzerinden yapılır; SAT Solutions, kurulum projesi kapsamında ilk yapılandırmayı üstlenebilir.

en.name: Ruijie RG-NBS3200-48GT4XS-P-V2 L2+ Switch
en.shortDescription: 48-port managed L2 PoE switch with 10G: 48 Gigabit RJ45 PoE/PoE+ ports, 4 10G SFP+ slots, 370 W PoE budget, metal housing for 19" rack mounting.
en.description:
Ruijie RG-NBS3200-48GT4XS-P-V2 is a powerful managed L2+ switch with PoE/PoE+ support on all 48 gigabit ports and a power budget of 370 W. Four 10G SFP+ uplinks provide high-speed transmission of aggregated traffic, and the 1U housing allows mounting the device in a standard 19-inch rack. The switch is designed for large security infrastructures and corporate networks where it is necessary to combine the powering and switching of a large number of network devices in a single solution.

## Advantages
- PoE/PoE+ on 48 ports — powering IP cameras, access points and phones without separate power supplies
- 370 W PoE budget — a powerful reserve for simultaneous operation of a large number of PoE devices
- 4 10G SFP+ uplinks — high-speed channels to the network core without overloads
- L2+ management — flexible configuration of VLAN, QoS and RSTP for separating and protecting networks
- 1U rack housing — professional placement in a server or telecommunication cabinet
- Updated V2 platform — current hardware base with improved reliability characteristics

## Applications
- Large video surveillance systems: powering and aggregation of streams from dozens of IP cameras
- Corporate offices: a unified infrastructure for IP telephony, Wi-Fi and workplaces
- Hotels and business centers: powering Wi-Fi access points on floors from a single point
- Warehouse and manufacturing complexes: reliable PoE switching in an industrial environment

## FAQ
Q: Is 370 W enough to power 48 PoE devices simultaneously?
A: At an average consumption of 7–10 W per device the budget is enough for most standard installations; for PoE+ devices it is recommended to calculate the load in advance.
Q: Does the switch support the PoE watchdog function for rebooting frozen cameras?
A: Check the PoE monitoring and power management functions with SAT Solutions managers — we are ready to select the optimal configuration.
Q: What is the advantage of the V2 version over the previous one?
A: The V2 version is built on a current hardware platform with improved reliability and compatibility while retaining the same key characteristics.

- Multi-gigabit ports — support for speeds of 2.5/5 Gbit/s for connecting next-generation devices
- High PoE budget up to 460 W — powering resource-intensive Wi-Fi 6 devices, PTZ cameras and other equipment
- 4 SFP+ uplinks — high-speed connection to the network core without congestion
- L2+ management — advanced VLAN, QoS, RSTP functions for professional network infrastructure
- Built-in AC power supply — ready to operate out of the box without external PoE injectors
- Ruijie reliability — an industrial platform for facilities with uninterrupted operation requirements

## Applications
- Modern office networks: connecting workstations and Wi-Fi 6 access points at multi-gigabit speeds
- High-resolution video surveillance systems: powering and switching of 4K and higher cameras
- Lecture and conference halls: powerful wireless infrastructure with PoE power
- Hotels and business centers: high-quality Wi-Fi for guests on the latest equipment

## FAQ
Q: What are multi-gigabit ports and why are they needed?
A: Multi-gigabit ports support speeds of 2.5 or 5 Gbit/s over standard Cat5e/Cat6 cable, which is necessary for Wi-Fi 6 access points capable of transmitting data faster than 1 Gbit/s.
Q: Does the switch support PoE on all 16 ports?
