Q: Ikkinchi darajadagi boshqaruv boshqarilmaydigan kommutatorga nisbatan nima beradi?
A: Boshqariladigan kommutator trafikni ajratish uchun VLAN ni sozlash, prioritetlar belgilash, portlarni bloklash va tarmoq monitoringini olib borish imkonini beradi — bu xavfsizlik va ishonchlilikni sezilarli darajada oshiradi.
Q: Kommutator standart telekommunikatsiya shkafiga o'rnatish uchun mosmi?
A: Ha, SNR seriyali Pixietech jihozi standart 19 dyumli shkaflar va stoykalarga o'rnatish uchun loyihalashtiriladi.

en.name: Managed Layer 2 PoE switch SNR-S2200G-8T-POE
en.shortDescription: Managed L2 PoE switch SNR-S2200G-8T-POE Pixietech for offices and stores: powering IP cameras and access points over cable. Buy in Tashkent with warranty.
en.description:
The managed L2 PoE switch SNR-S2200G-8T-POE from Pixietech is a compact solution for building a reliable network infrastructure with cable-based powering of devices. The model is designed for small sites: offices, shops, small warehouses where it is necessary to centrally manage the network and power IP cameras or access points without separate power supplies. Layer 2 manageability provides flexible VLAN configuration, traffic prioritization and control over each port.

## Advantages
- Power over PoE: connection of IP cameras, access points and IP phones without separate power adapters
- Layer L2 management: VLAN support, broadcast storm control and isolation of network segments
- Compact form factor: suitable for installation in small telecommunication cabinets and niches
- Centralized management: configuration and monitoring of all ports through a single interface
- Manufacturer's warranty 1 year: confirmed quality and reliability of the equipment
- Easy scaling: easily integrates into existing network infrastructure

## Areas of application
- Video surveillance systems: power and connection of IP cameras at small and medium sites
- Office networks: organization of a segmented and managed local network
- Retail outlets and shops: connection of POS terminals, Wi-Fi access points and cameras
- Hotels and hostels: providing network infrastructure for guest and service zones
- Educational institutions: managed network for classrooms and administrative premises

## FAQ
Q: Can IP cameras be connected directly to this switch without additional power supplies?
A: Yes, the switch supports PoE technology, which allows transmitting power over the network cable — separate adapters for cameras are not needed.
Q: What does layer 2 manageability provide compared to an unmanaged switch?
A: A managed switch allows configuring VLANs to separate traffic, setting priorities, blocking ports and monitoring the network — this significantly increases security and reliability.
Q: Is the switch suitable for installation in a standard telecommunication cabinet?
A: Yes, Pixietech SNR series equipment is designed for installation in standard 19-inch cabinets and racks.

tr.name: Yönetilebilir Katman 2 PoE switch SNR-S2200G-8T-POE
tr.shortDescription: Ofisler ve mağazalar için yönetilebilir L2 PoE switch SNR-S2200G-8T-POE Pixietech: IP kameraları ve erişim noktalarını kablo üzerinden besler. Taşkent'ten garantili satın alın.

## Avantajlar
- PoE üzerinden besleme: IP kameraların, erişim noktalarının ve IP telefonların ayrı güç adaptörleri olmadan bağlanması
- L2 seviyesi yönetim: VLAN desteği, yayın fırtınası kontrolü ve ağ segmentlerinin izolasyonu
- Kompakt form faktörü: küçük telekomünikasyon dolaplarına ve nişlere kurulum için uygun
- Merkezi yönetim: tüm bağlantı noktalarının tek bir arayüz üzerinden yapılandırılması ve izlenmesi
- Üretici garantisi 1 yıl: ekipmanın onaylanmış kalitesi ve güvenilirliği
- Kolay ölçekleme: mevcut ağ altyapısına kolayca entegre olur

## Uygulama alanları
- Video gözetim sistemleri: küçük ve orta ölçekli tesislerde IP kameraların beslenmesi ve bağlanması
- Ofis ağları: segmentli ve yönetilen bir yerel ağın organizasyonu
- Perakende satış noktaları ve mağazalar: POS terminallerinin, Wi-Fi erişim noktalarının ve kameraların bağlanması
- Oteller ve hosteller: misafir ve servis bölgeleri için ağ altyapısının sağlanması
- Eğitim kurumları: sınıflar ve idari mekanlar için yönetilen ağ

## FAQ
Q: IP kameralar ek güç kaynakları olmadan doğrudan bu anahtara bağlanabilir mi?

Q: İkinci seviye yönetilebilirlik yönetilmeyen bir anahtara kıyasla ne sağlar?
A: Yönetilen bir anahtar, trafiği ayırmak için VLAN yapılandırmaya, öncelikler belirlemeye, bağlantı noktalarını engellemeye ve ağı izlemeye olanak tanır — bu, güvenliği ve güvenilirliği önemli ölçüde artırır.

zh.name: 二层网管 PoE 交换机 SNR-S2200G-8T-POE
zh.shortDescription: 面向办公室和商店的二层网管 PoE 交换机 SNR-S2200G-8T-POE Pixietech：通过线缆为 IP 摄像机和接入点供电。塔什干购买，提供保修。

- 紧凑的外形：适合安装在小型电信机柜和壁龛中
- 集中管理：通过单一界面配置和监控所有端口

en.shortDescription: Managed L3 PoE switch Pixietech PXT-S2790G-8TX-POE: 8 ports with routing and VLAN for small facilities without an external router. Buy in Tashkent.
en.description:
The L3 managed PoE switch PXT-S2790G-8TX-POE from Pixietech is a compact 8-port device with layer-3 routing for small facilities that need inter-segment traffic exchange without an external router. Despite its small form factor, the model offers professional tooling: VLAN, ACL, routing between subnets. An ideal solution for technical rooms, small offices and remote points of connection to the corporate network.

## Advantages
- L3 routing in a compact chassis: hardware inter-network exchange without additional equipment
- 8 PoE ports: powering IP cameras, access points or phones over the network cable
- Advanced security: ACL and access control to protect small network nodes
- Flexible VLAN configuration: traffic segmentation between different groups of devices
- Simple deployment: quick connection to existing corporate infrastructure
- 1-year warranty: reliability of Pixietech equipment

## Areas of application
- Remote offices and branches: local routing with connection to the corporate WAN
- Technical nodes: managing a small number of devices with traffic isolation
- Video surveillance: powering IP cameras and connecting to an isolated network segment
- Meeting and conference rooms: reliable managed network with AV traffic prioritization
- Small production areas: network infrastructure for process equipment

## FAQ
Q: Why do you need an L3 switch with 8 ports if there are simpler 8-port models?
A: For small facilities connected to a multi-segment corporate network, L3 routing makes it possible to process inter-network traffic locally without loading the central router.
Q: Does the switch support static routing?
A: Yes, Pixietech L3 series switches support static routing, and dynamic protocols should be clarified when ordering.
Q: Is it possible to combine several such switches into a single managed network?
A: Yes, PXT-S2790G series devices can be built into a hierarchical topology with shared management through an upstream switch.

en.description:
The level 2 managed switch SNR-S2985G-24TC is a versatile gigabit platform with combo ports, allowing you to flexibly build a network infrastructure using both copper and optical communication channels. The presence of combo ports makes the device especially valuable for facilities that require a backbone optical connection in combination with ordinary copper lines. It is suitable for corporate networks, campuses and security facilities.

## Advantages
- Combo ports allow the use of both copper cables and fiber optics without additional converters
- Gigabit speed on all ports provides high throughput for modern applications
- L2 management includes a full set of functions: VLAN, QoS, STP and access control
- Topology flexibility: optical ports are used for backbone lines, copper ones — for end devices
- Support for standard protocols guarantees compatibility with any network equipment
- A 1-year warranty provides confidence in the long-term reliability of the solution

## Areas of application
- Campus networks: connecting buildings via fiber with distribution over copper cables inside
- IP video surveillance systems: backbone optical connection to the server with gigabit cameras
- Industrial facilities: optical lines for noise-immune data transmission over long distances
- Corporate offices: flexible scaling of the network with a choice of cabling system type
- Operator nodes: aggregation of traffic from several points using fiber optics

## FAQ
Q: What are combo ports and why are they needed?
A: A combo port is a physical connector that supports both a copper cable (RJ-45) and an optical SFP module; this provides flexibility in choosing the connection type without replacing equipment.
Q: Is it necessary to buy SFP modules separately?
A: Yes, optical SFP transceivers are purchased separately for the specific type of fiber and distance — our specialists will help with the selection.
Q: What is the warranty period?
A: The warranty for the switch is 1 year.

- Kampüs ağları: binaların fiber ile bağlanması ve içeride bakır kablolar üzerinden dağıtım

A: Kombo port, hem bakır kabloyu (RJ-45) hem de optik SFP modülünü destekleyen fiziksel bir konnektördür; bu, ekipmanı değiştirmeden bağlantı türünü seçmede esneklik sağlar.

en.name: Layer 3 managed switch SNR-S2995G-24TX
en.shortDescription: Managed L3 switch SNR-S2995G-24TX Pixietech: 24 copper ports, inter-subnet routing, QoS and monitoring for offices. In stock in Tashkent.
en.description:
Layer 3 managed switch SNR-S2995G-24TX is a 24-port model on copper TX ports for building a flexible and high-performance corporate network. Support for the full L3 functionality allows implementing routing between subnets, a flexible QoS policy and extended monitoring tools. The device is suitable for offices, enterprises and institutions that require a managed network of medium and large scale on standard cable infrastructure.

## Advantages
- 24 copper TX ports: connecting a large number of devices over standard UTP cable without spending on optics
- L3 routing: inter-VLAN interaction and subnet management at the hardware level
- Cost efficiency: copper ports are simpler and cheaper to install, do not require optical transceivers
- Flexible management: VLAN, ACL, QoS, port monitoring — a full set of enterprise-class tools
- Scalability: 24 ports for connecting workstations, IP phones, access points and other devices
- 1-year warranty: support from the manufacturer Pixietech

## Applications
- Corporate offices: a centralized network for workplaces, printers and VoIP phones
- Hotels: managed infrastructure for guest and service zones
- Educational institutions: a network for computer classes with access segregation
- Medical institutions: connecting workstations and medical equipment with security policies
- Retail enterprises: POS terminals, accounting systems and Wi-Fi infrastructure

## FAQ
Q: What is the difference between TX and FX ports on SNR-S2995G switches?
A: TX are copper ports for UTP cables, FX are optical. The TX version is cheaper to install and suitable for distances up to 100 meters; FX is needed for long distances or interference.
Q: Does the SNR-S2995G-24TX support trunking and channel aggregation?
A: Layer L3 switches of the SNR line support standard aggregation and management protocols — this is confirmed by their positioning as corporate equipment.
Q: How to buy the SNR-S2995G-24TX in Tashkent?
A: Contact SAT Solutions — we supply Pixietech SNR switches in Uzbekistan with an official warranty and provide installation.

The ideal solution for large IP video surveillance systems, deployment of corporate Wi-Fi and IP telephony: a single switch replaces dozens of separate power supplies. Full-fledged L3 routing provides flexible network management with traffic segregation by subnets and VLANs.

## Advantages
- 48 PoE ports: power and data transmission for IP cameras, access points, VoIP phones over a single cable
- L3 routing: network segmentation and inter-VLAN interaction without an external router
- Maximum density: 48 ports in a single device for large sites and big installations
- Significant installation savings: the absence of separate power supplies reduces the cost and complexity of installation
- Centralized PoE control: management of power and power schedule on each port
- 1-year warranty: official support from the manufacturer Pixietech

## Applications
- Large IP video surveillance systems: powering dozens of cameras from a single switch
- Corporate wireless networks: centralized powering of Wi-Fi access points throughout the building
- IP telephony: connecting VoIP phones in large offices and call centers
- Smart buildings and BMS systems: integration of IoT sensors, controllers and terminals with PoE support
- Access control systems: readers, cameras and controllers in a single PoE infrastructure

## FAQ
Q: How many IP cameras can be connected to the SNR-S2995G-48TX-POE?
A: Up to 48 cameras simultaneously — one per port; the actual number is limited by the total PoE budget of the switch and the consumption of each camera.
Q: Can the PoE power schedule be managed on individual ports?
A: Managed Layer L3 SNR switches support flexible PoE management policies, including power limitation and port priority management.
Q: Where to buy the SNR-S2995G-48TX-POE in Tashkent for a video surveillance system?
A: SAT Solutions supplies Pixietech SNR PoE switches in Uzbekistan and performs design and turnkey installation of video surveillance systems.

en.name: Layer 3 managed switch SNR-S300G-24FX
en.shortDescription: Managed L3 switch SNR-S300G-24FX Pixietech for the network core: hardware routing reduces load and speeds up data exchange. In stock.
en.description:
The Pixietech SNR-S300G-24FX Layer 3 managed switch is designed for building a reliable network core at enterprises and in corporate infrastructures. The device provides hardware-level traffic routing, which significantly reduces the load on servers and increases data transfer speed between network segments. Optical interfaces allow building backbone connections over considerable distances without loss of signal quality.

## Advantages
- Layer 3 routing at the hardware level: high-speed traffic processing between subnets without involving separate routers
- Optical ports (FX): stable data transmission over long distances, resistance to electromagnetic interference
- Flexible network management: full control over traffic, VLAN, QoS and other parameters through a single interface
- High reliability: corporate-grade design ensures stable operation in 24/7 mode
- Scalability: the switch is easily integrated into existing infrastructure and supports network expansion
- 1-year warranty: confirmed quality and manufacturer support

## Applications
- Corporate networks: combining office segments and organizing inter-network interaction
- Data centers: building a fast and reliable network core
- Video surveillance sites: backbone connection of IP cameras and recording servers via optics
- Industrial enterprises: creating interference-protected network backbones
- Educational and medical institutions: centralized management of branched network infrastructure

## FAQ
Q: How does a Layer 3 switch differ from a regular (Layer 2) one?
A: An L3 switch can route traffic between different subnets on its own, without a separate router, which speeds up network operation and simplifies the architecture.
Q: Is the SNR-S300G-24FX suitable for connecting IP cameras via optics?
A: Yes, the FX optical ports provide a stable connection with remote cameras and switches over considerable distances.
Q: What is the warranty on the device?
A: The manufacturer Pixietech provides a 1-year warranty on this switch.

- High reliability: equipment designed for failure-free 24/7 operation
- Scalability of architecture: supports network growth and an increasing number of connected devices

## Applications
- Large corporate networks: routing and managing traffic between offices and departments

en.name: Layer 3 managed switch SNR-S3850G-24FX-UPS
en.shortDescription: Managed L3 switch SNR-S3850G-24FX-UPS Pixietech with built-in UPS: protects the network from sudden outages and data loss. Delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
The Pixietech SNR-S3850G-24FX-UPS Layer 3 managed switch is a version with a built-in uninterruptible power supply, created for sites with increased requirements for network operation continuity. The presence of the UPS module protects the network from the consequences of sudden power outages and eliminates data or connection loss. The optical ports provide interference-protected backbone data transmission over long distances.

## Advantages
- Built-in UPS: the network continues to operate during short-term power outages without an additional UPS unit
- Layer 3 routing: hardware processing of traffic between segments without an external router
- 24 FX optical ports: stable connections over long distances with protection against electromagnetic interference
- Increased fault tolerance: combining a managed switch and backup power in one device
- Saving space and cable infrastructure: no need for a separate UPS for the switch
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Critically important sites: banks, medical institutions, dispatch centers, where interruption in communication is unacceptable
- Video surveillance systems: continuous recording and transmission of video even during short-term power failures
- Industrial enterprises: protecting production networks from unstable power supply
- Server rooms without a centralized UPS: backing up the power of the network core
- Government and municipal facilities: reliable network infrastructure with power backup

## FAQ
Q: Why is a UPS needed directly in the switch if there is an external UPS?
A: The built-in UPS guarantees protection of this particular network node even in cases where the external UPS does not cover the cabinet with the switch or its capacity is insufficient.
Q: How long does the built-in UPS keep the switch running?
A: The specific backup time depends on the capacity of the built-in battery and the load; clarify this parameter when ordering with SAT Solutions managers.
Q: Is there a warranty on this model?
A: Yes, Pixietech provides a 1-year warranty on the SNR-S3850G-24FX-UPS switch.

- Dahili UPS: ağ, kısa süreli elektrik kesintilerinde ek bir UPS olmadan çalışmaya devam eder
- Katman 3 yönlendirme: harici bir yönlendirici olmadan segmentler arasındaki trafiğin donanımsal işlenmesi

- Kritik öneme sahip tesisler: iletişimde kesintinin kabul edilemez olduğu bankalar, sağlık kurumları, sevkiyat merkezleri

- Endüstriyel işletmeler: üretim ağlarını kararsız güç kaynağından koruma
- Merkezi UPS'i olmayan sunucu odaları: ağ çekirdeğinin gücünü yedekleme
- Devlet ve belediye tesisleri: güç yedeklemeli güvenilir ağ altyapısı

Q: Bu modelde garanti var mı?

Pixietech kompaniyasining L3 darajali boshqariladigan PXT-S2790G-24TX kommutatori — unumdor korporativ tarmoqlarni qurish uchun apparat marshrutlashni qo'llab-quvvatlovchi 24 portli gigabit yechim. TX mis portlari bino ichida jihozlarni qulay ulashni ta'minlaydi, L3 funksiyalari esa bir nechta quyi tarmoqni yagona boshqariladigan infratuzilmaga birlashtirish imkonini beradi. Qurilma tarmoq yadrosi roli uchun ham, taqsimlangan inshootlardagi agregatsiya darajasi uchun ham mos keladi.

## Afzalliklari
- Apparat L3 marshrutlash: tashqi routersiz quyi tarmoqlar o'rtasida tez ma'lumot almashinuvi
- 24 gigabit mis port: serverlar, ishchi stansiyalar va tarmoq qurilmalarini qulay ulash
- To'liq boshqaruv to'plami: xavfsiz korporativ tarmoq uchun VLAN, QoS, ACL va monitoring
- 24/7 ishonchlilik: uzluksiz ishlatish uchun korporativ sinf jihozlari
- O'rnatish soddaligi: RJ-45 mis portlari standart SKS bilan mos keladi
- Pixietech'dan 1 yil kafolat

## Qo'llanilish sohalari
- Server xonalari: VLAN o'rtasida marshrutlash bilan serverlar va saqlash tizimlarini ulash
- Korporativ ofislar: murakkab tuzilishga ega tashkilotlar uchun boshqariladigan tarmoq yadrosi
- Kirishni nazorat qilish va videokuzatuv tizimlari: segmentlash va trafikni boshqarish
- Tibbiyot va ta'lim muassasalari: foydalanuvchilar va ma'muriy tizimlar tarmoqlarini ajratish
- Mehmonxonalar va savdo markazlari: turli xil tarmoq infratuzilmasini yagona boshqarish

## FAQ
Q: L3-kommutatorning L2-kommutator va router kombinatsiyasi oldidagi afzalligi nimada?
A: L3-kommutator marshrutlashni apparat tarzda va dasturiy routerlardan ancha tez bajaradi, shuningdek stoykadagi qurilmalar sonini kamaytiradi va xizmat ko'rsatishni soddalashtiradi.
Q: PXT-S2790G-24TX dinamik marshrutlash protokollarini qo'llab-quvvatlaydimi?
A: Marshrutlash protokollari imkoniyatlari konfiguratsiyani tanlashda SAT Solutions mutaxassislaridan aniqlanadi.
Q: Qurilmaga kafolat qancha?
A: Pixietech ishlab chiqaruvchisi 1 yil kafolat beradi.

en.name: Layer L3 managed switch PXT-S2790G-24TX
en.shortDescription: Managed L3 switch Pixietech PXT-S2790G-24TX: 24 gigabit copper ports with hardware routing for high-performance networks. In stock in Tashkent.
en.description:
The Pixietech PXT-S2790G-24TX Layer L3 managed switch is a 24-port gigabit solution with support for hardware routing for building high-performance corporate networks. The TX copper ports provide convenient connection of equipment within a building, while the L3 functions allow combining several subnets into a single managed infrastructure. The device is suitable both for the role of a network core and for the aggregation level in distributed installations.

## Advantages
- Hardware L3 routing: fast data exchange between subnets without an external router
- 24 gigabit copper ports: convenient connection of servers, workstations and network devices
- Full management set: VLAN, QoS, ACL and monitoring for a secure corporate network
- 24/7 reliability: corporate-class equipment for continuous operation
- Ease of installation: RJ-45 copper ports are compatible with standard structured cabling
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Server rooms: connecting servers and storage systems with routing between VLANs
- Corporate offices: a managed network core for organizations with a complex structure
- Access control and video surveillance systems: segmentation and traffic management
- Medical and educational institutions: separating user and administrative system networks
- Hotels and shopping centers: unified management of heterogeneous network infrastructure

## FAQ
Q: What is the advantage of an L3 switch over a combination of an L2 switch and a router?
A: An L3 switch performs routing in hardware and significantly faster than software routers, and also reduces the number of devices in the rack and simplifies maintenance.
Q: Does the PXT-S2790G-24TX support dynamic routing protocols?
A: The capabilities of routing protocols are clarified with SAT Solutions specialists when selecting a configuration.
Q: What is the warranty on the device?
A: The manufacturer Pixietech provides a 1-year warranty.

tr.name: L3 katmanı yönetilebilir switch PXT-S2790G-24TX
tr.shortDescription: Yönetilebilir L3 switch Pixietech PXT-S2790G-24TX: yüksek performanslı ağlar için donanımsal yönlendirmeli 24 gigabit bakır port. Taşkent'te stokta.
tr.description:
Pixietech'in PXT-S2790G-24TX L3 katman yönetilebilir anahtarı, yüksek performanslı kurumsal ağlar oluşturmak için donanımsal yönlendirme desteğine sahip 24 portlu gigabit bir çözümdür. TX bakır portları, bir bina içinde ekipmanların kullanışlı bir şekilde bağlanmasını sağlarken, L3 işlevleri birden fazla alt ağı tek bir yönetilebilir altyapıda birleştirmeye olanak tanır. Cihaz, hem bir ağ çekirdeği rolü için hem de dağıtık kurulumlarda toplama düzeyi için uygundur.

## Avantajlar
- Donanımsal L3 yönlendirme: harici bir yönlendirici olmadan alt ağlar arasında hızlı veri alışverişi
- 24 gigabit bakır port: sunucuların, iş istasyonlarının ve ağ cihazlarının kullanışlı bağlantısı
- Tam yönetim seti: güvenli bir kurumsal ağ için VLAN, QoS, ACL ve izleme
- 24/7 güvenilirlik: kesintisiz çalışma için kurumsal sınıf ekipman
- Kurulum kolaylığı: RJ-45 bakır portları standart yapısal kablolamayla uyumludur
- Pixietech'ten 1 yıl garanti

## Uygulama alanları
- Sunucu odaları: VLAN'lar arasında yönlendirme ile sunucuları ve depolama sistemlerini bağlama
- Kurumsal ofisler: karmaşık yapıya sahip kuruluşlar için yönetilebilir bir ağ çekirdeği
- Erişim kontrolü ve video gözetim sistemleri: segmentasyon ve trafik yönetimi
- Tıbbi ve eğitim kurumları: kullanıcı ve idari sistem ağlarını ayırma
- Oteller ve alışveriş merkezleri: heterojen ağ altyapısının birleşik yönetimi

## FAQ
Q: Bir L3 anahtarının, bir L2 anahtarı ile bir yönlendirici kombinasyonuna göre avantajı nedir?
A: Bir L3 anahtarı yönlendirmeyi donanımsal olarak ve yazılım yönlendiricilerinden çok daha hızlı gerçekleştirir, ayrıca raftaki cihaz sayısını azaltır ve bakımı basitleştirir.
Q: PXT-S2790G-24TX, dinamik yönlendirme protokollerini destekliyor mu?
A: Yönlendirme protokollerinin yetenekleri, yapılandırma seçimi sırasında SAT Solutions uzmanlarıyla netleştirilir.
Q: Cihazın garantisi nedir?
A: Üretici Pixietech, 1 yıl garanti sağlar.

zh.name: L3 网管交换机 PXT-S2790G-24TX
zh.shortDescription: Pixietech PXT-S2790G-24TX 三层网管交换机：24 个带硬件路由的千兆铜口，适用于高性能网络。塔什干现货。
zh.description:
Pixietech 的 PXT-S2790G-24TX L3 层管理型交换机是一款支持硬件路由的 24 端口千兆解决方案，用于构建高性能企业网络。TX 铜口便于在楼宇内连接设备，而 L3 功能可将多个子网整合为单一的管理型基础设施。该设备既适合担任网络核心，也适合分布式安装中的汇聚层。

## 优势
- 硬件 L3 路由：无需外部路由器即可在子网之间快速交换数据
- 24 个千兆铜口：便于连接服务器、工作站和网络设备
- 完整的管理套件：为安全的企业网络提供 VLAN、QoS、ACL 和监控
- 24/7 可靠性：用于持续运行的企业级设备
- 安装简便：RJ-45 铜口兼容标准综合布线
- Pixietech 提供 1 年质保

## 应用领域
- 服务器机房：通过 VLAN 间路由连接服务器和存储系统
- 企业办公室：为结构复杂的组织提供管理型网络核心
- 门禁和视频监控系统：分段和流量管理
- 医疗和教育机构：分离用户网络与行政系统网络
- 酒店和购物中心：对异构网络基础设施进行统一管理

## FAQ
Q: L3 交换机相比 L2 交换机加路由器的组合有何优势？
A: L3 交换机以硬件方式执行路由，速度远超软件路由器，同时减少了机架中的设备数量并简化了维护。
Q: PXT-S2790G-24TX 是否支持动态路由协议？
A: 路由协议的能力将在选择配置时与 SAT Solutions 专家确认。
Q: 设备的质保如何？
A: 制造商 Pixietech 提供 1 年质保。

uz.name: L3 darajali boshqariladigan kommutator PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC

uz.description:
Pixietech kompaniyasining L3 darajali boshqariladigan PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC kommutatori — ishonchli tarmoq yadrosini qurish uchun 48 optik port va elektr ta'minoti zaxiralanishiga ega yuqori zichlikdagi yechim. Ikkita AC quvvat manbasining mavjudligi yagona nosozlik nuqtasini istisno qiladi va bloklardan biri ishdan chiqqanda ham uzluksiz ishlashni ta'minlaydi. L3 funksiyalari va optik interfeyslar kommutatorni yirik va mas'uliyatli obyektlar uchun ideal tanlovga aylantiradi.

## Afzalliklari
- 48 FX optik port: optik-tolali liniyalar bo'yicha ko'plab uzoq tugunlarni ulash
- Ikkita AC quvvat bloki (2AC): maksimal nosozliklarga chidamlilik uchun quvvat zaxiralanishi
- L3 marshrutlash: quyi tarmoqlar o'rtasidagi trafikni apparat darajasida boshqarish
- Yuqori portlar zichligi: ixcham shassi ichida 48 optik ulanish
- Shovqinlarga chidamlilik: optik interfeyslar elektromagnit ta'sirdan himoyalangan

## Qo'llanilish sohalari
- Ma'lumotlarni qayta ishlash markazlari: quvvat zaxiralanishi bilan yuqori zichlikdagi optik yadro
- Yirik sanoat obyektlari: dostuplikka yuqori talablar bilan shovqinlar sharoitidagi tarmoqlar
- Operator va telekommunikatsiya tugunlari: ko'plab optik kanallarni agregatsiya qilish
- Uzluksiz ish sikliga ega obyektlar: ishlab chiqarishlar, kasalxonalar, dispetcherliklar
- Taqsimlangan videokuzatuv tizimlari: yuzlab kameralarni optika orqali markazlashtirilgan ulash

## FAQ
Q: Kommutatorda nima uchun ikkita quvvat bloki kerak?
A: Quvvat zaxiralanishi (2AC) bir blok ishdan chiqqanda tarmoq uzilishsiz ishlashda davom etishini kafolatlaydi — bu to'xtatish yo'l qo'yilmaydigan obyektlar uchun muhim.
Q: PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC ga qo'shimcha kengaytirish modullarini qo'shish mumkinmi?
A: Modulli kengaytirish imkoniyatlari buyurtma berishda SAT Solutions mutaxassislaridan aniqlanadi.
Q: Ushbu kommutatorga kafolat qanday?
A: Pixietech PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC ga 1 yil kafolat beradi.

en.name: Layer L3 managed switch PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC
en.shortDescription: Managed L3 switch Pixietech PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC: 48 fiber ports and two AC power supplies for a reliable network core. Delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
The Pixietech PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC Layer L3 managed switch is a high-density solution with 48 optical ports and power supply redundancy for building a reliable network core. The presence of two AC power supplies eliminates a single point of failure and ensures continuous operation even if one of the units fails. The L3 functions and optical interfaces make the switch an ideal choice for large and critical sites.

## Advantages
- 48 FX optical ports: connecting a large number of remote nodes via fiber-optic lines
- Two AC power supplies (2AC): power redundancy for maximum fault tolerance
- L3 routing: hardware-level traffic management between subnets
- High port density: 48 optical connections in a compact chassis
- Interference resistance: optical interfaces are protected from electromagnetic effects
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Data centers: a high-density optical core with power redundancy
- Large industrial sites: networks in conditions of interference with high availability requirements
- Carrier and telecommunications nodes: aggregation of a large number of optical channels
- Sites with a continuous operation cycle: production facilities, hospitals, dispatch centers
- Distributed video surveillance systems: centralized connection of hundreds of cameras via optics

## FAQ
Q: What are the two power supplies in the switch for?
A: Power redundancy (2AC) guarantees that if one unit fails, the network will continue to operate without interruption — this is critical for sites where a stoppage is unacceptable.
Q: Can additional expansion modules be added to the PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC?
A: Modular expansion capabilities are clarified when ordering with SAT Solutions specialists.
Q: What is the warranty on this switch?
A: Pixietech provides a 1-year warranty on the PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC.

tr.name: L3 katmanı yönetilebilir switch PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC

tr.description:
Pixietech'in PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC L3 katman yönetilebilir anahtarı, güvenilir bir ağ çekirdeği oluşturmak için 48 optik port ve güç kaynağı yedekliliğine sahip yüksek yoğunluklu bir çözümdür. İki AC güç kaynağının varlığı, tek bir arıza noktasını ortadan kaldırır ve ünitelerden biri arızalansa bile kesintisiz çalışmayı sağlar. L3 işlevleri ve optik arayüzler, anahtarı büyük ve kritik tesisler için ideal bir seçim haline getirir.

## Avantajlar
- 48 FX optik port: fiber optik hatlar üzerinden çok sayıda uzak düğümü bağlama
- İki AC güç kaynağı (2AC): maksimum hata toleransı için güç yedekliliği
- L3 yönlendirme: alt ağlar arasında donanım düzeyinde trafik yönetimi
- Yüksek port yoğunluğu: kompakt bir şasi içinde 48 optik bağlantı
- Girişime karşı dayanıklılık: optik arayüzler elektromanyetik etkilerden korunur
- Pixietech'ten 1 yıl garanti

## Uygulama alanları
- Veri merkezleri: güç yedekliliğine sahip yüksek yoğunluklu optik çekirdek
- Büyük endüstriyel tesisler: yüksek kullanılabilirlik gereksinimleriyle girişim koşullarında ağlar
- Operatör ve telekomünikasyon düğümleri: çok sayıda optik kanalın toplanması
- Sürekli çalışma döngüsüne sahip tesisler: üretim tesisleri, hastaneler, sevkiyat merkezleri
- Dağıtık video gözetim sistemleri: yüzlerce kameranın optik üzerinden merkezi bağlantısı

## FAQ
Q: Anahtardaki iki güç kaynağı ne işe yarar?
A: Güç yedekliliği (2AC), bir ünite arızalanırsa ağın kesintisiz çalışmaya devam etmesini garanti eder — bu, duruşun kabul edilemez olduğu tesisler için kritik öneme sahiptir.
Q: PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC'ye ek genişletme modülleri eklenebilir mi?
A: Modüler genişletme yetenekleri, sipariş sırasında SAT Solutions uzmanlarıyla netleştirilir.
Q: Bu anahtarın garantisi nedir?
A: Pixietech, PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC için 1 yıl garanti sağlar.

zh.name: L3 网管交换机 PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC
zh.shortDescription: Pixietech PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC 三层网管交换机：48 个光口和两个 AC 电源，构建可靠的网络核心。乌兹别克斯坦全境配送。
zh.description:
Pixietech 的 PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC L3 层管理型交换机是一款具备 48 个光纤端口和电源冗余的高密度解决方案，用于构建可靠的网络核心。两个 AC 电源的存在消除了单点故障，即使其中一个电源单元发生故障也能确保持续运行。L3 功能和光纤接口使该交换机成为大型关键场所的理想选择。

## 优势
- 48 个 FX 光纤端口：通过光纤线路连接大量远程节点
- 两个 AC 电源（2AC）：实现最大容错的电源冗余
- L3 路由：在子网之间进行硬件级流量管理
- 高端口密度：在紧凑机箱中实现 48 个光纤连接
- 抗干扰：光纤接口免受电磁影响
- Pixietech 提供 1 年质保

## 应用领域
- 数据中心：带电源冗余的高密度光纤核心
- 大型工业场所：在干扰条件下且对可用性要求高的网络
- 运营商和电信节点：聚合大量光纤通道
- 连续运行周期的场所：生产设施、医院、调度中心
- 分布式视频监控系统：通过光纤集中连接数百台摄像机

## FAQ
Q: 交换机中的两个电源有何用途？
A: 电源冗余（2AC）确保在一个电源单元故障时网络仍能不间断运行——这对于不容许停机的场所至关重要。
Q: PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC 能否添加额外的扩展模块？
A: 模块化扩展能力将在订购时与 SAT Solutions 专家确认。
Q: 该交换机的质保如何？
A: Pixietech 为 PXT-S2790G-48FX-2AC 提供 1 年质保。

en.name: Layer L3 managed switch PXT-S2790G-48T4X
en.shortDescription: Managed L3 switch Pixietech PXT-S2790G-48T4X: 48 gigabit ports and 4 10G uplinks for a powerful, scalable network core. In stock in Tashkent.
en.description:
The Pixietech PXT-S2790G-48T4X Layer L3 managed switch offers 48 gigabit copper ports and 4 10G uplinks for building a powerful and scalable network core. The high-speed uplinks provide fast aggregation of traffic to upstream equipment, while the L3 routing functions allow managing several subnets without additional routers. This is a solution for large installations with a large number of users and devices.

## Advantages
- 48 gigabit copper ports: mass connection of devices in one switch
- 4 10G uplinks: high-speed aggregation of traffic to the network core or servers
- L3 routing: hardware processing of inter-network traffic without an external router
- VLAN, QoS and advanced management: full control over network policy
- Scalability: supports infrastructure growth without changing the network core
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Corporate networks of large companies: connecting a large number of workplaces with fast uplinks
- Floor aggregation switches: collecting traffic from workplaces and transferring it to the network core via 10G
- Video surveillance systems: connecting IP cameras and NVR with high throughput to servers
- Data centers and server farms: flexible connection of servers with 10G uplinks
- Educational campuses: a high-performance network for students and server infrastructure

## FAQ
Q: Why are 10G uplinks needed with gigabit access ports?
A: 10G uplinks aggregate traffic from dozens of gigabit ports and transmit it without a bottleneck to servers or upstream core switches.
Q: Does the PXT-S2790G-48T4X support stacking with other switches?
A: Stacking capabilities are clarified with SAT Solutions specialists when forming a project solution.
Q: What is the warranty period?

The Pixietech PXT-S2790G-48TX Layer L3 managed switch is designed for building a corporate network core with high connection density. The device supports Layer 3 routing, which allows segmenting the network and managing traffic without an additional router. This solution is suitable for large offices, industrial sites and institutions where reliable and scalable network infrastructure is required.

## Advantages
- L3 routing allows dividing the network into VLAN segments and centrally managing inter-network traffic
- 48 ports provide high connection density — convenient for large sites without additional access switches
- Full management via web interface or CLI simplifies network configuration and monitoring
- Support for modern routing protocols increases the fault tolerance and flexibility of the topology
- The manufacturer's 1-year warranty confirms the reliability of the equipment in commercial operation
- The Pixietech brand specializes in corporate-class network equipment at an affordable price

## Applications
- The core of a corporate network in office centers and administrative buildings
- Network infrastructure of educational institutions, hospitals and government institutions
- Manufacturing enterprises with a large number of workstations and servers
- Medium-scale data centers and server rooms

## FAQ
Q: How does an L3 switch differ from a regular L2 switch?
A: An L3 switch can route traffic between different subnets, replacing a separate router — this simplifies the architecture and reduces network latency.

Q: Can the switch be managed remotely?
A: Yes, the device supports remote management via standard protocols, which allows administering the network without physical access to the equipment.

Q: Is the switch suitable for video surveillance and IP telephony?
A: Yes, support for VLAN and QoS allows prioritizing the latency-sensitive traffic of cameras and phones on the same infrastructure.

en.name: Layer L3 managed switch PXT-S2795X-12FX
en.shortDescription: Managed L3 switch Pixietech PXT-S2795X-12FX with SFP/SFP+ ports: high-speed fiber for linking buildings and backbones. Buy in Tashkent.
en.description:
The Pixietech PXT-S2795X-12FX Layer L3 managed switch is oriented toward sites where high-speed data transmission over optical fiber is required. The device is equipped with SFP/SFP+ optical ports, which makes it indispensable for connecting remote buildings, server rooms and backbone network nodes. Full Layer 3 routing provides flexible traffic management on an enterprise scale.

## Advantages
- Optical interfaces ensure data transmission over long distances without losses and interference
- L3 routing allows combining geographically dispersed network segments into a single managed infrastructure
- Support for high-speed uplink ports guarantees the absence of bottlenecks during traffic aggregation
- Centralized management simplifies monitoring and diagnostics of the entire network from a single point
- The reliable Pixietech platform with a 1-year warranty is suitable for continuous commercial operation
- The compact form factor allows placing the switch in a standard server rack

## Applications
- Inter-building connections on the territory of enterprises, campuses and complexes
- The aggregation level in the three-tier architecture of a corporate network
- Communication nodes in video surveillance systems with high resolution and a large number of cameras
- Data centers with high throughput requirements

## FAQ
Q: Why use optical ports instead of copper ones?
A: Optics transmit data over hundreds of meters and kilometers without signal attenuation, which is critical when connecting buildings or remote server rooms.

Q: Are third-party SFP modules compatible with this switch?
A: The switch supports standard SFP/SFP+ modules — check the compatibility of specific modules with our specialists before purchasing.

Q: Can this switch be combined with copper access switches?
A: Yes, via the SFP uplink the switch easily aggregates traffic from several copper access-level switches.

- Optik arayüzler, uzun mesafelerde kayıpsız ve girişimsiz veri aktarımı sağlar
- L3 yönlendirme, coğrafi olarak dağınık ağ segmentlerini tek bir yönetilebilir altyapıda birleştirmeye olanak tanır
- Yüksek hızlı uplink portlarının desteği, trafik toplama sırasında darboğazların olmamasını garanti eder
- Merkezi yönetim, tüm ağın tek bir noktadan izlenmesini ve tanısını basitleştirir
- 1 yıl garantili güvenilir Pixietech platformu, kesintisiz ticari işletme için uygundur
- Kompakt form faktörü, anahtarın standart bir sunucu rafına yerleştirilmesine olanak tanır

## Uygulama alanları
- İşletmelerin, kampüslerin ve komplekslerin sahasında binalar arası bağlantılar
- Kurumsal bir ağın üç katmanlı mimarisindeki toplama düzeyi
- Yüksek çözünürlüklü ve çok sayıda kameraya sahip video gözetim sistemlerindeki iletişim düğümleri
- Yüksek verim gereksinimleri olan veri merkezleri

## FAQ
Q: Neden bakır yerine optik portlar kullanılır?
A: Optik, verileri sinyal zayıflaması olmadan yüzlerce metre ve kilometre boyunca iletir; bu da binaları veya uzaktaki sunucu odalarını bağlarken kritik öneme sahiptir.

Q: Üçüncü taraf SFP modülleri bu anahtarla uyumlu mu?

Q: Bu anahtar, bakır erişim anahtarlarıyla birleştirilebilir mi?

en.description:

This is an enterprise-level solution for those building a high-performance network core who do not want to compromise on speed and functionality. You can buy such a switch in Uzbekistan through SAT Solutions.

## Advantages
- 48 multi-gigabit ports allow connecting a large number of devices at speeds above 1 Gbit/s without replacing cables
- High-speed 10G/25G uplink ports provide a fast connection to the upper network level
- Two 40G/100G QSFP ports create backbone channels with maximum throughput
- L3 routing gives full control over inter-segment traffic and security policies
- Support for advanced routing protocols ensures fault tolerance and load balancing
- Pixietech 1-year warranty confirms the quality and reliability of the flagship solution

## Areas of application
- Core of a large corporate network in multi-story office complexes and technology parks
- Traffic aggregation in data centers and cloud infrastructures
- Operator nodes and corporate access provider nodes
- Large educational and medical institutions with high throughput requirements

## FAQ
Q: What are QSFP ports for on an aggregation switch?
A: QSFP ports support speeds of 40G or 100G and are used to create high-speed backbone channels between key network nodes or toward the data center.

Q: Can this switch be used instead of two devices — aggregation and core?
A: Yes, thanks to the combination of multi-gigabit access ports and high-speed uplink ports, a single device can perform both functions in medium-sized networks.

Q: How difficult is it for a specialist to configure the switch?
A: The switch is managed via standard CLI interfaces and a web panel, so a qualified network engineer will configure it without specialized training.

en.name: Layer L3 managed switch PXT-S2950-8MG4X
en.shortDescription: Compact managed L3 switch Pixietech PXT-S2950-8MG4X: multi-gigabit ports and 4 uplinks for small nodes. L3 routing, delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
The Pixietech PXT-S2950-8MG4X L3 managed switch is a compact multi-gigabit model with four high-speed uplink ports for use in small network nodes with increased throughput requirements. The device combines layer 3 routing capabilities with multi-gigabit access interfaces, providing a modern network infrastructure with a minimal footprint. An optimal choice for small offices and technical nodes working with demanding applications.

## Advantages
- Multi-gigabit access ports allow connecting workstations and servers at speeds above 1 Gbit/s over existing wiring
- Four high-speed uplink ports provide a reliable connection to the upper level and channel redundancy
- L3 routing allows building isolated network segments without an additional router
- Compact form factor saves space in the mounting cabinet or at the administrator's workplace
- Manageability via standard protocols simplifies integration into existing infrastructure
- Pixietech 1-year warranty provides peace of mind in commercial operation

## Areas of application
- Small server rooms and technical nodes with high-speed connections
- Distribution points on the floors of an office building
- Storage system nodes with multi-gigabit speed requirements
- Small data centers and virtualization clusters

## FAQ
Q: Why choose a multi-gigabit switch instead of a regular gigabit one?
A: Multi-gigabit ports support 2.5G or 5G over standard Cat5e/Cat6 twisted pair, allowing speed increases without replacing cables — this saves budget during upgrades.

Q: Does the switch support link aggregation (LAG/LACP)?
A: Yes, Pixietech S2950 series managed switches support port aggregation to increase throughput and fault tolerance.

Q: Is the device suitable for small business or only for large companies?
A: The compact 8-port model is ideal for small and medium businesses that need enterprise features without an excessive number of ports.

en.name: Managed industrial POE switch L2 PXT-S250G-2S8T-POE
en.shortDescription: Industrial managed PoE switch L2 Pixietech PXT-S250G-2S8T-POE: 8 ports and 2 SFP for outdoor cabinets and technical rooms. In stock in Tashkent.
en.description:
The Pixietech PXT-S250G-2S8T-POE L2 managed industrial POE switch provides power and connection for up to 8 devices over twisted pair with two optical SFP ports for communication with the upper network. The device in industrial design is intended for installation outside server rooms — in technical cabinets, outdoor boxes and production areas. This is a ready-made solution for building segments of video surveillance, access control and industrial automation networks.

## Advantages
- 8 copper POE ports allow powering and connecting up to 8 IP cameras or access points simultaneously without additional wiring
- Two SFP uplink ports provide a reliable connection to the backbone node via optical cable
- Industrial design guarantees operability over a wide temperature range and in high humidity conditions
- L2 manageability with VLAN support allows isolating surveillance cameras from the corporate network
- POE device status monitoring function simplifies maintenance and diagnostics
- Pixietech 1-year warranty ensures reliability in round-the-clock security systems

## Areas of application
- Distributed IP video surveillance systems at large industrial and commercial facilities
- Access control and management systems with IP controllers and readers
- Outdoor surveillance camera nodes on the perimeter of enterprises and residential complexes
- Industrial IoT networks with sensors and devices powered over Ethernet

## FAQ
Q: Can analog cameras be connected to the switch via video servers?
A: Yes, video servers with POE support can be powered from the switch ports and connected to the network — this allows integrating analog equipment into the IP infrastructure.

Q: How to monitor the status of connected POE devices?
A: The managed switch allows remotely restarting POE devices and monitoring power consumption through the management interface.

Q: Is the switch suitable for DIN-rail mounting in a mounting cabinet?
A: Pixietech PXT-S250G series industrial switches support DIN-rail mounting — check the type of mounting with our specialists.

- POE cihaz durumu izleme işlevi bakım ve teşhisi kolaylaştırır
- Pixietech 1 yıl garanti 24 saat çalışan güvenlik sistemlerinde güvenilirlik sağlar

## Uygulama alanları
- Büyük endüstriyel ve ticari tesislerde dağıtık IP video gözetim sistemleri
- IP kontrolörleri ve okuyucularla erişim kontrol ve yönetim sistemleri
- İşletmelerin ve konut komplekslerinin çevresinde dış mekan gözetim kamera düğümleri
- Ethernet üzerinden beslenen sensörler ve cihazlarla endüstriyel IoT ağları

## FAQ
Q: Switch'e analog kameralar video sunucuları aracılığıyla bağlanabilir mi?
A: Evet, POE destekli video sunucuları switch portlarından beslenebilir ve ağa bağlanabilir — bu, analog ekipmanı IP altyapısına entegre etmeyi sağlar.

Q: Bağlı POE cihazlarının durumu nasıl izlenir?

zh.name: L2 网管工业 POE 交换机 PXT-S250G-2S8T-POE

- To'rtta SFP-port uzilishda avtomatik tiklanish bilan halqali topologiyalarni qurish imkoniyatini ochadi
- O'rnatilgan POE ulangan IP-qurilmalarni alohida adapterlarsiz quvvatlaydi, ob'ektdagi komponentlar sonini qisqartiradi
- Sanoat ijrosi harorat o'zgarishlari va elektromagnit shovqinlar sharoitida ishonchli ishlashni ta'minlaydi
- L2 boshqariluvchanlik qurilmani masofadan boshqarish va VLAN, STP va boshqa funksiyalarni sozlash imkonini beradi

Q: Bitta tarmoqda optik va mis ulanishlarni aralashtirish mumkinmi?

en.name: Managed industrial POE switch L2 PXT-S250G-4S2T8-POE
en.shortDescription: Industrial PoE switch L2 Pixietech PXT-S250G-4S2T8-POE with 4 SFP ports for ring and redundant fiber topologies. Delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
The Pixietech PXT-S250G-4S2T8-POE L2 managed industrial POE switch differs from other models in the series by an increased number of SFP optical ports — four SFP versus two in the basic versions. This configuration allows creating ring and redundant optical topologies, critical for facilities with increased fault tolerance requirements. The industrial design and POE function make the device indispensable for remote nodes of security systems.

## Advantages
- Four SFP ports open up possibilities for building ring topologies with automatic recovery in case of a break
- Built-in POE powers connected IP devices without separate adapters, reducing the number of components at the site
- Industrial design ensures reliable operation under temperature fluctuations and electromagnetic interference
- L2 manageability allows administering the device remotely and configuring VLAN, STP and other functions
- Flexible port configuration makes it possible to use the device as an intermediate node in complex topologies
- Pixietech 1-year warranty provides support throughout the entire warranty period

## Areas of application
- Ring topologies of video surveillance systems with automatic switching in case of channel failure
- Distributed facilities with several optical directions: factories, airports, large warehouses
- Railway and transport infrastructure with communication continuity requirements
- Critical facilities where interruptions in the operation of the security system are unacceptable

## FAQ
Q: What is a ring topology and why is it important for industrial systems?
A: A ring topology connects switches into a closed loop — if one cable breaks, traffic is automatically rerouted along a backup path, ensuring continuity of operation.

Q: Does the switch support redundancy protocols such as RSTP or Ring Protection?
A: Pixietech industrial switches support standard fast-recovery protocols — check the specific supported functions with our specialists.

Q: Can optical and copper connections be mixed in one network?
A: Yes, the combination of SFP and copper ports allows building hybrid networks where optics are used for the backbone and copper for connecting end devices.

tr.name: Yönetilebilir endüstriyel POE switch L2 PXT-S250G-4S2T8-POE

Endüstriyel tasarım ve POE işlevi cihazı güvenlik sistemlerinin uzak düğümleri için vazgeçilmez kılar.

## Avantajları
- Dört SFP port, kopma durumunda otomatik kurtarma ile halka topolojileri oluşturma imkanları açar
- Yerleşik POE, bağlı IP cihazları ayrı adaptörler olmadan besler, sahadaki bileşen sayısını azaltır
- Endüstriyel tasarım sıcaklık dalgalanmaları ve elektromanyetik girişim koşullarında güvenilir çalışma sağlar
- L2 yönetilebilirlik cihazı uzaktan yönetmeyi ve VLAN, STP ile diğer işlevleri yapılandırmayı sağlar
- Esnek port yapılandırması cihazı karmaşık topolojilerde bir ara düğüm olarak kullanmayı mümkün kılar
- Pixietech 1 yıl garanti tüm garanti süresi boyunca destek sağlar

## Uygulama alanları
- Kanal arızası durumunda otomatik geçişli video gözetim sistemlerinin halka topolojileri
- Birkaç optik yöne sahip dağıtık tesisler: fabrikalar, havaalanları, büyük depolar
- İletişim sürekliliği gereksinimleri olan demiryolu ve ulaşım altyapısı
- Güvenlik sisteminin çalışmasında kesintilerin kabul edilemez olduğu kritik tesisler

## FAQ
Q: Halka topolojisi nedir ve endüstriyel sistemler için neden önemlidir?
A: Halka topolojisi switch'leri kapalı bir döngüye bağlar — bir kablo koptuğunda trafik otomatik olarak yedek bir yol üzerinden yönlendirilir, böylece çalışma sürekliliği sağlanır.

Q: Switch RSTP veya Ring Protection gibi yedekleme protokollerini destekliyor mu?
A: Pixietech endüstriyel switch'ler standart hızlı kurtarma protokollerini destekler — desteklenen belirli işlevleri uzmanlarımızdan öğrenin.

Q: Optik ve bakır bağlantılar tek bir ağda karıştırılabilir mi?
A: Evet, SFP ve bakır portların kombinasyonu, optiğin omurga için ve bakırın uç cihazları bağlamak için kullanıldığı hibrit ağlar oluşturmayı sağlar.

zh.name: L2 网管工业 POE 交换机 PXT-S250G-4S2T8-POE
zh.shortDescription: 带 4 个 SFP 端口的 Pixietech PXT-S250G-4S2T8-POE 二层工业 PoE 交换机：适用于环形和冗余光纤拓扑。乌兹别克斯坦全境配送。

## 优势
- 四个 SFP 端口开启了构建具有断线自动恢复功能的环形拓扑的可能性
- 内置 POE 为已连接的 IP 设备供电，无需独立适配器，减少了现场组件数量
- 工业级设计确保在温度波动和电磁干扰条件下的可靠运行
- L2 可管理性可远程管理设备并配置 VLAN、STP 及其他功能
- 灵活的端口配置使设备能够在复杂拓扑中用作中间节点
- Pixietech 1年质保在整个质保期内提供支持

## 应用领域
- 具有通道故障自动切换功能的视频监控系统环形拓扑
- 具有多个光纤方向的分布式设施：工厂、机场、大型仓库
- 对通信连续性有要求的铁路和交通基础设施
- 安防系统运行不允许中断的关键设施

## FAQ
Q: 什么是环形拓扑，为什么它对工业系统很重要？
A: 环形拓扑将交换机连接成一个闭环——当一根电缆断开时，流量会自动沿备份路径重新路由，从而确保运行的连续性。

Q: 该交换机支持 RSTP 或 Ring Protection 等冗余协议吗？
A: Pixietech 工业交换机支持标准的快速恢复协议——请向我们的专家咨询所支持的具体功能。

Q: 可以在同一网络中混用光纤和铜缆连接吗？
A: 可以，SFP 和铜口的组合可构建混合网络，其中光纤用于骨干，铜缆用于连接终端设备。
