- The transitional FC/UPC-SC/UPC design joins equipment of different types without intermediate adapters
- A length of 3 m allows flexibly routing the cord along a cable organizer or tray
- UPC polish at both ends provides consistently low insertion and back loss
- The single-mode fiber is compatible with a wide range of active equipment
- The durable sheath protects the fiber during repeated connections
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- Connecting telecommunication FC equipment to the SC ports of switches and media converters
- IP video surveillance systems: joining optical transmitters from different manufacturers
- Provider nodes: transitional switching during phased infrastructure modernization
- Corporate networks: connecting equipment in different cabinets of one room
- Commissioning work and functional testing of optical paths

## FAQ
Q: Can such a patch cord be used as a permanent solution rather than a temporary one?
A: Yes, transitional patch cords are a full-fledged permanent solution; they are no worse than ordinary cords provided they are handled carefully.
Q: Which end should be connected to the FC adapter first?
A: The order of connection does not matter — the fiber is bidirectional; the main thing is to correctly align the key of the FC connector with the adapter slot.
Q: Is this patch cord suitable for a GPON ONT with SC/APC?
A: No, because a GPON ONT requires an SC/APC connector, while this cord has SC/UPC; the polish types are incompatible without significant degradation of the line.

- Minimal kechikish va yuqori o'tkazuvchanlik talab qilinadigan server xonalari

## FAQ
Q: Yuqori tezlikli ilovalar uchun OM4 ning OM3 dan ustunligi nimada?

Q: OM4 patchkordi OM3 ga mo'ljallangan uskuna bilan mosmi?

Q: Dupleksli LC/UPC OM4 1 m patchkord LC ga bo'linadigan QSFP transiverlari uchun mosmi?

en.name: Optical patch cord LC/UPC MM OM4 Duplex, 1 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC MM OM4 Duplex optical patch cord, 1 m for next-generation high-speed connections. Full-duplex transmission. In stock with warranty.
en.description:
LC/UPC MM OM4 Duplex optical patch cord 1 meter long from Pixietech — a patch cable based on next-generation OM4 multimode fiber for high-speed optical connections. The duplex design with LC/UPC connectors provides full-duplex data transmission and is intended for use in modern data centers and high-performance computing complexes. The minimum length of 1 m is ideal for compact in-cabinet switching.

## Advantages
- OM4 fiber provides higher bandwidth compared to OM3 at the same distances
- Duplex design allows organizing bidirectional data transmission with a single cable
- LC/UPC connectors with precise end-face polishing ensure minimal insertion loss
- Compact LC connectors are suitable for high-density patch panels
- The 1 m length eliminates excess cable in in-cabinet switching
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech

## Applications
- High-performance data centers and computing clusters
- Switching cabinets with 40G/100G equipment and above
- Data storage systems with optical interfaces
- Server rooms with requirements for minimal latency and high bandwidth

## FAQ
Q: What is the advantage of OM4 over OM3 for high-speed applications?
A: OM4 provides a wider bandwidth, which allows supporting 40G and 100G speeds over a greater distance compared to OM3.
Q: Is the OM4 patch cord compatible with equipment designed for OM3?
A: Yes, OM4 is backward compatible with OM3 and can be used together, however the resulting link characteristics are determined by the weakest link.
Q: Is the duplex LC/UPC OM4 1 m patch cord suitable for QSFP transceivers with breakout to LC?
A: Yes, combined with a cable splitter or an appropriate adapter, such a patch cord is used in schemes with QSFP breakout into 4 LC channels.

Minimum 1 m uzunluk, kompakt kabin içi anahtarlama için idealdir.

## Avantajları
- OM4 fiber, aynı mesafelerde OM3'e kıyasla daha yüksek bant genişliği sağlar
- Dupleks yapı, tek bir kabloyla çift yönlü veri iletimini düzenleme imkanı verir
- Uç yüzeyi hassas parlatılmış LC/UPC konektörler minimum ekleme kaybı sağlar
- Kompakt LC konektörler yüksek yoğunluklu patch panellere uygundur
- 1 m uzunluk, kabin içi anahtarlamada fazla kabloyu ortadan kaldırır
- Pixietech'ten 1 yıl garanti

## Uygulama alanları
- Yüksek performanslı veri merkezleri ve hesaplama kümeleri
- 40G/100G ve üstü ekipmana sahip anahtarlama kabinleri
- Optik arayüzlü veri depolama sistemleri
- Minimum gecikme ve yüksek bant genişliği gereksinimleri olan sunucu odaları

## FAQ
Q: Yüksek hızlı uygulamalar için OM4'ün OM3'e göre avantajı nedir?
A: OM4 daha geniş bir bant genişliği sağlar; bu da OM3'e kıyasla daha uzak mesafede 40G ve 100G hızlarını desteklemeye olanak tanır.
Q: OM4 patch kordon, OM3 için tasarlanmış ekipmanla uyumlu mu?
A: Evet, OM4 OM3 ile geriye dönük uyumludur ve birlikte kullanılabilir, ancak nihai hat özellikleri en zayıf halka tarafından belirlenir.
Q: Dupleks LC/UPC OM4 1 m patch kordon, LC'ye ayrıştırmalı QSFP alıcı-vericileri için uygun mu?
A: Evet, bir kablo ayırıcı veya uygun bir adaptörle birlikte böyle bir patch kordon, QSFP'nin 4 LC kanalına ayrıştırıldığı şemalarda kullanılır.

- Duplex construction allows transmitting data in both directions simultaneously

Compact LC/UPC connectors ensure a reliable contact and are easily secured in densely populated panels.

- The 3 m length is convenient both for in-rack switching and for connecting to nearby external devices

- The duplex fiber pair supports bidirectional data transmission in a single cable

- Server racks: switching of switches, servers, and data storage systems

Q: What is the advantage of OM4 fiber over OM3 when choosing a patch cord?

en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC MM OM4 Duplex optical patch cord, 30 m for patching between floors, buildings and machine-hall sections. OM4 fiber. Order with delivery.
en.description:
LC/UPC MM OM4 Duplex optical patch cord 30 m long from Pixietech is designed for optical switching over significant distances inside buildings: between technical floors, buildings connected by common cable infrastructure, or remote sections of the machine room. OM4 multimode fiber in a duplex design provides a reliable high-performance channel even over extended routing. LC/UPC connectors with precise polishing guarantee stable optical characteristics throughout the entire operation.

## Advantages
- The 30 m length allows switching equipment in different zones of the same building without splicing
- OM4 fiber provides an attenuation margin and support for high data transmission speeds
- LC/UPC connectors ensure a reliable and precise contact during repeated mating
- Duplex design organizes a full-duplex channel with a single cable
- The durable cable sheath withstands installation conditions in trays and cable channels
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech is backed by the reputation of an optical components manufacturer

## Applications
- Large data centers: optical communication between machine room zones or adjacent halls
- Production facilities: switching network equipment in extended production premises
- Educational and medical institutions: optical horizontal wiring between rooms of the same floor
- Video surveillance systems: optical transport from remote switches to central equipment

## FAQ
Q: Is the 30-meter patch cord suitable for working with 10G transceivers?
A: Yes, OM4 fiber is designed to support speeds of 10G and above over distances significantly exceeding 30 meters.
Q: Is it necessary to use special cable organizers for this length?
A: It is recommended to lay the excess length in loops and secure it with velcro clamps to prevent twisting and bending of the fiber.
Q: Are there limitations on the minimum bend radius?
A: Optical patch cords should not be bent with a radius of less than 30 mm — this can lead to increased losses or mechanical damage to the fiber.

Dupleks yapıdaki OM4 çok modlu fiber, uzun döşemelerde bile güvenilir yüksek performanslı kanal sağlar. Hassas cilalı LC/UPC konektörler tüm çalışma boyunca kararlı optik özellikler garanti eder.

## Avantajları
- 30 m uzunluk, aynı binanın farklı bölgelerindeki ekipmanı ek yapmadan anahtarlama imkanı verir
- OM4 fiber, zayıflama rezervi ve yüksek veri iletim hızları desteği sağlar
- LC/UPC konektörler tekrarlı takmalarda güvenilir ve hassas temas sağlar
- Dupleks yapı, tek bir kabloyla tam dupleks kanal düzenler
- Dayanıklı kablo kılıfı, kanallarda ve kablo kanallarında montaj koşullarına dayanır
- Pixietech'ten 1 yıl garanti, bir optik bileşen üreticisinin itibarıyla desteklenir

## Uygulama alanları
- Büyük veri merkezleri: makine odası bölgeleri veya bitişik salonlar arasında optik iletişim
- Üretim tesisleri: uzun üretim mekanlarında ağ ekipmanını anahtarlama
- Eğitim ve tıbbi kurumlar: aynı katın odaları arasında optik yatay kablolama
- Video gözetim sistemleri: uzak anahtarlardan merkezi ekipmana optik taşıma

## FAQ
Q: 30 metrelik patch kordon 10G alıcı-vericilerle çalışmak için uygun mu?
A: Evet, OM4 fiber, 30 metreyi önemli ölçüde aşan mesafelerde 10G ve üzeri hızları desteklemek üzere tasarlanmıştır.
Q: Bu uzunluk için özel kablo düzenleyicileri kullanmak gerekli mi?
A: Fazla uzunluğun halkalar halinde döşenmesi ve fiberin burulmasını ve bükülmesini önlemek için velkro kelepçelerle sabitlenmesi önerilir.
Q: Minimum bükülme yarıçapı konusunda sınırlamalar var mı?
A: Optik patch kordonlar 30 mm'den küçük bir yarıçapla bükülmemelidir — bu, kayıpların artmasına veya fiberin mekanik hasarına yol açabilir.

- OM4 光纤提供衰减裕量并支持高数据传输速率
- LC/UPC 连接器在多次插拔时确保可靠精确的接触
- 双工设计用单根电缆组织全双工通道
- 坚固的电缆外护套能承受桥架和线缆通道中的安装条件

## 应用领域
- 大型数据中心：机房区域或相邻机房之间的光纤通信
- 生产设施：在狭长的生产用房中切换网络设备
- 教育和医疗机构：同一楼层房间之间的光纤水平布线
- 视频监控系统：从远端交换机到中心设备的光纤传输

## FAQ
Q: 30 米跳线适合配合 10G 收发器工作吗？
A: 是的，OM4 光纤设计用于在远超 30 米的距离上支持 10G 及以上速率。
Q: 这种长度需要使用专用的理线器吗？
A: 建议将多余的长度盘成环，并用魔术贴扎带固定，以防止光纤扭曲和弯折。
Q: 最小弯曲半径有限制吗？
A: 光纤跳线弯曲半径不应小于 30 mm — 这可能导致损耗增加或光纤的机械损坏。

en.name: Optical patch cord LC/UPC MM OM4 Duplex, 5 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC MM OM4 Duplex universal optical patch cord, 5 m for server rooms, data centers and telecom nodes. Connection in adjacent racks. With warranty.
en.description:
LC/UPC MM OM4 Duplex optical patch cord 5 m long from Pixietech — a universal solution for optical switching in server rooms, data centers, and telecommunication nodes. The five-meter length provides flexibility when connecting equipment in adjacent racks or between active devices and patch panels. OM4 multimode fiber in a duplex design supports high-speed network applications.

## Advantages
- The 5 m length is optimal for switching between adjacent racks and neighboring equipment
- OM4 fiber provides high bandwidth characteristics of a multimode line
- Polished LC/UPC connectors ensure minimal insertion loss during connection
- Duplex design allows organizing bidirectional data transmission with a single cable
- The flexible construction facilitates routing in cable organizers and trays
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech provides confidence in the component's durability

## Applications
- Data centers and server rooms: connecting switches, servers, and storage systems
- Corporate networks: switching active equipment within a telecommunication room
- IP video surveillance: optical communication between video recorders and network equipment
- Access control systems: connecting controllers and switches via optics

## FAQ
Q: Is 5 m suitable for connecting to equipment in an adjacent rack?
A: Yes, a 5-meter patch cord is well suited for switching between racks standing side by side or across an aisle.
Q: Can the cable be bent when routing in a dense cable organizer?
A: It is recommended to observe a minimum bend radius of at least 30 mm to prevent increased attenuation or damage to the fiber.
Q: Is this patch cord suitable for fiber-based security systems?
A: Yes, the LC/UPC OM4 cable is compatible with optical transceivers used in switches of security and video surveillance systems.

zh.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC MM OM4 Duplex 光纤跳线，50 m，用于远端房间和楼栋之间的连接。OM4 光纤，传输距离留有余量。提供配送。

Pixietech 出品的 50 m 长 LC/UPC MM OM4 Duplex 光纤跳线，专为建筑物内较大距离的光纤切换而设计：在远端技术用房、企业楼栋或分布式基础设施的大型区域之间。OM4 多模光纤为这种距离上可靠的数据传输提供足够的衰减裕量。双工设计和 LC/UPC 连接器使该电缆可随时配合现代高速设备工作。

## 优势
- 50 m 长度无需延长和熔接即可覆盖较大距离
- OM4 光纤对高速长距离连接具有足够的衰减裕量
- LC/UPC 连接器保证精确连接和低光学损耗
- 双工结构可同时双向传输数据
- 可靠的电缆外护套能承受桥架和线缆通道中的布线条件
- Pixietech 提供 1 年质保，确认产品符合行业要求

## 应用领域
- 工业设施和工厂：车间与技术用房之间的光纤切换
- 大型数据中心：单个建筑物内远端模块或机房之间的通信
- 大学和医院：跨大型楼层的水平光纤布线
- 安防系统：从远端点到中心设备的光纤传输

## FAQ
Q: 可以用 50 米跳线代替固定电缆吗？
A: 跳线用于切换，而非用于墙体或楼层间通道的固定布线；对于固定走线，建议使用骨干电缆。
Q: OM4 在 50 m 上支持 10 Gbit/s 速率工作吗？
A: 是的，OM4 光纤在远超 50 米的距离上支持 10 Gbit/s，这提供了良好的可靠性裕量。
Q: 如何在机架中组织多余电缆长度的存放？
A: 多余的长度应小心地盘成直径不小于 60 mm 的环，并在理线器中用魔术贴扎带固定。

uz.name: Optik patchkord LC/UPC SM Duplex, 1 m
uz.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM dupleks patchkordi, 1 m: minimal yo‘qotishlar bilan stoyka ichidagi kommutatsiya uchun ixcham bir modali shnur. Toshkentdan sotib oling.
uz.description:
Pixietech kompaniyasidan 1 m uzunlikdagi LC/UPC SM Duplex optik patchkord — telekommunikatsiya va tarmoq uskunasini stoyka ichida kommutatsiya qilish uchun ixcham bir rejimli (bir modali) ulash kabeli. Bir modali SM tolasi minimal signal yo'qotishlarini ta'minlaydi va tegishli transiverlar ishlatiladigan katta masofalarda ma'lumot uzatishga mo'ljallangan tizimlarda qo'llaniladi. Aniq sayqallangan LC/UPC ulagichlari ishonchli optik kontaktni ta'minlaydi.

## Afzalliklari
- Bir modali SM tolasi bir modali transiverlar bilan ishlaydigan uskuna uchun mos keladi
- 1 m uzunlik bitta stoyka yoki shkaf ichidagi aniq ulanish uchun ideal
- LC/UPC ulagichlari tolaning aniq markazlashishi va minimal kiritiladigan yo'qotishlarni ta'minlaydi
- Dupleks bajarilishi bitta kabel bilan ikki tomonlama kanalni tashkil etish imkonini beradi
- Ixcham LC formati zich to'ldirilgan patch-panellarda joy tejaydi
- Pixietech tomonidan 1 yil kafolat uzoq muddatda ishonchlilikni ta'minlaydi

## Qo'llash sohalari
- Server stoykalari: bir modali SFP/SFP+ transiverlarini patch-panellarga ulash
- Telekommunikatsiya tugunlari: operator sinfidagi SM-uskunani kommutatsiya qilish
- Ma'lumot markazlari: bir modali optik liniyalar bilan stoyka ichidagi ulanishlar
- Magistral tarmoqlar: mijoz uskunasi tomonida kommutatsiya

## FAQ
Q: SM (bir modali) va MM (ko'p modali) patchkord o'rtasidagi farq nimada?
A: Bir modali SM patchkord bir modali transiverlar bilan ishlashga mo'ljallangan va kamroq so'nish bilan katta masofalarda ma'lumot uzatishni ta'minlaydi; ko'p modali variantlar tegishli transiverlar bilan ma'lumot markazlari doirasida ishlatiladi.
Q: SM-patchkordni ko'p modali transiver bilan ishlatish mumkinmi?
A: Yo'q, tola va transiver turlari mos kelishi kerak; SM va MM komponentlarni aralashtirish sezilarli signal yo'qotishlariga olib keladi.
Q: Patchkord SFP ulagichli uskuna uchun mosmi?
A: Ha, LC/UPC ulagichi aksariyat SFP va SFP+ bir modali transiverlar uchun standart hisoblanadi.

en.name: Optical patch cord LC/UPC SM Duplex, 1 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM duplex patch cord, 1 m: compact single-mode cord for in-rack patching with minimal loss. Buy in Tashkent.
en.description:
LC/UPC SM Duplex optical patch cord 1 m long from Pixietech — a compact single-mode connecting cable for in-rack switching of telecommunication and network equipment. SM single-mode fiber provides minimal signal loss and is used in systems designed for data transmission over long distances where appropriate transceivers are used. LC/UPC connectors with precise polishing ensure a reliable optical contact.

## Advantages
- SM single-mode fiber is suitable for equipment that works with single-mode transceivers
- The 1 m length is ideal for neat connection within a single rack or cabinet
- LC/UPC connectors ensure precise fiber centering and minimal insertion loss
- Duplex design allows organizing a bidirectional channel with a single cable
- The compact LC format saves space in densely populated patch panels
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech ensures reliability in the long term

## Applications
- Server racks: connecting single-mode SFP/SFP+ transceivers to patch panels
- Telecommunication nodes: switching carrier-class SM equipment
- Data centers: in-rack connections with single-mode optical lines
- Backbone networks: switching on the client equipment side

## FAQ
Q: What is the difference between an SM (single-mode) and MM (multimode) patch cord?
A: The SM single-mode patch cord is intended for working with single-mode transceivers and provides data transmission over long distances with less attenuation; multimode variants are used within data centers with appropriate transceivers.
Q: Can an SM patch cord be used with a multimode transceiver?
A: No, the types of fiber and transceivers must match; mixing SM and MM components leads to significant signal loss.
Q: Is the patch cord suitable for equipment with SFP connectors?
A: Yes, the LC/UPC connector is standard for most SFP and SFP+ single-mode transceivers.

tr.name: Optik patch kablo LC/UPC SM Duplex, 1 m

Pixietech'ten 1 m uzunluğundaki LC/UPC SM Duplex optik patch kordon — telekomünikasyon ve ağ ekipmanının rak içi anahtarlaması için kompakt tek modlu bir bağlantı kablosudur. SM tek modlu fiber, minimum sinyal kaybı sağlar ve uygun alıcı-vericilerin kullanıldığı uzun mesafelerde veri iletimi için tasarlanmış sistemlerde kullanılır. Hassas cilalı LC/UPC konektörler güvenilir optik temas sağlar.

## Avantajları
- SM tek modlu fiber, tek modlu alıcı-vericilerle çalışan ekipman için uygundur
- 1 m uzunluk, tek bir rak veya kabin içinde düzgün bağlantı için idealdir
- LC/UPC konektörler hassas fiber merkezlemesi ve minimum ekleme kaybı sağlar
- Dupleks yapı, tek bir kabloyla çift yönlü kanal düzenleme imkanı verir
- Kompakt LC formatı, yoğun dolu patch panellerde yer kazandırır
- Pixietech'ten 1 yıl garanti, uzun vadede güvenilirlik sağlar

## Uygulama alanları
- Sunucu rafları: tek modlu SFP/SFP+ alıcı-vericileri patch panellere bağlama
- Telekomünikasyon düğümleri: operatör sınıfı SM ekipmanını anahtarlama
- Veri merkezleri: tek modlu optik hatlarla rak içi bağlantılar
- Omurga ağları: istemci ekipmanı tarafında anahtarlama

## FAQ
Q: SM (tek modlu) ve MM (çok modlu) patch kordon arasındaki fark nedir?
A: SM tek modlu patch kordon, tek modlu alıcı-vericilerle çalışmak için tasarlanmıştır ve daha az zayıflama ile uzun mesafelerde veri iletimi sağlar; çok modlu varyantlar, uygun alıcı-vericilerle veri merkezleri içinde kullanılır.
Q: SM patch kordon çok modlu bir alıcı-verici ile kullanılabilir mi?
A: Hayır, fiber ve alıcı-verici türleri eşleşmelidir; SM ve MM bileşenleri karıştırmak önemli sinyal kaybına yol açar.
Q: Patch kordon SFP konektörlü ekipman için uygun mu?
A: Evet, LC/UPC konektörü çoğu SFP ve SFP+ tek modlu alıcı-verici için standarttır.

zh.name: 光纤跳线 LC/UPC SM Duplex，1 m
zh.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM 双工跳线，1 m：紧凑型单模跳线，用于机架内连接，损耗极低。塔什干购买。
zh.description:
Pixietech 出品的 1 m 长 LC/UPC SM Duplex 光纤跳线 — 是用于电信和网络设备机柜内切换的紧凑型单模连接电缆。SM 单模光纤提供最小的信号损耗，用于使用相应收发器进行长距离数据传输的系统中。精密研磨的 LC/UPC 连接器确保可靠的光学接触。

- SM 单模光纤适用于配合单模收发器工作的设备
- 1 m 长度非常适合单个机柜或机架内的整洁连接
- LC/UPC 连接器确保精确的光纤对中和最小插入损耗
- 双工设计可用单根电缆组织双向通道
- 紧凑的 LC 格式在密集填充的配线架中节省空间

- 服务器机架：将单模 SFP/SFP+ 收发器连接到配线架
- 电信节点：切换运营商级 SM 设备
- 数据中心：使用单模光纤线路的机柜内连接

Q: SM（单模）和 MM（多模）跳线之间有什么区别？
A: SM 单模跳线用于配合单模收发器工作，以更低的衰减提供长距离数据传输；多模变体在数据中心内配合相应的收发器使用。
Q: SM 跳线可以与多模收发器一起使用吗？
A: 不可以，光纤和收发器类型必须匹配；混用 SM 和 MM 组件会导致显著的信号损耗。
Q: 跳线适用于带 SFP 连接器的设备吗？
A: 是的，LC/UPC 连接器是大多数 SFP 和 SFP+ 单模收发器的标准。

en.name: Optical patch cord LC/UPC SM Duplex, 10 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM duplex patch cord, 10 m: single-mode fiber for server and telecom rooms with high signal quality. Delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
LC/UPC SM Duplex optical patch cord 10 m long from Pixietech — a single-mode connecting cable for switching equipment over distances of up to 10 meters in server halls, telecommunication rooms, and distributed network infrastructures. SM single-mode fiber with LC/UPC connectors ensures high signal quality and compatibility with a wide range of single-mode transceivers and active equipment. The duplex construction supports bidirectional data transmission.

## Advantages
- SM single-mode fiber ensures high signal quality for single-mode applications
- The 10 m length covers distances between racks within a single machine room
- LC/UPC connectors with UPC polishing reduce return loss and ensure a stable connection
- Duplex design allows simultaneously transmitting and receiving data
- The flexible cable sheath is convenient when laying in trays and cable organizers
- 1-year warranty confirms the product's compliance with Pixietech quality standards

## Applications
- Telecommunication nodes: switching single-mode equipment of communication operators
- Data centers: horizontal connections between racks with single-mode transceivers
- Corporate networks: connecting to backbone single-mode lines
- Video surveillance systems: optical switching based on single-mode transceivers

Q: Is this patch cord suitable for working with GPON equipment?
A: Single-mode LC/UPC patch cords are used in a number of GPON installations on the OLT side, however for specific equipment it is necessary to check against the manufacturer's requirements.

A: UPC (Ultra Physical Contact) is a type of connector end-face polishing that provides a low level of return loss and a reliable optical contact.

en.name: Optical patch cord LC/UPC SM Duplex, 2 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM Duplex patch cord, 2 m: single-mode fiber for telecom and security systems, signal transmission in both directions. Delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
LC/UPC SM Duplex optical patch cord 2 m long from Pixietech — a reliable connecting fiber for single-mode optical lines in telecommunication and security systems. The duplex design ensures signal transmission in both directions simultaneously, while UPC polishing guarantees minimal losses at the connectors. The short 2 m length is ideal for switching equipment inside a server cabinet or mounting rack.

## Advantages
- Low optical losses: UPC polishing ensures high purity of the connector end-face and a stable signal
- Duplex channel: two fibers in one cord allow transmitting and receiving data without additional connections
- SM single-mode fiber: suitable for high-speed and long-distance communication lines
- Compact LC connector: takes up minimal space on the patch panel, convenient for dense installation
- 2 m length: optimal for in-cabinet wiring without excess cable loops
- 1-year warranty: confirmed quality from the manufacturer Pixietech

## Applications
- Server rooms and data centers: switching active equipment inside a rack
- Video surveillance systems: connecting IP cameras and video recorders via optics
- Structured cabling systems: wiring in patch panels and optical cross-connects
- Telecommunication nodes: connecting switches and media converters
- Security and low-voltage systems: organizing backbone optical connections

## FAQ
Q: Is the patch cord suitable for multimode equipment?
A: No, this patch cord is made on SM single-mode fiber and is intended for single-mode systems; for multimode equipment, a cable marked MM is required.
Q: What does UPC polishing mean?
A: UPC (Ultra Physical Contact) is a type of connector end-face polishing with minimal back reflection, which ensures low insertion loss and a stable signal.
Q: Can a duplex patch cord be used instead of two simplex ones?
A: Yes, a duplex cord replaces two simplex ones, simplifies routing, and reduces the risk of confusing the TX/RX directions.

en.name: Optical patch cord LC/UPC SM Duplex, 20 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM Duplex patch cord, 20 m: two fibers in one cord for connecting adjacent rooms, floors and racks. With quality warranty and delivery.
en.description:
LC/UPC SM Duplex optical patch cord 20 m long from Pixietech is designed for routing single-mode optical connections between adjacent rooms, floors, or racks. The duplex construction combines two fibers in one cord, while LC/UPC connectors ensure a reliable and low-loss contact. The 20 m length is sufficient for most inter-room connections without the need to use splicing.

## Advantages
- 20 m length: covers distances between rooms or racks without additional connectors
- Duplex channel: transmission and reception in one cord simplify wiring and reduce the number of cables
- UPC polishing: minimal insertion loss and back reflection at the LC connectors
- SM single-mode fiber: high bandwidth for data and video signal transmission
- Compact LC connector: convenient when connecting to densely populated patch panels
- 1-year warranty: confirmed product quality from the Pixietech brand

## Applications
- Inter-floor connections in buildings: communication between cross-connects on different floors
- Video surveillance systems: connecting remote IP cameras and servers
- Corporate networks: horizontal wiring between switches and patch panels
- Security and low-voltage systems: backbone optical lines within a facility
- Telecommunication nodes: connecting equipment in different racks of the same room

## FAQ
Q: Can the patch cord be extended using an adapter?
A: Yes, two LC/UPC patch cords can be joined through an LC/UPC optical adapter, however each connection introduces additional losses, so it is better to choose a cord of the required length.
Q: What does the SM marking mean?
A: SM (Single Mode) means a single-mode fiber with a small core diameter, which is used for high-speed data transmission over long distances.
Q: Is the cord suitable for media converters?
A: Yes, most media converters with LC ports work with SM single-mode fiber, and this patch cord is fully compatible with such devices.

Q: SM 标记是什么意思？

Q: 该跳线适合媒体转换器吗？
A: 是的，大多数带 LC 端口的媒体转换器使用 SM 单模光纤工作，此跳线与此类设备完全兼容。

en.name: Optical patch cord LC/UPC SM Duplex, 25 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM duplex patch cord, 25 m: bidirectional data exchange over a single cord with minimal connector loss. In stock in Tashkent.
en.description:
The LC/UPC SM Duplex optical patch cord, 25 m long, from Pixietech is the optimal solution for running single-mode connections over medium distances inside buildings and technical rooms. The duplex design enables bidirectional data exchange over a single cord, while the LC connectors with UPC polishing ensure minimal signal loss. The 25 m length makes the cord convenient for connecting racks in different parts of one floor or in adjacent rooms.

## Advantages
- 25 m length: provides sufficient slack for routing without strain or sharp bends
- Duplex mode: two fibers in a single jacket reduce confusion during installation and operation
- UPC polishing: stable optical contact with low back reflection
- Single-mode SM fiber: suitable for high-speed data and video transmission channels
- LC connector: compact form factor for the dense ports of switches and patch panels
- 1-year warranty: guaranteed quality of the Pixietech product

## Applications
- Horizontal cabling within floors and rooms
- IP video surveillance systems: connecting switches to recording servers
- Office and industrial corporate networks
- Security systems: backbone optical channels within a facility
- Connecting active equipment in telecommunication nodes

## FAQ
Q: Is there a risk of damaging the fiber when routing over 25 m?
A: The fiber is rated for a specific bend radius; when the recommended radius is observed and the cord is carefully laid into cable trays, it serves the entire warranty period without damage.
Q: Is the patch cord compatible with equipment from other brands?
A: Yes, the LC/UPC connector is an international standard and is compatible with equipment from most manufacturers of network and telecommunication equipment.
Q: How does a duplex patch cord differ from a simplex one?
A: A duplex one contains two fibers — one for transmitting and one for receiving the signal, whereas a simplex one contains only one fiber.

Q: 25 m üzerinde döşeme yaparken fiberi zedeleme riski var mı?

en.name: Optical patch cord LC/UPC SM Duplex, 3 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM Duplex patch cord, 3 m: convenient routing in server cabinets and racks, a full-fledged bidirectional optical channel. In stock.
en.description:
The LC/UPC SM Duplex optical patch cord, 3 m long, from Pixietech is a practical solution for switching equipment in server cabinets and small mounting racks. Three meters of length give sufficient slack for convenient cable routing without unnecessary loops, while the duplex design provides a full bidirectional optical channel. The LC/UPC connectors with single-mode SM fiber are compatible with a wide range of active equipment.

## Advantages
- 3 m length: a comfortable length for routing between racks or devices at a short distance
- Duplex design: simplifies installation by replacing two separate simplex cords
- UPC polishing: minimal optical losses and reliable contact throughout the entire service life
- Single-mode SM fiber: high throughput for any data transmission tasks
- Compact LC connector: convenient when connecting to densely populated equipment ports
- 1-year warranty: quality confirmed by the manufacturer Pixietech

## Applications
- Server and telecommunication racks: in-cabinet switching of active equipment
- Video surveillance systems: connecting IP devices and switches in a mounting box
- Structured cabling systems: connection to optical cross-connects and patch panels
- Office networks: connecting switches to media converters
- Security systems: optical connections in the local nodes of a facility

## FAQ
Q: Can this patch cord be used for outdoor installation?
A: No, this cord is intended for indoor use; for outdoor installation, a cable with a protective outer jacket is required.
Q: How does LC differ from the SC connector?
A: The LC connector is roughly half the size of the SC, which allows more ports to be placed in a rack; both standards are widely used in equipment.
Q: Is special cleaning of the connectors required before connection?
A: It is recommended to inspect the connector end face before each connection and, if necessary, wipe it with a special tool to avoid losses due to contamination.

- Corporate and departmental local networks
- Security and fire systems: optical backbones at a facility
- Telecommunication nodes and data centers

## FAQ
Q: How should a patch cord of this length be stored correctly?
A: The cord should be stored in a coil with a diameter no less than the recommended minimum bend radius, secured with a soft tie, so as not to damage the fiber.
Q: Does the cord length affect signal attenuation?
A: Over short and medium distances of up to several dozen meters, attenuation in the fiber itself is negligible; the main losses are introduced by connectors in case of poor contact or contamination.
Q: Is this patch cord compatible with GPON equipment?
A: Yes, provided the equipment has LC/UPC ports for single-mode fiber, this cord is suitable for connection.

tr.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM çift yönlü patch kablo, 30 m: konnektörlerde düşük ekleme kayıbıyla bina katları ve bölgeleri arasında bağlantı. Garantili satın alın.
tr.description:
Pixietech'in 30 m uzunluğundaki LC/UPC SM Duplex optik patch kablosu, 30 metreye kadar mesafede güvenilir tek modlu optik bağlantı sağlar — katlar, teknik odalar veya binanın ayrı bölgeleri arasındaki iletişim için kullanışlıdır. Bu uzunluk, engellerin etrafından dolaşmayı hesaba katarak kabloyu döşemeye olanak tanır ve eklemeye başvurmaya gerek bırakmaz.

## Avantajlar
- 30 m uzunluk: döşeme payıyla birlikte katlar arası ve bölgeler arası bağlantılar için yeterli
- Dupleks mod: tek kablo iki simpleksi değiştirir ve kablo yönetimini basitleştirir
- UPC parlatma: yüksek optik temas kalitesi, düşük geri yansıma
- Tek modlu SM fiber: yüksek hızlı ağlar ve video gözetim sistemleri için uygundur
- LC konnektör: modern ağ ekipmanları için fiili standart
- 1 yıl garanti: Pixietech'ten garantili güvenilirlik

## Kullanım alanları
- Ofis ve endüstriyel binalarda katlar arası optik bağlantılar
- IP video gözetim: anahtarlama düğümleri ve sunucular arasındaki iletişim
- Kurumsal ve kurumlar arası yerel ağlar
- Güvenlik ve yangın sistemleri: tesisteki optik ana hatlar

## FAQ
Q: Bu uzunluktaki patch kablosu nasıl doğru saklanır?
A: Kablo, önerilen minimum bükülme yarıçapından az olmayan çapta bir bobinde, yumuşak bir bağ ile sabitlenerek saklanmalıdır, böylece fiber zarar görmez.
Q: Kablo uzunluğu sinyal zayıflamasını etkiler mi?

Q: Bu patch kablosu GPON ekipmanlarıyla uyumlu mu?

zh.name: 光纤跳线 LC/UPC SM Duplex，30 m
zh.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM 双工跳线，30 m：连接建筑物楼层和区域，接口插入损耗低。购买享质保。
zh.description:
Pixietech 的 30 米 LC/UPC SM Duplex 光纤跳线可在最长 30 米的距离上提供可靠的单模光纤连接——便于楼层、技术机房或建筑独立区域之间的连接。配备 LC 连接器和 UPC 研磨的双工跳线可保证低插入损耗和稳定信号。这一长度允许在考虑绕过障碍物的情况下敷设线缆，而无需进行熔接。

## 优势
- 30 米长度：足以满足带布线余量的楼层间和区域间连接
- 双工模式：单根跳线替代两根单工跳线，简化线缆管理
- UPC 研磨：光学接触质量高，回波反射低
- 单模 SM 光纤：适用于高速网络和视频监控系统
- LC 连接器：现代网络设备的事实标准
- 1 年质保：来自 Pixietech 的可靠性保证

## 应用领域
- 办公和工业楼宇中的楼层间光纤连接
- IP 视频监控：交换节点与服务器之间的连接
- 企业和部门局域网
- 安防与消防系统：设施内的光纤骨干
- 电信节点和数据中心

## FAQ
Q: 这种长度的跳线应如何正确存放？
A: 跳线应盘绕存放，盘绕直径不小于推荐的最小弯曲半径，并用柔软的扎带固定，以免损坏光纤。
Q: 跳线长度会影响信号衰减吗？
A: 在几十米以内的短、中距离上，光纤本身的衰减微乎其微；主要损耗由接触不良或污染情况下的连接器造成。
Q: 该跳线是否与 GPON 设备兼容？
A: 是的，只要设备具备用于单模光纤的 LC/UPC 端口，该跳线即适合连接。

uz.name: Optik patchkord LC/UPC SM Duplex, 40 m
uz.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM dupleks patchkordi, 40 m: ob'ektning korpuslari va tugunlari orasidagi uzun trassalar uchun bir modali tola. O‘zbekiston bo‘ylab yetkazib berish.
uz.description:
Pixietech kompaniyasidan 40 m uzunlikdagi LC/UPC SM Duplex optik patchkord binolar ichidagi uzun trassalarda optik ulanishlarni yotqizish uchun mo'ljallangan: uzoq xonalar, korpuslar yoki bir ob'ektdagi texnik tugunlar o'rtasida. LC/UPC ulagichlariga ega dupleks bir modali tola qo'shimcha payvandlashlarsiz yuqori uzatish tezligi va minimal yo'qotishlarni ta'minlaydi. 40 m uzunlik qurilish konstruksiyalarini aylanib o'tib yotqizish uchun yetarli zaxira beradi.

## Afzalliklari
- 40 m uzunlik: payvandlash zaruratisiz uzun ob'ekt ichidagi trassalarni qoplaydi
- Bir modali SM tola: yuqori o'tkazuvchanlik va zamonaviy tizimlar bilan moslik
- Dupleks rejim: bitta qobiqdagi ikki tola — bitta shnurda uzatish va qabul qilish
- LC/UPC ulagich: past aks ettirish, ishonchli mahkamlanish, uskunalarning keng qatori bilan moslik
- Montaj qulayligi: shnur ulanishga tayyor holda yetkaziladi, dala yig'ish zaruratisiz

- Yirik ofis binolari: uzoq qavatlardagi yoki turli qanotlardagi krosslarni ulash
- Sanoat ob'ektlari: sexlar yoki ishlab chiqarish uchastkalari o'rtasidagi optik liniyalar

- Xavfsizlik tizimlari: boshqaruv va monitoring magistral optik kanallari

Q: Patchkordni kuch kabellari bilan birga kabel lotoklariga yotqizish mumkinmi?

Q: Shnur lotokda gorizontal yotqizishda yukni ko'taradimi?
A: Patchkordlar tortuvchi yuklarsiz yotqizish uchun mo'ljallangan; lotokda gorizontal yotqizishda shnurni muntazam oraliqlarda yumshoq tortma bilan mahkamlang.
Q: Ulagich chang bilan ifloslangan bo'lsa nima qilish kerak?
A: LC-ulagichlar uchlari uchun maxsus tozalovchi asbobdan foydalaning — bu optik kontaktni tiklaydi va signal yo'qotishlarini bartaraf etadi.

en.name: Optical patch cord LC/UPC SM Duplex, 40 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM duplex patch cord, 40 m: single-mode fiber for long routes between buildings and nodes of a site. Delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
The LC/UPC SM Duplex optical patch cord, 40 m long, from Pixietech is designed for routing optical connections along extended runs inside buildings: between remote rooms, blocks, or technical nodes at a single facility. The duplex single-mode fiber with LC/UPC connectors ensures high transmission speed and minimal losses without additional splices. The 40 m length provides sufficient slack for routing around building structures.

## Advantages
- 40 m length: covers extended on-site runs without the need for splicing
- Single-mode SM fiber: high throughput and compatibility with modern systems
- Duplex mode: two fibers in a single jacket — transmit and receive in one cord
- LC/UPC connector: low reflection, reliable locking, compatibility with a wide range of equipment
- Ease of installation: the cord is supplied ready for connection, without the need for field assembly
- 1-year warranty: factory quality of the Pixietech product

## Applications
- Large office buildings: connecting cross-connects on remote floors or in different wings
- Industrial facilities: optical lines between workshops or production areas
- Video surveillance systems: routing fiber from switches to server rooms
- Educational and medical institutions: building on-site network infrastructure
- Security systems: backbone optical channels for control and monitoring

## FAQ
Q: Can the patch cord be laid in cable trays together with power cables?
A: Optical fiber is not susceptible to electromagnetic interference, so it can be routed next to power cables while observing mechanical protection from damage.
Q: Will the cord withstand the load during horizontal routing in a tray?
A: Patch cords are intended for routing without tensile loads; during horizontal laying in a tray, secure the cord with soft ties at regular intervals.
Q: What should be done if the connector is contaminated with dust?
A: Use a special cleaning tool for LC connector end faces — this will restore the optical contact and eliminate signal losses.

tr.name: Optik patch kablo LC/UPC SM Duplex, 40 m

LC/UPC konnektörlü dupleks tek modlu fiber, ek eklemeler olmadan yüksek iletim hızı ve minimum kayıp sağlar. 40 m uzunluk, yapı elemanlarının etrafından dolaşarak döşeme için yeterli pay sağlar.

## Avantajlar
- 40 m uzunluk: ekleme gerektirmeden uzun tesis içi güzergahları kapsar
- Tek modlu SM fiber: yüksek bant genişliği ve modern sistemlerle uyumluluk
- Dupleks mod: tek kılıftaki iki fiber — tek kabloda iletim ve alım
- LC/UPC konnektör: düşük yansıma, güvenilir kilitlenme, geniş ekipman yelpazesiyle uyumluluk
- Montaj kolaylığı: kablo bağlantıya hazır olarak teslim edilir, saha montajına gerek yoktur
- 1 yıl garanti: Pixietech ürününün fabrika kalitesi

## Kullanım alanları
- Büyük ofis binaları: uzak katlardaki veya farklı kanatlardaki krosların bağlanması
- Endüstriyel tesisler: atölyeler veya üretim alanları arasındaki optik hatlar
- Video gözetim sistemleri: switch'lerden sunucu odalarına fiber döşeme
- Eğitim ve tıbbi kurumlar: tesis içi ağ altyapısının kurulması
- Güvenlik sistemleri: kontrol ve izleme için ana hat optik kanalları

## FAQ
Q: Patch kablosu güç kablolarıyla birlikte kablo kanallarına döşenebilir mi?
A: Optik fiber elektromanyetik girişimden etkilenmez, bu nedenle hasara karşı mekanik korumaya uyularak güç kablolarının yanına döşenebilir.
Q: Kablo, kanalda yatay döşeme sırasında yüke dayanır mı?
A: Patch kabloları çekme yükü olmadan döşeme için tasarlanmıştır; kanalda yatay döşeme sırasında kabloyu düzenli aralıklarla yumuşak bağlarla sabitleyin.
Q: Konnektör tozla kirlenmişse ne yapılmalı?
A: LC konnektör uç yüzeyleri için özel bir temizleme aleti kullanın — bu, optik teması geri kazandırır ve sinyal kayıplarını giderir.

zh.name: 光纤跳线 LC/UPC SM Duplex，40 m
zh.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM 双工跳线，40 m：单模光纤，用于场区楼栋和节点之间的长距离线路。全乌兹别克斯坦配送。
zh.description:
Pixietech 的 40 米 LC/UPC SM Duplex 光纤跳线专为在楼宇内部较长线路上敷设光纤连接而设计：用于远端房间、楼栋或同一设施内技术节点之间。配备 LC/UPC 连接器的双工单模光纤可在无需额外熔接的情况下确保高传输速率和最小损耗。40 米的长度为绕过建筑结构敷设提供了充足余量。

## 优势
- 40 米长度：无需熔接即可覆盖较长的设施内线路
- 单模 SM 光纤：高吞吐量并与现代系统兼容
- 双工模式：单一外护套内两根光纤——单根跳线实现收发
- LC/UPC 连接器：反射低、锁定可靠，与广泛的设备兼容
- 安装便捷：跳线以即插即用状态供货，无需现场组装

## 应用领域
- 大型办公楼：连接远端楼层或不同侧翼的配线架
- 工业设施：车间或生产区之间的光纤线路
- 视频监控系统：从交换机到服务器机房敷设光纤

- 安防系统：用于控制和监控的骨干光纤通道

## FAQ
Q: 跳线能否与电力电缆一起敷设在线缆桥架中？
A: 光纤不受电磁干扰影响，因此可在做好防损伤机械保护的前提下敷设于电力电缆旁。
Q: 跳线在桥架中水平敷设时能否承受载荷？
A: 跳线设计用于无拉伸载荷的敷设；在桥架中水平敷设时，请用柔软扎带按规则间隔固定跳线。
Q: 如果连接器被灰尘污染该怎么办？
A: 使用专用于 LC 连接器端面的清洁工具——这将恢复光学接触并消除信号损耗。

uz.name: Optik patchkord LC/UPC SM Duplex, 5 m
uz.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM dupleks patchkordi, 5 m: qo‘shni stoykalar orasida qulay yotqizish, to‘liq qiymatli ikki tomonlama aloqa kanali. Kafolat bilan mavjud.

Pixietech kompaniyasidan 5 m uzunlikdagi LC/UPC SM Duplex optik patchkord — server stoykalari, montaj shkaflari va telekommunikatsiya tugunlarida uskunalarni kommutatsiya qilish uchun universal yechim. Besh metr uzunlik shnurni shkaf ichida yoki qo'shni stoykalar o'rtasida qulay yotqizishga imkon beradi, dupleks konstruksiya esa to'liq ikki yo'nalishli optik kanalni ta'minlaydi. Bir modali tolali LC/UPC ulagichlari minimal yo'qotishlar va yetakchi ishlab chiqaruvchilarning uskunalari bilan moslikni kafolatlaydi.

- 5 m uzunlik: bitta xona doirasidagi stoykalar yoki qurilmalar o'rtasida tarqatish uchun yetarli
- Dupleks konstruksiya: montajni va ekspluatatsiyada kabellarni aniqlashni soddalashtiradi

- Bir modali SM tola: ma'lumot va video uzatish tarmoqlari uchun yuqori o'tkazuvchanlik
- Ixcham LC ulagich: zamonaviy kommutatorlar, mediakonvertorlar va ODF bilan mos

- Server va tarmoq stoykalari: faol uskunalarni kommutatsiya qilish

Q: Bu shnur ko'p modali transiver uchun mos keladimi?

en.name: Optical patch cord LC/UPC SM Duplex, 5 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM duplex patch cord, 5 m: convenient routing between adjacent racks, a full-fledged bidirectional communication channel. In stock with warranty.
en.description:
The LC/UPC SM Duplex optical patch cord, 5 m long, from Pixietech is a versatile solution for switching equipment in server racks, mounting cabinets, and telecommunication nodes. Five meters of length allow the cord to be conveniently routed within a cabinet or between adjacent racks, while the duplex design provides a full bidirectional optical channel. The LC/UPC connectors with single-mode fiber guarantee minimal losses and compatibility with equipment from leading manufacturers.

## Advantages
- 5 m length: sufficient for routing between racks or devices within a single room
- Duplex design: simplifies installation and cable identification during operation
- UPC polishing: provides stable optical contact and low back reflection
- Single-mode SM fiber: high throughput for data and video transmission networks
- Compact LC connector: compatible with modern switches, media converters, and ODFs
- 1-year warranty: confirmed quality from Pixietech

## Applications
- Server and network racks: switching of active equipment
- Optical distribution frames (ODF): connection to passive components
- IP video surveillance systems: connecting switches in a local node
- Office and corporate networks: horizontal routing in mounting cabinets
- Security and low-current systems: optical connections in switching nodes

## FAQ
Q: Is this cord suitable for a multimode transceiver?
A: No, multimode transceivers require multimode fiber (OM2/OM3/OM4); this patch cord is intended exclusively for single-mode devices.
Q: Can the patch cord be shortened?
A: It is not recommended: trimming the cord requires re-polishing the connector end face under factory conditions, otherwise losses at the connector will increase sharply.
Q: How critical is the patch cord length for signal quality?
A: At such distances, attenuation in the fiber is minimal; more important is the quality of the connector mating — the cleanliness of the end face and proper locking of the connector.

tr.name: Optik patch kablo LC/UPC SM Duplex, 5 m

tr.description:
Pixietech'in 5 m uzunluğundaki LC/UPC SM Duplex optik patch kablosu — sunucu rafları, montaj kabinetleri ve telekomünikasyon düğümlerinde ekipman anahtarlama için çok yönlü bir çözümdür. Tek modlu fiberli LC/UPC konnektörler minimum kayıp ve önde gelen üreticilerin ekipmanlarıyla uyumluluk garanti eder.

## Avantajlar
- 5 m uzunluk: tek bir oda içinde raflar veya cihazlar arasında döşeme için yeterli
- Dupleks yapı: montajı ve işletim sırasında kablo tanımlamayı basitleştirir
- UPC parlatma: kararlı optik temas ve düşük geri yansıma sağlar
- Tek modlu SM fiber: veri ve video iletim ağları için yüksek bant genişliği
- Kompakt LC konnektör: modern switch'ler, medya dönüştürücüler ve ODF'lerle uyumlu
- 1 yıl garanti: Pixietech'ten onaylanmış kalite

## Kullanım alanları
- Sunucu ve ağ rafları: aktif ekipmanın anahtarlanması
- Optik dağıtım çerçeveleri (ODF): pasif bileşenlere bağlantı
- IP video gözetim sistemleri: yerel bir düğümde switch'lerin bağlanması
- Ofis ve kurumsal ağlar: montaj kabinetlerinde yatay döşeme
- Güvenlik ve zayıf akım sistemleri: anahtarlama düğümlerindeki optik bağlantılar

## FAQ
Q: Bu kablo çok modlu bir alıcı-verici için uygun mu?
A: Hayır, çok modlu alıcı-vericiler için çok modlu fiber (OM2/OM3/OM4) gereklidir; bu patch kablosu yalnızca tek modlu cihazlar için tasarlanmıştır.
Q: Patch kablosu kısaltılabilir mi?
A: Önerilmez: kabloyu kesmek, konnektör uç yüzeyinin fabrika koşullarında yeniden parlatılmasını gerektirir, aksi takdirde konnektördeki kayıplar keskin biçimde artar.
Q: Patch kablosu uzunluğu sinyal kalitesi için ne kadar kritik?
A: Bu mesafelerde fiberdeki zayıflama minimumdur; daha önemlisi konnektör bağlantısının kalitesidir — uç yüzeyin temizliği ve konnektörün doğru sabitlenmesi.

zh.name: 光纤跳线 LC/UPC SM Duplex，5 m

zh.description:
Pixietech 的 5 米 LC/UPC SM Duplex 光纤跳线是在服务器机架、安装机柜和电信节点中进行设备跳接的多功能方案。五米的长度可使跳线在机柜内或相邻机架之间方便地敷设，而双工设计提供了完整的双向光通道。配备单模光纤的 LC/UPC 连接器可保证最小损耗以及与领先制造商设备的兼容性。

## 优势
- 5 米长度：足以满足单一房间内机架或设备之间的布线
- 双工设计：简化安装并便于使用中识别线缆
- UPC 研磨：提供稳定的光学接触和低回波反射
- 单模 SM 光纤：满足数据和视频传输网络的高吞吐量
- 紧凑型 LC 连接器：与现代交换机、光电转换器和 ODF 兼容
- 1 年质保：来自 Pixietech 的确认品质

## 应用领域
- 服务器和网络机架：有源设备的跳接
- 光纤配线架（ODF）：连接至无源组件
- IP 视频监控系统：在本地节点连接交换机
- 办公和企业网络：安装机柜内的水平布线
- 安防和弱电系统：交换节点中的光纤连接

## FAQ
Q: 该跳线是否适用于多模光模块？
A: 不适用，多模光模块需要多模光纤（OM2/OM3/OM4）；该跳线仅适用于单模设备。
Q: 跳线可以剪短吗？
A: 不建议：剪短跳线需要在工厂条件下重新研磨连接器端面，否则连接器处的损耗会急剧增加。
Q: 跳线长度对信号质量有多关键？
A: 在此类距离上，光纤中的衰减极小；更重要的是连接器对接的质量——端面的清洁度和连接器的正确锁定。

Q: Bu patchkordni GPON tizimlarida qo'llash mumkinmi?

en.name: LC/UPC SM Duplex optical patch cord, 50 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM Duplex patch cord, 50 m: long-distance connections in malls, office buildings and factories without extra splices. Buy in Tashkent.
en.description:
The LC/UPC SM Duplex optical patch cord, 50 m long, from Pixietech is a solution for optical connections over considerable distances within large facilities: administrative buildings, shopping centers, production complexes. The duplex single-mode cord with LC/UPC connectors eliminates the need for additional couplers and fusion splices where the run fits within 50 meters. The finished factory product with a warranty installs quickly and without specialized splicing tools.

## Advantages
- 50 m length: covers long cable runs within a facility without splicing
- Factory assembly: the LC/UPC connectors are polished and tested at the factory, which eliminates installation errors
- Duplex channel: two fibers in a single cord for transmitting and receiving
- Single-mode SM fiber: supports high-speed networks and surveillance systems
- No splice losses: a continuous cord provides better characteristics than fused fragments
- 1-year warranty: the Pixietech product meets quality standards

## Applications
- Large facilities: retail, business centers, industrial enterprises
- Video surveillance systems: optical backbones from camera nodes to server rooms
- Corporate networks: connecting distribution cross-connects on remote sections of a floor
- Security and fire systems: extended on-site optical lines
- Educational and medical institutions with large building areas

## FAQ
Q: How does a 50 m patch cord differ from an ordinary cable with connectors?
A: A patch cord is a finished factory product with polished connectors and stable characteristics; self-termination of a cable requires equipment and skills, and the result is of lower quality.
Q: Are special fasteners needed for laying a 50-meter cord?
A: It is recommended to lay the cord in cable trays or corrugated conduit and secure it with soft ties every 50-100 cm to avoid kinks and strain.
Q: Can this patch cord be used in GPON systems?
A: Yes, if the equipment is fitted with LC/UPC ports for single-mode fiber, this cord is compatible with such systems.

Garantili hazır fabrika ürünü, hızlı ve özel eritme aleti olmadan kurulur.

## Avantajlar
- 50 m uzunluk: ekleme olmadan tesis içindeki uzun kablo güzergahlarını kapsar
- Fabrika montajı: LC/UPC konnektörler fabrikada parlatılır ve test edilir, bu da montaj hatalarını ortadan kaldırır
- Dupleks kanal: iletim ve alım için tek kabloda iki fiber
- Tek modlu SM fiber: yüksek hızlı ağları ve gözetim sistemlerini destekler
- Ekleme kaybı yok: bütün bir kablo, eritilmiş parçalardan daha iyi özellikler sağlar
- 1 yıl garanti: Pixietech ürünü kalite standartlarına uygundur

## Kullanım alanları
- Büyük tesisler: perakende, iş merkezleri, sanayi işletmeleri
- Video gözetim sistemleri: kamera düğümlerinden sunucu odalarına optik ana hatlar
- Kurumsal ağlar: bir katın uzak bölümlerindeki dağıtım kroslarının bağlanması
- Güvenlik ve yangın sistemleri: tesis içi uzun optik hatlar
- Geniş bina alanlı eğitim ve tıbbi kurumlar

## FAQ
Q: 50 m patch kablosu, konnektörlü sıradan bir kablodan ne ile farklıdır?
A: Patch kablosu, parlatılmış konnektörlere ve kararlı özelliklere sahip hazır bir fabrika ürünüdür; bir kabloyu kendi başına sonlandırmak ekipman ve beceri gerektirir, sonuç ise kalite açısından daha düşüktür.
Q: 50 metrelik bir kablonun döşenmesi için özel sabitleyiciler gerekli mi?
A: Kablonun kablo kanallarına veya spiral boruya döşenmesi ve bükülme ile gerilmeyi önlemek için her 50-100 cm'de yumuşak bağlarla sabitlenmesi önerilir.
Q: Bu patch kablosu GPON sistemlerinde kullanılabilir mi?
A: Evet, ekipman tek modlu fiber için LC/UPC portlarıyla donatılmışsa, bu kablo bu tür sistemlerle uyumludur.

- 工厂组装：LC/UPC 连接器在工厂经过研磨和测试，可消除安装错误

Q: 敷设 50 米跳线是否需要专用固定件？
A: 建议将跳线敷设于线缆桥架或波纹管中，并每 50-100 厘米用柔软扎带固定，以避免折弯和张力。
Q: 该跳线能否用于 GPON 系统？
A: 可以，如果设备配备用于单模光纤的 LC/UPC 端口，该跳线即与此类系统兼容。

A: Simpleks bitta tolani o'z ichiga oladi va signalni bitta yo'nalishda uzatadi; to'liq dupleks kanal uchun ikkita simpleks shnur yoki bitta dupleks kerak.

en.name: LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 1 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 1 m: a compact simplex cord for neat patching inside a single telecom cabinet. In stock, with warranty.
en.description:
The LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 1 m long, from Pixietech is a compact simplex cord for switching single-mode equipment in server racks and telecommunication cabinets. The 1 m length is suitable for connection within a single cabinet, where neat, minimalist routing without unnecessary loops is important. The LC/UPC connector ensures reliable optical contact with minimal insertion losses.

## Advantages
- 1 m length: ideal for in-cabinet connections — no excess loops or clutter
- Simplex format: a single fiber for the targeted connection of a specific port
- UPC polishing: high quality of the connector end face, low back reflection
- Single-mode SM fiber: compatibility with modern active equipment with LC ports
- Compact LC connector: maximum mounting density on a patch panel or ODF
- 1-year warranty: confirmed quality of the Pixietech product

## Applications
- Server racks and mounting cabinets: switching transceivers, switches, and ODFs
- Optical cross-connects: connecting adapters to active equipment
- Video surveillance systems: connection at the switching point
- Telecommunication nodes: connecting media converters and subscriber devices
- Laboratory and test benches: temporary connection of equipment

## FAQ
Q: How does a simplex patch cord differ from a duplex one?
A: A simplex one contains a single fiber and transmits the signal in one direction; for a full-duplex channel, two simplex cords or one duplex cord are needed.
Q: Is a one-meter cord suitable for connecting to an SFP transceiver?
A: Yes, most SFP transceivers have LC ports, and 1 m of length is sufficient to connect a transceiver to an optical cross-connect within a rack.
Q: How can the connector be protected when the patch cord is not connected?
A: Use dust caps for LC connectors — they are included in the kit or sold separately and protect the end face from contamination.

LC/UPC konnektör, minimum ekleme kaybıyla güvenilir optik temas sağlar.

## Avantajlar
- 1 m uzunluk: kabin içi bağlantılar için ideal — fazla halka ve karmaşa yok
- Simpleks format: belirli bir portun hedefli bağlantısı için tek bir fiber
- UPC parlatma: konnektör uç yüzeyinin yüksek kalitesi, düşük geri yansıma
- Tek modlu SM fiber: LC portlu modern aktif ekipmanla uyumluluk
- Kompakt LC konnektör: patch panel veya ODF üzerinde maksimum montaj yoğunluğu
- 1 yıl garanti: Pixietech ürününün onaylanmış kalitesi

## Kullanım alanları
- Sunucu rafları ve montaj kabinetleri: alıcı-vericilerin, switch'lerin ve ODF'lerin anahtarlanması
- Optik kroslar: adaptörlerin aktif ekipmanla bağlanması
- Video gözetim sistemleri: anahtarlama noktasında bağlantı
- Telekomünikasyon düğümleri: medya dönüştürücülerin ve abone cihazlarının bağlanması
- Laboratuvar ve test tezgahları: ekipmanın geçici bağlantısı

## FAQ
Q: Simpleks patch kablosu dupleksten ne ile farklıdır?
A: Simpleks tek bir fiber içerir ve sinyali tek yönde iletir; tam dupleks kanal için iki simpleks kablo veya bir dupleks kablo gereklidir.
Q: Bir metrelik kablo bir SFP alıcı-vericisine bağlanmak için uygun mu?
A: Evet, çoğu SFP alıcı-vericisinin LC portu vardır ve 1 m uzunluk, bir alıcı-vericiyi raf içindeki bir optik krosa bağlamak için yeterlidir.
Q: Patch kablosu bağlı değilken konnektör nasıl korunur?
A: LC konnektörleri için toz koruma kapakları kullanın — bunlar sete dahildir veya ayrı satılır ve uç yüzeyi kirlenmeden korur.

- 单工格式：单根光纤用于特定端口的定向连接
- UPC 研磨：连接器端面质量高，回波反射低

- 服务器机架和安装机柜：光模块、交换机和 ODF 的跳接
- 光纤配线架：将适配器连接至有源设备
- 视频监控系统：在跳接点处的连接

Q: 单工跳线与双工跳线有何区别？

Q: 一米跳线是否适合连接 SFP 光模块？

en.name: LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 10 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 10 m: a simplex single-mode cord for neat routing between adjacent racks. Delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
The LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 10 m long, from Pixietech is a versatile simplex cord for routing single-mode optical lines within a single room or between adjacent racks. Ten meters of length provide sufficient slack for neat cable routing in a tray or along a wall without strain. The LC connector with UPC polishing guarantees a reliable, low-loss connection.

## Advantages
- 10 m length: a versatile length for most in-room optical connections
- UPC polishing: low insertion loss and back reflection at the LC connector
- Single-mode SM fiber: supports high-speed data transmission and video signal
- Simplex design: flexibility in building non-standard connection topologies
- Compact LC connector: compatible with switches, media converters, and ODFs
- 1-year warranty: the quality standard of Pixietech products

## Applications
- In-room switching in server and network rooms
- Video surveillance systems: connecting camera switches to recording equipment
- Corporate networks: horizontal routing in mounting cabinets
- Optical cross-connects and patch panels: connection to active equipment
- Security systems: optical connections in local nodes

## FAQ
Q: Can a simplex cord be used for WDM multiplexing?
A: Yes, when WDM transceivers are used, a single simplex cord can carry several wavelengths simultaneously in one direction.
Q: What happens if the fiber is bent too sharply?
A: Too small a bend radius leads to a sharp increase in losses and potential mechanical damage to the fiber; observe the minimum radius specified in the documentation.
Q: Is the patch cord compatible with Huawei, Cisco, MikroTik equipment?
A: Yes, the LC/UPC connector is an industry standard and is compatible with the LC ports of most leading manufacturers of network equipment.

On metrelik uzunluk, kablonun bir kanalda veya duvar boyunca gerginlik olmadan düzgün döşenmesi için yeterli pay sağlar. UPC parlatmalı LC konnektör, güvenilir ve düşük kayıplı bağlantı garanti eder.

## Avantajlar
- 10 m uzunluk: çoğu oda içi optik bağlantı için çok yönlü bir uzunluk
- UPC parlatma: LC konnektörde düşük ekleme kaybı ve geri yansıma
- Tek modlu SM fiber: yüksek hızlı veri iletimini ve video sinyalini destekler
- Simpleks yapı: standart dışı bağlantı topolojileri kurmada esneklik
- Kompakt LC konnektör: switch'ler, medya dönüştürücüler ve ODF'lerle uyumlu
- 1 yıl garanti: Pixietech ürünlerinin kalite standardı

## Kullanım alanları
- Sunucu ve ağ odalarında oda içi anahtarlama
- Video gözetim sistemleri: kamera switch'lerinin kayıt ekipmanıyla bağlanması
- Kurumsal ağlar: montaj kabinetlerinde yatay döşeme
- Optik kroslar ve patch paneller: aktif ekipmana bağlantı
- Güvenlik sistemleri: yerel düğümlerdeki optik bağlantılar

## FAQ
Q: Simpleks kablo WDM çoğullama için kullanılabilir mi?
A: Evet, WDM alıcı-vericileri kullanıldığında, tek bir simpleks kablo tek yönde aynı anda birkaç dalga boyu taşıyabilir.
Q: Fiber çok keskin bükülürse ne olur?
A: Çok küçük bir bükülme yarıçapı, kayıpların keskin biçimde artmasına ve fiberin olası mekanik hasarına yol açar; belgelerde belirtilen minimum yarıçapa uyun.
Q: Patch kablosu Huawei, Cisco, MikroTik ekipmanlarıyla uyumlu mu?
A: Evet, LC/UPC konnektörü bir endüstri standardıdır ve çoğu önde gelen ağ ekipmanı üreticisinin LC portlarıyla uyumludur.

zh.name: LC/UPC SM 光纤跳线，10 米
zh.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM 光纤跳线，10 米：用于相邻机架间整洁布线的单工单模跳线。全乌兹别克斯坦配送。
zh.description:
Pixietech 的 10 米 LC/UPC SM 光纤跳线是用于在单一房间内或相邻机架之间敷设单模光纤线路的多功能单工跳线。十米的长度为在桥架中或沿墙无张力地整洁布线提供了充足余量。带 UPC 研磨的 LC 连接器可保证可靠、低损耗的连接。

## 优势
- 10 米长度：适用于大多数室内光纤连接的通用长度
- UPC 研磨：LC 连接器处插入损耗和回波反射低
- 单模 SM 光纤：支持高速数据传输和视频信号
- 单工设计：构建非标准连接拓扑时具备灵活性
- 紧凑型 LC 连接器：与交换机、光电转换器和 ODF 兼容
- 1 年质保：Pixietech 产品的质量标准

## 应用领域
- 服务器和网络机房内的室内跳接
- 视频监控系统：将摄像机交换机连接至录像设备
- 企业网络：安装机柜内的水平布线

## FAQ
Q: 单工跳线能否用于 WDM 复用？

Q: 如果光纤弯曲过度会怎样？
A: 弯曲半径过小会导致损耗急剧增加并可能造成光纤的机械损伤；请遵守文档中规定的最小半径。
Q: 该跳线是否与华为、思科、MikroTik 设备兼容？
A: 是的，LC/UPC 连接器是行业标准，与大多数领先网络设备制造商的 LC 端口兼容。

uz.name: Optik patchkord LC/UPC SM, 15 m

uz.description:

LC/UPC ulagichli simpleks shnur bir yo'nalishda yagona optik kanal talab qilinganda tarmoq infratuzilmasida moslashuvchan tarqatish uchun qulay. 15 m uzunlik to'siqlarni aylanib o'tishni hisobga olib kabelni lotok bo'ylab yotqizishga imkon beradi.

- 15 m uzunlik: qo'shni xonalar yoki montaj shkaflari o'rtasidagi ulanish uchun optimal

- UPC silliqlash: barqaror kontakt, kichik so'nish va teskari aks ettirish
- Simpleks format: bir yo'nalishli yoki WDM kanallarni qurishda moslashuvchanlik
- LC ulagich: ixcham va keng qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan ulanish standarti

- Ofis va texnik xonalardagi xonalararo optik ulanishlar

- Telekommunikatsiya tugunlari: uskunani moslashuvchan kommutatsiya qilish

## FAQ
Q: 15 m patchkordni kattaroq uzunlikgacha o'stirish mumkinmi?
A: LC/UPC-adapter orqali ulash mumkin, ammo har bir ulanish yo'qotishlarni qo'shadi; darhol kerakli uzunlikdagi shnurni tanlash yaxshiroq.
Q: Maxsus uskunasiz tolaning butunligini qanday tekshirish mumkin?
A: Fonarik yorug'ligini ulagichning bir uchiga yo'naltiring: agar yorug'lik boshqa uchda ko'rinsa, tola shikastlanmagan.
Q: Patchkordni devor orqali o'tkazish uchun maxsus mufta kerakmi?
A: Devor orqali o'tish uchun shnurni mexanik shikastlanishlardan himoya qilish maqsadida kabel kirituvchisi yoki o'tkazuvchi adapterdan foydalanish tavsiya etiladi.

en.name: LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 15 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 15 m: single-mode connections over medium distances between cabinets and floor nodes. Buy in Tashkent, in stock.
en.description:
The LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 15 m long, from Pixietech is designed for setting up single-mode optical connections over medium distances — between rooms, mounting cabinets, or nodes within a single floor of a building. The simplex cord with an LC/UPC connector is convenient for flexible routing in network infrastructure when a single optical channel in one direction is required. The 15 m length allows routing the cable along a tray while accounting for obstacle bypasses.

## Advantages
- 15 m length: optimal for connection between adjacent rooms or mounting cabinets
- Single-mode SM fiber: high throughput and support for modern speed standards
- UPC polishing: stable contact, low attenuation and back reflection
- Simplex format: flexibility in building unidirectional or WDM channels
- LC connector: a compact and widely supported connection standard
- 1-year warranty: guaranteed quality from Pixietech

## Applications
- Inter-room optical connections in offices and technical rooms
- IP video surveillance: routing from switching nodes to servers
- Corporate and departmental networks: horizontal structured cabling system
- Security and fire systems: control optical channels
- Telecommunication nodes: flexible switching of equipment

## FAQ
Q: Can a 15 m patch cord be extended to a greater length?
A: It can be joined via an LC/UPC adapter, but each connection adds losses; it is better to choose a cord of the required length right away.
Q: How can the integrity of the fiber be checked without special equipment?
A: Shine a flashlight into one end of the connector: if the light is visible at the other end, the fiber is not damaged.
Q: Is a special coupler needed to route the patch cord through a wall?
A: To pass through a wall, it is recommended to use a cable gland or a feed-through adapter to protect the cord from mechanical damage.

## Avantajlar
- 15 m uzunluk: bitişik odalar veya montaj kabinetleri arasındaki bağlantı için en uygun
- Tek modlu SM fiber: yüksek bant genişliği ve modern hız standartlarına destek

- Simpleks format: tek yönlü veya WDM kanalları kurmada esneklik

## Kullanım alanları

- IP video gözetim: anahtarlama düğümlerinden sunuculara döşeme
- Kurumsal ve kurumlar arası ağlar: yatay yapısal kablolama sistemi

Q: 15 m patch kablosu daha büyük bir uzunluğa uzatılabilir mi?
A: LC/UPC adaptör aracılığıyla birleştirilebilir, ancak her bağlantı kayıp ekler; hemen gereken uzunlukta bir kablo seçmek daha iyidir.
Q: Özel ekipman olmadan fiberin bütünlüğü nasıl kontrol edilir?
A: Bir el fenerinin ışığını konnektörün bir ucuna yöneltin: ışık diğer uçta görünüyorsa fiber hasarsızdır.
Q: Patch kablosunu bir duvardan geçirmek için özel bir manşon gerekli mi?
A: Bir duvardan geçiş için, kabloyu mekanik hasardan korumak amacıyla bir kablo rakoru veya geçiş adaptörü kullanılması önerilir.

## 优势
- 15 米长度：适合相邻房间或安装机柜之间的连接
- 单模 SM 光纤：高吞吐量并支持现代速率标准

- 单工格式：构建单向或 WDM 通道时具备灵活性

- 办公和技术机房中的房间间光纤连接

Q: 如何在没有专用设备的情况下检查光纤的完整性？
A: 将手电筒的光照入连接器一端：如果另一端可见光，则光纤未受损。
Q: 将跳线穿墙敷设是否需要专用接续件？
A: 穿墙时建议使用电缆密封接头或穿墙适配器，以保护跳线免受机械损伤。

uz.name: Optik patchkord LC/UPC SM, 2 m

uz.description:
Pixietech kompaniyasidan 2 m uzunlikdagi LC/UPC SM optik patchkord — server shkaflari va montaj stoykalarida bir modali uskunani kommutatsiya qilish uchun ixcham va ishonchli yechim. Ikki metr uzunlik bir yoki qo'shni stoykalarda joylashgan qurilmalar o'rtasida ortiqcha kabel halqalarisiz qulay ulanish uchun yetarli. LC/UPC ulagichi minimal kiritilgan yo'qotishlar bilan aniq optik kontaktni ta'minlaydi.

- 2 m uzunlik: shkaf ichidagi va stoykalararo kommutatsiya uchun optimal

- Bir modali SM tola: zamonaviy tarmoq uskunasining keng spektri bilan moslik

- Ixcham LC ulagich: patch-panelda yuqori montaj zichligi

- Server stoykalari: transiverlar, kommutatorlar va mediakonvertorlarni ulash

## FAQ
Q: LC/UPC va LC/APC ulagichlari o'rtasidagi farq nimada?
A: UPC (Ultra Physical Contact) tekis uchga ega va aksariyat tarmoq qo'llanishlari uchun mos; APC (Angled Physical Contact) yanada kamroq teskari aks ettirishli qiyshiq uchga ega va asosan GPON va kabel televideniyesida ishlatiladi.
Q: 2 m patchkord 10G SFP+-transiverlar bilan mos keladimi?
A: Ha, bir modali SM tola transiver to'lqin uzunligiga mos kelishi sharti bilan LC portli 10G SFP+-transiverlar bilan mos keladi.
Q: Changdan himoya qiluvchi qopqoqlarni alohida sotib olish kerakmi?
A: Buyurtma berishda to'plamni aniqlang; odatda saqlash va tashish vaqtida ulagichlar uchlarini himoya qilish uchun qopqoqlardan foydalanish tavsiya etiladi.

en.name: LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 2 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 2 m: a single-mode cord for convenient equipment connection in adjacent racks without excess loops. In stock.
en.description:
The LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 2 m long, from Pixietech is a concise and reliable solution for switching single-mode equipment in server cabinets and mounting racks. Two meters of length are sufficient for convenient connection between devices located in the same or adjacent racks, without excess cable loops. The LC/UPC connector ensures precise optical contact with minimal insertion losses.

## Advantages
- 2 m length: optimal for in-cabinet and inter-rack switching
- UPC polishing: reliable optical contact, low back reflection
- Single-mode SM fiber: compatibility with a wide range of modern network equipment
- Simplex format: point connection without excess cable
- Compact LC connector: high mounting density on a patch panel
- 1-year warranty: quality guaranteed by the manufacturer Pixietech

## Applications
- Server racks: connecting transceivers, switches, and media converters
- Optical cross-connects: connecting adapter ports to active equipment
- Video surveillance systems: switching in a local mounting node
- Security systems: optical connections in a technical cabinet
- Telecommunication nodes: flexible and neat routing of equipment

## FAQ
Q: What is the difference between LC/UPC and LC/APC connectors?
A: UPC (Ultra Physical Contact) has a flat end face and is suitable for most network applications; APC (Angled Physical Contact) has an angled end face with even lower back reflection and is used mainly in GPON and cable television.
Q: Is the 2 m patch cord compatible with 10G SFP+ transceivers?
A: Yes, single-mode SM fiber is compatible with 10G SFP+ transceivers with LC ports, provided the transceiver wavelength matches.
Q: Do dust caps need to be purchased separately?
A: Check the kit contents when ordering; as a rule, it is recommended to use caps to protect the connector end faces during storage and transport.

Q: LC/UPC ile LC/APC konnektörleri arasındaki fark nedir?
A: UPC (Ultra Physical Contact) düz bir uç yüzeyine sahiptir ve çoğu ağ uygulaması için uygundur; APC (Angled Physical Contact) daha da düşük geri yansımaya sahip eğimli bir uç yüzeyine sahiptir ve esas olarak GPON ve kablo televizyonunda kullanılır.
Q: 2 m patch kablosu 10G SFP+ alıcı-vericileriyle uyumlu mu?

Q: Toz koruma kapaklarının ayrı satın alınması gerekir mi?

- 视频监控系统：在本地安装节点处跳接
- 安防系统：技术机柜中的光纤连接
- 电信节点：设备的灵活整洁布线

## FAQ
Q: LC/UPC 与 LC/APC 连接器有何区别？
A: UPC（Ultra Physical Contact）端面为平面，适用于大多数网络应用；APC（Angled Physical Contact）端面为斜面，回波反射更低，主要用于 GPON 和有线电视。
Q: 2 米跳线是否与 10G SFP+ 光模块兼容？
A: 是的，在光模块波长匹配的前提下，单模 SM 光纤与具备 LC 端口的 10G SFP+ 光模块兼容。
Q: 是否需要单独购买防尘帽？
A: 下单时请确认套件配置；通常建议使用防尘帽以在存放和运输期间保护连接器端面。

en.name: LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 20 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 20 m: a single-mode cord for structured cabling and fiber lines, long-distance transmission with low loss. Delivery across Uzbekistan.
en.description:
The Pixietech LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 20 m long, is designed for connecting active equipment in structured cabling systems and fiber-optic networks. The single-mode design ensures lossless signal transmission over considerable distances, while the LC/UPC connectors guarantee low return losses when connecting. It is suitable for installers, system integrators, and specialists who need a reliable connection in technical rooms and server rooms.

## Advantages
- Single-mode SM fiber — minimal signal attenuation and stable operation over long distances
- LC/UPC connectors with a polished end face — low reflection losses and high connection quality
- 20 m length — sufficient for inter-rack switching and routing along technical corridors
- 1-year warranty from manufacturer Pixietech — confirmed build quality
- Flexible jacket — convenient when routing in the cramped conditions of server and mounting cabinets
- Ready for installation immediately upon delivery — requires no additional polishing or termination

## Applications
- Server rooms and data centers: connecting switches, routers, and storage systems to optical patch panels
- Video surveillance systems: transmitting the video stream over fiber between switches and DVRs
- Telecommunication nodes: connecting DWDM/CWDM equipment and optical multiplexers
- Corporate networks: horizontal and vertical switching within a building
- Industrial facilities: routing in zones with a high level of electromagnetic interference

## FAQ
Q: Is the patch cord suitable for working with SFP transceivers?
A: Yes, the LC/UPC connector is standard for most SFP transceivers, so the patch cord is compatible with equipment from leading network equipment manufacturers.

Q: Can this patch cord be used outdoors?
A: The patch cord is intended for indoor routing; for outdoor installation, cables with a protective outer jacket should be used.

Q: How can the integrity of the patch cord be verified before installation?
A: A visual inspection of the connectors and a check with an optical reflectometer or a visual fault locator before installation is recommended.

Teknik odalarda ve sunucu odalarında güvenilir bağlantıya ihtiyaç duyan montajcılar, sistem entegratörleri ve uzmanlar için uygundur.

## Avantajlar
- Tek modlu SM fiber — minimum sinyal zayıflaması ve uzun mesafelerde kararlı çalışma
- Parlatılmış uç yüzeyli LC/UPC konnektörler — düşük yansıma kayıpları ve yüksek bağlantı kalitesi
- 20 m uzunluk — raflar arası anahtarlama ve teknik koridorlarda döşeme için yeterli
- Üretici Pixietech'ten 1 yıl garanti — onaylanmış yapım kalitesi
- Esnek kılıf — sunucu ve montaj kabinetlerinin dar koşullarında döşemede kullanışlı
- Teslimattan hemen sonra kuruluma hazır — ek parlatma veya sonlandırma gerektirmez

## Kullanım alanları
- Sunucu odaları ve veri merkezleri: switch'lerin, yönlendiricilerin ve depolama sistemlerinin optik patch panellere bağlanması
- Video gözetim sistemleri: switch'ler ve DVR'lar arasında video akışının fiber üzerinden iletilmesi
- Telekomünikasyon düğümleri: DWDM/CWDM ekipmanlarının ve optik çoğullayıcıların bağlanması
- Kurumsal ağlar: bina içinde yatay ve dikey anahtarlama
- Endüstriyel tesisler: yüksek düzeyde elektromanyetik girişim olan bölgelerde döşeme

## FAQ
Q: Patch kablosu SFP alıcı-vericilerle çalışmaya uygun mu?
A: Evet, LC/UPC konnektörü çoğu SFP alıcı-vericisi için standarttır, bu nedenle patch kablosu önde gelen ağ ekipmanı üreticilerinin ekipmanlarıyla uyumludur.

Q: Bu patch kablosu açık havada kullanılabilir mi?
A: Patch kablosu iç mekan döşemesi için tasarlanmıştır; dış mekan kurulumları için koruyucu dış kılıflı kablolar kullanılmalıdır.

Q: Montajdan önce patch kablosunun bütünlüğünden nasıl emin olunur?
A: Kurulumdan önce konnektörlerin görsel olarak incelenmesi ve optik reflektometre veya görsel hasar bulucu ile kontrol edilmesi önerilir.

- 单模 SM 光纤——信号衰减最小，长距离运行稳定

A: 建议在安装前对连接器进行目视检查，并使用光时域反射仪或可视故障定位仪进行检测。

en.name: LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 25 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 25 m: single-mode fiber for patching over long distances in server and cross-connect rooms. Buy in Tashkent.
en.description:
The Pixietech LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 25 m long, is a professional solution for switching fiber-optic lines in server rooms, cross-connect rooms, and technical zones. The single-mode fiber ensures reliable data transmission over long distances, while the standard LC/UPC connectors are compatible with a wide range of active equipment. The 25 m length allows equipment located in different rows of server cabinets to be connected without strain.

## Advantages
- Single-mode SM fiber — stable operation when transmitting data over considerable distances
- LC/UPC connectors — a standard form factor compatible with most SFP ports and patch panels
- 25 m length — optimal for large server halls and distributed cable nodes
- 1-year warranty — Pixietech production quality control
- Convenient routing — the flexible jacket reduces the risk of fiber kinking during installation
- Readiness for immediate use — the connectors are polished and protected with caps

## Applications
- Data centers: inter-rack switching and connecting servers to switching equipment
- Security systems: transmitting the video signal over an optical channel at large facilities
- Operator communication nodes: organizing transport optical paths within telephone exchanges and PoPs
- Corporate LANs: backbone lines between floor distributors
- Educational and medical institutions: building a reliable network infrastructure

## FAQ
Q: Is the patch cord compatible with equipment from different manufacturers?
A: The LC/UPC connector is an international standard, so the patch cord is compatible with equipment from MikroTik, Cisco, Huawei, TP-Link, and other brands.

Q: Is additional extension of the patch cord via a splice permitted?
A: This is technically possible, however each splice introduces additional losses; it is recommended to choose a patch cord of the required length right away.

Q: What minimum bend distance is permissible during routing?
A: During installation, the minimum bend radius specified by the manufacturer must be observed so as not to damage the fiber — as a rule, no less than 30 mm.

- Tek modlu SM fiber — veriyi önemli mesafelerde iletirken kararlı çalışma
- LC/UPC konnektörler — çoğu SFP portu ve patch paneliyle uyumlu standart form faktörü
- 25 m uzunluk — büyük sunucu salonları ve dağıtık kablo düğümleri için en uygun
- 1 yıl garanti — Pixietech üretim kalite kontrolü
- Kullanışlı döşeme — esnek kılıf, montaj sırasında fiber bükülme riskini azaltır
- Hemen kullanıma hazırlık — konnektörler parlatılmış ve kapaklarla korunmuştur

## Kullanım alanları
- Veri işleme merkezleri: raflar arası anahtarlama ve sunucuların anahtarlama ekipmanına bağlanması
- Güvenlik sistemleri: büyük tesislerde optik kanal üzerinden video sinyali iletimi

- Eğitim ve tıbbi kurumlar: güvenilir ağ altyapısının kurulması

## FAQ
Q: Patch kablosu farklı üreticilerin ekipmanlarıyla uyumlu mu?
A: LC/UPC konnektörü uluslararası bir standarttır, bu nedenle patch kablosu MikroTik, Cisco, Huawei, TP-Link ve diğer markaların ekipmanlarıyla uyumludur.

Q: Patch kablosunun bir ek aracılığıyla ek olarak uzatılmasına izin verilir mi?

Q: Döşeme sırasında izin verilen minimum bükülme mesafesi nedir?
A: Montaj sırasında fiberi zedelememek için üreticinin belirttiği minimum bükülme yarıçapına uyulmalıdır — kural olarak 30 mm'den az olmamalıdır.

en.description:
The Pixietech LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 3 m long, is a compact and convenient connecting cord for switching equipment within a single mounting cabinet or a small server rack. The single-mode design and LC/UPC connectors make it compatible with most modern transceivers and patch panels. The short length simplifies cable routing and maintains order in the mounting space.

## Advantages
- 3 m length — convenient for neat in-cabinet switching without excess loops
- Single-mode SM fiber — minimal attenuation, suitable for high-speed data transmission
- LC/UPC connectors — low return losses, a standard form factor for SFP transceivers
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech — reliability confirmed by the manufacturer
- Flexible protective jacket — reduces the risk of damage during repeated reconnection
- Ready for installation — the connectors are polished and protected with dust caps

## Applications
- Mounting cabinets and racks: switching switches, routers, and patch panels
- Mini server and operator cabinets: connecting active equipment in a cramped space
- Laboratory benches and test zones: quick connection during setup and diagnostics
- Video surveillance systems: connecting optical media converters to switches
- Telecommunication nodes: switching within cross-sections and optical cross-connects

## FAQ
Q: Is the 3 m patch cord suitable for connecting to an OLT or ONU?
A: Yes, the LC/UPC connector is widely used in PON network equipment, and such a patch cord is suitable for switching between an OLT and an optical cross-connect.

Q: Can a single-mode patch cord be used in a multimode network?
A: No, mixing fiber types is not recommended — this will lead to a significant increase in losses and unstable network operation.

Q: How should the patch cord be stored correctly when it is not in use?
A: Store it with the dust caps installed, avoiding sharp bends, exposure to moisture, and direct sunlight.

en.name: LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 5 m
en.shortDescription: Pixietech LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 5 m: a single-mode cord for patching in mounting cabinets and server rooms with minimal loss. Buy with warranty.
en.description:
Pixietech LC/UPC SM optical patch cord, 5 m long — a universal connecting cord for switching equipment in mounting cabinets, small server rooms and technical spaces. The single-mode fiber and LC/UPC connectors provide a reliable connection with minimal optical loss, while the 5 m length gives the necessary slack for neat routing without excess loops. Suitable for initial installation and replacement of damaged jumpers at operating sites.

## Advantages
- 5 m length — sufficient for switching equipment in adjacent sections of a mounting cabinet
- Single-mode SM fiber — low attenuation and stable operation during data transmission
- LC/UPC connectors — precise end-face polishing reduces return loss to a minimum
- 1-year warranty from Pixietech — guaranteed quality of every product
- Ready for instant installation — connectors are protected by caps against dust and contamination
- Flexible jacket — easy routing in tight mounting conditions

## Applications
- Mounting cabinets and telecommunication racks: connecting switches to patch panels
- Video surveillance systems: connecting media converters and optical switches
- Office server rooms: organizing in-cabinet optical switching
- Internet providers: terminal switching at PON network nodes
- Laboratory and test benches: flexible switching during equipment setup

## FAQ
Q: Can this patch cord be used in GPON networks?
A: Yes, the LC/UPC connector is widely used in GPON equipment, and the patch cord is compatible with most ONUs and OLTs of this type.

Q: How often should the condition of the connectors be checked?
A: With frequent reconnection, it is recommended to periodically inspect the end faces with an optical microscope and clean them with special tools if necessary.

Q: Is the patch cord compatible with single-window and dual-window equipment?
A: LC/UPC SM is used in both single-window and dual-window systems; specific compatibility is determined by the parameters of the transceivers used.

- Anında kuruluma hazır — konektörler toz ve kirlenmeye karşı kapaklarla korunur
- Esnek kılıf — dar montaj koşullarında kolay döşeme

- Montaj kabinetleri ve telekomünikasyon rafları: anahtarların patch panellere bağlanması
- Video gözetim sistemleri: medya dönüştürücülerin ve optik anahtarların bağlanması
- Ofis sunucu odaları: kabin içi optik anahtarlamanın düzenlenmesi
